name: Library and Voices hosts split by domain
summary: The site is two products on separate hostnames: Library (texts) and Voices (sheets/community, called chiburim in Hebrew). The host decides which pages exist.
details: ROOT_URLCONF is empty; django-hosts picks sefaria.urls_library or sefaria.urls_sheets from settings.DOMAIN_MODULES; unknown hosts fall to DEFAULT_HOST=library.
DOMAIN_MODULES shape: {en:{library,voices}, he:{library,voices}}. Prod: sefaria.org / sefaria.org.il; voices subdomain is voices. (en) and chiburim. (he).
Local example hosts: www.localsefaria.org:8000, voices.localsefaria.org:8000, www.localsefaria.org.il:8000, chiburim.localsefaria.org.il:8000.
NAME_SERVICE=True pods route every host to sefaria.urls_name (autocomplete only).
Module names 'library' and 'voices' (static/js/constants.js:27-28).
HostsRequestMiddleware must be first and HostsResponseMiddleware last in MIDDLEWARE.

name: URLconf composition and catchall order
summary: Pages are matched in a fixed order, ending in a catchall that treats any single path segment as a text reference.
details: Library: urls_library.urlpatterns + operational patterns + shared_patterns; Voices: urls_sheets.urlpatterns + shared_patterns.
shared_patterns (urls_shared.py:20-315) + site_urlpatterns (sites/sefaria/urls.py via SITE_PACKAGE) + staticfiles + final catchall ^(?P<tref>[^/]+)(/)?$ -> reader.views.catchall.
handler404 = reader.views.custom_page_not_found, handler500 = custom_server_error.
First match wins; ordering causes shadowing bugs (see garden and edit/textinfo features).

name: Maintenance mode
summary: When the site is flagged down for maintenance, every page returns a 503 maintenance message except health and admin-cache endpoints.
details: DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE swaps urlpatterns for maintenance_patterns on both library and voices.
Kept alive: admin/reset/cache, admin, healthz, health-check, healthz-rollout; all else -> sefaria.views.maintenance_message (503, static/maintenance.html).
Replaces all patterns with maintenance_patterns (urls_shared.py ~322-333); keeps /admin/reset/cache, /admin, health checks. maintenance_message view returns static/maintenance.html.

name: Edge redirects to Voices for sheets, collections, profile
summary: On the library host, any /sheets, /collections or /profile path is bounced to the same path on the Voices host before it reaches Django.
details: nginx rule ^/(sheets|collections|profile)(/.*|$) -> 307 to voices subdomain, same path; driven by values domains.modules[].redirects.
This is why library Django has no /sheets/<id>, /collections, /profile/<slug> routes; local dev without nginx 404s on library host.
Dead Django equivalents: collections_redirect, profile_redirect_to_voices, sheets_redirect_to_voices (reader/views.py:5274-5310) are not routed.

name: Bare root domain redirects to www
summary: Visiting sefaria.org without www sends the user to www.sefaria.org, except for iOS app-link verification files.
details: nginx: bare root -> 301 https://www.<root>$request_uri.
Exceptions proxied with Host=www: /apple-app-site-association and /.well-known/apple-app-site-association.

name: Mobile message and sitemap passthrough at edge
summary: The app's in-app message files and the sitemaps are served by nginx rather than Django.
details: /static/mobile/message-en.json and message-he.json -> 301 to Strapi /api/mobile-message(-he).
/static/sitemaps/ proxied to GCS bucket sefaria-sitemaps.
/api/search/<index>/_search|_analyze proxied directly to Elasticsearch with basic auth; other /api/search/* -> 403.

name: robots.txt rules
summary: Crawlers are told to skip activity pages and login/register next-links.
details: Served from configmap robots-txt.yaml: Disallow /activity/, /login?next=*, /register?next=*; or Disallow: / when disableScraping is set.

name: Request middleware affecting URL behavior
summary: A fixed middleware chain decides module, language, location, cookies and redirects before any view runs.
details: SessionCookieDomainMiddleware: session/CSRF cookie Domain = common suffix of all module hosts of same language (.sefaria.org) so login is shared library<->voices;
optionally expires legacy domain-less cookies when remote config EXPIRE_LEGACY_COOKIES.
SessionIDAuthMiddleware: authenticates anonymous requests via encrypted X-Session-ID header (chatbot token).
UserAgentMiddleware: request.user_agent.is_mobile drives multiPanel.
ModuleMiddleware: request.active_module from host, default library; forced library for /linker.js, /api/, /_api/, /apple-app-site-association, /static/ (but /api/img-gen/ is processed).
LocationSettingsMiddleware: country_code from Cloudflare cf-ipcountry (XX/missing -> PINNED_IPCOUNTRY or 'us'); request.diaspora = country != 'il'.
WebSessionRedirectMiddleware: appends no_applink=1 to redirect Locations continuing a web session (OAuth callback or sefaria Referer) so iOS universal links do not hijack.
LanguageCookieMiddleware: handles ?set-language-cookie (see Language domains).
ProfileMiddleware: ?prof (DEBUG only) returns cProfile output; ?sort= sorts it.
ClearSsoNextCookieMiddleware: deletes sefaria_sso_next cookie on /api/auth/google/redirect and /accounts/apple/login/callback/finish/.

name: Library home and texts navigation URLs
summary: Library has no separate home page: / sends visitors to /texts, and /texts/<category path> browses the table of contents.
details: / (library) -> 302 /texts (home view reader/views.py:4581-4586).
/texts: React page, menu 'navigation'; passes userHistory props (get_user_history_props).
/texts/<cats...>: menu 'navigation' with initialNavigationCategories = path split on '/'.
'Tanach' anywhere in the category path -> 302 to same path with 'Tanakh'.
Unknown category falls back to rendering /texts home (no 404).
Title uses Hebrew terms for he interface; description = category enDesc/heDesc -> shortDesc -> default; emits JSON-LD category breadcrumbs.
DEAD: cats=='recent' branch in texts_category_list is effectively dead.
/texts/recent -> 301 /texts/history, which is not a real page and falls back to texts home (BUG: broken legacy redirect).

name: Learning schedules and calendar URLs
summary: /calendars opens the Learning Schedules page; daily shortcuts jump straight to today's reading.
details: /calendars: menu 'calendars'.
/parashat-hashavua -> 302 this week's parasha URL; reads ?diaspora but ignores it (TODO) and uses the default calendar.
/todays-daf-yomi -> 302 today's daf.
/dayoflearningcalendar -> external/internal 302 (site package).

name: Translations page URLs
summary: /translations/<language> lists texts available in a given translation language.
details: Allowed slugs: ar de en eo es fa fi fr he it pl pt ru yi (Ladino commented out); any other slug -> 404.
Menu 'translationsPage' with initialTranslationsSlug; localized title/desc per language; noindex False.
In-app links inside .translationsPage override content language from link ?lang.
api/texts/translations builds reader URLs /<firstSectionRef>?ven=<family|title>&lang=bi.

name: Random text URLs
summary: Random links send readers to a random segment or a random-text page.
details: /random/link -> 302 random segment ref (random_redirect).
/random -> random.html page.
api/texts/random -> 302 /api/texts/<random>?commentary=0&context=0; regex ^api/texts/random?$ also matches a missing last letter.

name: Account settings URL
summary: Signed-in users manage account preferences at /settings/account, a server-rendered page under the React header.
details: login_required; Django template account_settings.html with ReaderApp header-only ({headerMode:True} -> Node SSR header).
Context: social providers, Library Assistant toggle, translation-language list from SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LANGUAGES, diaspora.
Regex ^settings/account?$ also matches /settings/accoun (typo-tolerant).
POST /settings/account/user changes email (requires current password).
/settings/profile on library -> 301 voices /settings/profile/ (cross-module).

name: Library-side legacy redirects to Voices
summary: Old community and profile-settings addresses on the library host forward to Voices.
details: /community -> 301 voices '/'.
/settings/profile -> 301 voices /settings/profile/.

name: Torah tracker and notes URLs
summary: /torahtracker shows a user's learning stats and /texts/notes shows 'My Notes'; both need login.
details: /torahtracker -> menu 'user_stats' (login required).
/texts/notes -> menu 'notes', @login_required (client history writes /texts/notes for notes menu).

name: Staff tool URLs (modtools, linker editor)
summary: Moderators and staff reach their tools at fixed URLs that load dedicated CSS.
details: /modtools: menu 'modtools', staff only, loads css/modtools.css when page=='modtools' (base.html:122-124).
/linker-editor: menu 'linkerEditor', staff only, ?book= -> initialLinkerEditorBook, loads css/linker-editor.css.
/modtools/upload_text (POST Workflowy upload), /modtools/links (POST CSV link upload/delete, staff), /modtools/links/<tref1>/<tref2> and /modtools/index_links/<tref1>/<tref2> (CSV download;
all GET params forwarded as kwargs; index_links is by_segment=True).
/dashboard: table of all VersionStates (dashboard.html).
/admin/heapdump/ (ops); /api/remote-config JSON.

name: Legacy S1 text editor URLs
summary: Old add/edit/translate text pages still exist on the original Django-template editor.
details: /add/new, /add/<ref>, /translate/<ref>, /edit/<ref> -> edit_text (legacy edit_text.html, S1 jQuery); mode = first path segment capitalized; book-level ref -> 'add new' with title.
/edit/<ref>/<language_family_name>/<version> edits a specific version (underscore -> space).
/add/textinfo/<new_title> -> edit_text_info (legacy edit_text_info.html); redirects to /edit/textinfo/<title> if the title exists.
BUG: /edit/textinfo/<title> is caught by edit/<path:ref> -> edit_text, not edit_text_info (route ordering).
/edit/terms/<term>, /add/terms/<term> -> terms_editor (JSON term editor, staff).
/edit/textinfo ?toc= param has no effect.
sidebarLang only exists as a legacy template var in templates/edit_text.html:45.

name: Activity feed and leaderboard URLs
summary: Contribution history pages show recent edits globally, per user, and per text segment.
details: /activity and /activity/<int:page>: global_activity, ?type= filter, ?api includes API edits; page > 40 -> 'Activity Unavailable'.
/activity/leaderboard (regex leaderboard?$ tolerates missing last letter).
/activity/<slug>/[<page>]: user_activity; needs trailing-slash form. BUG: next_page links go to global /activity/N.
/activity/<tref>/<lang>/<version>[/<page>]: segment_history revision history; 404 if version missing.
robots.txt disallows /activity/.

name: Version compare tool URL
summary: A separate page diffs two versions of a text.
details: /compare[/<ref>/][<en|he>/][<v1>/][<v2>] -> sefaria.views.compare, compare.html (separate React bundle) with JSON_PROPS secRef/v1/v2/lang/refArray.
BUG: stray print(comp_ref) debug left in the view (sefaria/views.py:2192).

name: Download URLs
summary: Text versions can be downloaded as files from stable URLs.
details: /download/version/<title> - <he|en> - <vtitle>.(plain.txt|json|csv|txt) -> text_download_api.
/download/bulk/versions/ -> staff-only zip.

name: Voices home and sheets-with-ref URLs
summary: The Voices host's root is the Voices home; sheets that cite a given source are listed at /sheets-with-ref/<ref>.
details: / (voices): sheets_home_page, menu 'voices'.
/sheets-with-ref/<tref>: menu 'sheetsWithRef', props sheetsWithRef {en,he} + search filter/sort/field params (prefix 's'); title 'Sheets with <ref>'.
/new-home -> 302 '/' (legacy).

name: Sheet URLs
summary: Source sheets open at /sheets/<id>, optionally with a highlighted node, or /sheets/new to start a fresh one.
details: /sheets/<int:id> -> view_sheet -> catchall(sheet=True) React sheet unless ?embed=1.
?embed=1 renders legacy S1 sheets.html (iframe embed) with canonical URL stripping embed=1; body gets 'embeded' class.
/sheets/<id.node> (regex [\d.]+) -> catchall {'sheet':True}, highlights a node, e.g. /sheets/123.4.
/sheets/new -> new_sheet creates an unlisted empty sheet then renders it via catchall(sheet=True) at URL /sheets/new; login required;
editor=True because Referer path == /sheets/new (reader/views.py:699-701); client replaces URL with /sheets/<id> on mount.
/sheets/visual/<int:id> -> legacy sheets_visual.html.
A /Sheet.<id> text URL on library renders a sheet in library (reader/views.py:807-812).
Client-written hash #afterLoading=exportToDrive and legacy #onload=exportToDrive trigger Google Drive export after OAuth; location.hash preserved on history push/replace.
Legacy ?editor=1 emitted by old sheets.js; React app ignores it.
Sheet panels in non-first positions serialize as p<N>=sheet&s<N>=... which the server cannot parse (see multi-panel feature).

name: Collections URLs
summary: Collections have a public list, per-collection pages, and creation/settings pages.
details: /collections: public_collections, menu 'collectionsPublic', collectionListing prop.
/collections/new: menu 'editCollection', initialCollectionData=None, login required, noindex.
/collections/<slug>/settings: menu 'editCollection' with data; 404 unknown slug.

/collections/<slug>: menu 'collection' with initialCollectionName/Slug/Tag(?tag)/initialTab(?tab)/collectionData; privateSlug -> 302 to public slug; noindex unless listed; members see private content.
?tag value written with '#' -> '%23' by client.
Client in-app openURL handles /collections/<slug>[?tag] but NOT /settings or /new (full page load).

name: Profile URLs
summary: Public user profiles live at /profile/<username>; own-profile shortcuts redirect there.
details: /profile/<username>: user_profile, menu 'profile', initialProfile (full dict if owner, else basic), initialTab default 'sheets'; 404 for missing or inactive users.
/profile and /my/profile and /account -> my_profile 302 to /profile/<own slug>, preserving ?tab=; regex ^my/profile has no $ anchor.
/my/notes -> 302 /my/profile?tab=notes (on library the target is unrouted, likely 404).
/contributors/<uid>[/<page>] -> 301 /profile/<uid> (legacy).
/settings/profile (voices): legacy edit_profile.html, login required.
Profile ?tab values e.g. sheets, notes; client in-app handles /profile/<slug>[?tab] and /my/profile[?tab].

name: Voices getting-started and sheets redirects
summary: The Voices marketing page is /getstarted and /sheets itself redirects there.
details: /getstarted -> serve_static {'page':'sheets'}, templates/static/sheets.html.
/sheets -> 301 /getstarted/.
/sheets/tags -> 301 /topics; /sheets/tags/<tag> -> 301 /topics/<tag>; /sheets/public -> 301 /sheets; /sheets/private -> 301 /my/profile (legacy).
/groups[/<name>] -> 302 /collections or /collections/<slug> (lookup by name with '-'->space), keeps ?tag (legacy).

name: Text reader URL (catchall)
summary: Any single-segment path that is not another route is treated as a text reference and opens the reader, book page, or a sheet.
details: Route: ^(?P<tref>[^/]+)(/)?$ -> reader.views.catchall; trailing slash accepted without redirect.
Book-level ref (/Genesis) -> panel menuOpen 'book toc' with indexDetails (content counts + relatedTopics) and versions; with ?notes=1 -> 'extended notes' page.
Torah refs include indexDetails for parashah headers.
Segment-level or ranged refs set highlightedRefs = each segment.
Spanning refs split into a refs list; super-section or empty refs jump to first section with content via first_available_section_ref().
Voices host: a non-sheet ref -> 301 to library domain, same path+query (redirect_to_module).
InputError on parse -> 404.

FOUND 2026-10-05: client-side navigation to a title with a comma wrote %2C (TanStack encodes path params); the old site and a direct load keep the comma ('/Jastrow,_אוֹר', '/Mishneh_Torah,_Shabbat.1.1'). Fixed with `pathParamsAllowedCharacters: [',', ':', '@']` in src/router.tsx.

name: Ref URL normalization to canonical form
summary: Any variant of a citation (case, alt title, Hebrew title, 'Genesis 1:1', 'Gen.1.1') redirects to one canonical URL.
details: Parsed via Ref.instantiate_ref_with_legacy_parse_fallback: plain Ref -> on PartialRefInputError, normalize title + per-index Mongo-backed LegacyRefParser (e.g.
old Zohar refs) -> else partially matched ref.
Canonical = oref.url(False): normal English ref, spaces -> '_', ':' -> '.', last '_' before sections -> '.' (Mishna_Brachot_2:3 -> Mishna_Brachot.2.3); '?' -> %3F with encode_html.
Differing incoming tref -> 301 to canonical with query string preserved.
Legacy /<tref>/<lang>/<version> -> 301 /<tref>?v<lang>=<version>&<orig params> (old_versions_redirect).
Client TextRange replaces history (no new entry) when loaded data's normalized ref differs, ref is spanning (split refs) or super-section (firstAvailableSectionRef).
Client-only: commentary refs with a single base text and depth >=3 (Rashi on Genesis 1:1:1) open as base text Genesis 1:1 + sidebar filter Rashi; server does NOT do this for direct URL loads.

VERIFIED 2026-10-06 on sefaria.org (scripts/probes/multipanel-probe*.mjs, scripts/parity-panels.mjs): a redirect to the canonical ref keeps the request's query as it was (/Gen.1.1?lang=en → 301 /Genesis.1.1?lang=en; /Gen.1.1 → /Genesis.1.1). The rebuild had re-encoded the query; fixed.

name: Version parameter normalization redirect
summary: Version choices in the URL are checked against the text's real versions; stale or legacy values are rewritten or dropped.
details: For main ref and every p<N>, ven<N>/vhe<N> matched against Ref(tref).version_list() by direction (ven=ltr, vhe=rtl): exact (family+title) -> family-only -> title-only;
title-only legacy values (no '|') accepted.
If any value changed -> 302 to /<tref>/?<params> with values replaced; unmatched version params removed.
BUG: redirect uses the raw tref and inserts '/' before '?' (reader/views.py:435).
Only extra panels (p2...) apply corpus version preferences server-side; panel 1 does not (reader/views.py:878).
BUG: extra-panel version validation uses legacy 'language: en/he' field, so versions in other languages can cause the panel to be skipped (:893-897).

name: Search URL
summary: /search runs a query; query, tabs, filters and sort are all in the URL so results are shareable.
details: Menu 'search'; initialQuery, initialSearchTab, filters, field, sort; noindex; title '<q> | Search'.
Params: q; tab (text|sheet, default text); search_tab (sources/books/authors/topics).
Text filters: tpathFilters ('|'-separated, URL-unquoted), tvar (1=naive_lemmatizer, 0=exact), tsort.
Sheet filters: scollectionsFilters, stopics_enFilters, stopics_heFilters, ssort.
Client writes via SearchState.makeURL: &{prefix}{agg}Filters=, &{prefix}var=0|1, &{prefix}sort=.
BUG: sheet filter agg_types += [filter_type]*len(filters) uses cumulative length (reader/views.py:1072-1074); svar never parsed.
Client search URL has no params when query is empty; /search is NOT handled by in-app openURL (full page load).
Search panel extra: p<N>=search with q<N>, tab<N>, search_tab<N>, tpathFilters<N>; text/sheet check reads unsuffixed tab (reader/views.py:1066).

name: Topics URLs
summary: Topics are browsed at /topics, by category, by letter, and individual topic pages.
details: /topics: topics landing (menu 'topics'); description differs library vs voices.
/topics/category/<cat>: menu 'topics', initialNavigationTopicCategory + initialNavigationTopicTitle {en,he}; 404 unknown.
/topics/all/<letter>: menu 'allTopics'; single character only.
/topics/<slug>: initialTopic, initialTab (?tab, default 'notable-sources'), initialTopicSort (?sort, default 'Relevance'), initialTopicTitle, topicData; slug normalized (normalize_slug).
404 if topic not in this module's pool (reader/views.py:3554-3557); noindex if should_display(min_sources) false.
/topics/b/<slug>: topic_page_b with topicTestVersion='b' (A/B variant URL); client builds /topics/<testVersion>/<slug>.
Topic editors redirect to /topics/<slug>?sort=Relevance&tab=<tab>.
BUG: openURL passes tab param for topics but openTopic(slug) ignores it (ReaderApp.jsx:1432,2081).
Legacy: /person/<name> -> 301 /topics/<person slug> (404 if unknown); /people -> 301 /topics/category/authors; /people/Talmud -> 301 /topics/category/talmudic-figures.

name: Saved, history and notifications URLs
summary: Signed-in users have URLs for saved items, reading history and notifications.
details: /saved: menu 'saved', saved.loaded=true with 20 annotated items; voices shows sheets only; login required.
/history: menu 'history', userHistory; respects reading_history setting; login required.
/notifications: menu 'notifications', scoped by active module; login required.

name: Login, register and logout URLs
summary: Sign-in, sign-up and logout have their own addresses and open the in-app auth page.
details: /login: CustomLoginView, React page (headerMode False), ReaderApp shows AuthPage login flow; logged-in -> 302 '/'; title 'Log in to Sefaria'.
/register: React AuthPage register flow; POST creates user; ?next=; ?educator=1 pre-checks educator subscribe; POST noredirect -> JSON;
success appends welcome=to-sefaria to next (except new?assignment= nexts); next validated against host; logged-in -> 302 '/'.
logout: GET or POST, then ?next (host-validated); client builds /logout?next=/texts (library) or /logout?next=/ (voices).
/password/reset/confirm/<uidb64>/<token>/: AuthPage reset flow with authResetUid, authResetValid; POST JSON sets password; POST {action:'resend'} re-emails.
Client resolveInitialAuthState: path /login, /register (optional trailing /) or authResetUid -> showAuth.
openURL turns /login and /register links into in-app AuthPage with next = current path; data-signup-source captured for funnel analytics.
Client helpers withNext, safeNext (same-origin check) in static/js/auth/utils.js.
No first-party JS reads the welcome param (presumably analytics/GTM).

VERIFIED 2026-10-06: titles 'Log in to Sefaria' and 'Create an Account' (www.sefaria.org); Hebrew site 'כניסה לחשבון בספריא' and 'יצירת חשבון' (www.sefaria.org.il). The reset page's 'Reset Your Password' has no Hebrew in locale/he.

REBUILD: /login, /register and /password/reset/confirm/<uidb64>/<token>/ are routes of the new client (src/routes/_auth*.tsx — one AuthPage stays mounted across them); 'login', 'register' and 'password' left DJANGO_PREFIXES (src/server/pass-through.ts). Every POST to them still goes to Django. A signed-in reader asking for /login or /register goes to '/' as Django did. Trailing slashes are dropped by the router (307), the reset POSTs re-add Django's slash.

REBUILD: the emailed token link is handed to Django (it validates the token, stores it in the session and 302s to …/<uid>/set-password/, which the client renders); VERIFIED 2026-10-06 against www.sefaria.org through the client's pass-through: an invalid token gets Django's page (no redirect), which the client turns into a 302 to the set-password address so the expired card shows there.

name: SSO and auth API endpoints
summary: Social and email login use dedicated endpoints under /accounts, /_allauth and /api/auth.
details: /_allauth/... allauth headless; /accounts/... allauth OAuth login/callback (Google, Apple).
/api/auth/google/redirect, /api/auth/google/mobile, /api/auth/apple/callback, /api/auth/apple/mobile, /api/auth/login (JSON email login), /api/auth/password/reset.
/api/login/ and /api/login/refresh/ JWT for mobile.
/gauth, /gauth/callback, /unlink-gauth (Google Drive OAuth); unlink-gauth?redirect=0 returns JSON instead of 302 to profile.

REBUILD: the client calls /api/auth/login, /api/auth/password/reset, /api/auth/apple/callback, /_allauth/browser/v1/auth/provider/token and /_allauth/browser/v1/auth/session same-origin; /_allauth, /accounts, /api, /logout stay Django's in the pass-through.

name: Language switch URL (/interface)
summary: /interface/english and /interface/hebrew switch interface language and then return to the page.
details: Sets interfaceLang cookie (+profile); 302 to ?next validated vs ALLOWED_HOSTS.
If a domain switch is needed, next becomes absolute on the target domain plus set-language-cookie.
Header links use NextRedirectAnchor -> window.location.href = /interface/<lang>?next=<encoded current path> (DropdownMenu.jsx:39-54, Header.jsx:599-607).

Rebuild: GET /interface/english|hebrew?next=<path> sets the interfaceLang cookie (1 year, Lax) and 302s to next. next must be a path on this site (a '//host', backslash or absolute URL falls back to '/'): the old route's open-redirect exposure is not copied.

name: Global JS data and plugin file URLs
summary: Several JS files are served by Django for the app, third parties, and caching.
details: /data.js and /data.<ts>.js: DJANGO_DATA_VARS (toc, topic_toc, terms, books, search index names, virtualBooks); Cache-Control max-age=31536000 immutable;
base.html requests /data.<last_cached_short>.js.
/sefaria.js: packaged Sefaria.js + data for third parties.
/linker.js, /linker.v<N>.js, /linker.v3.js.map: external citation linker plugin; version from remote config default '3'.

name: Admin and ops URLs
summary: Django admin and staff operational endpoints are mounted under ADMIN_PATH and /admin/*.
details: /admin/... Django admin; /admin/reset/..., /admin/rebuild/..., /admin/delete/..., /admin/spam..., /admin/*stats and similar staff ops views (sefaria/views.py).
ADMIN_PATH setting controls admin location.

name: Legacy redirects (complete list)
summary: A single reference list of every legacy URL that is redirected.
details: /texts/recent->/texts/history (301); Tanach->Tanakh (302); /<tref>/<lang>/<version>->?v<lang>= (301); /api/texts/<tref>/<lang>/<version> (301).
/sheets/tags[/<tag>]->/topics[/<tag>] (301); /sheets/public|private (301); /groups[/<name>]->/collections (302).
/contributors/<uid>->/profile/<uid> (301); /person/<name>->/topics/<slug> (301); /people[/Talmud] (301).
/new-home->/ (302); /my/notes->/my/profile?tab=notes; /account, /profile, /my/profile -> /profile/<slug>.
/ (library)->/texts; collection privateSlug -> public slug; /edit/textinfo add-new -> edit; /annualreport2021 -> /annualreport/2021.
api/texts/<non-normal tref> GET -> 301 to normalized URL with params.

name: Help-center redirects for specific sheets
summary: A set of sheets that were turned into help articles redirect to the Zendesk help center.
details: get_redirect_to_help_center: sheet id in SITE_SETTINGS.HELP_CENTER_REDIRECTS[<lang>] (~30 en ids plus he) -> 302 to the Zendesk article for /sheets/<id> or /sheets/<id>.<node>.
Language = request.LANGUAGE_CODE falling back to 'en'.

name: Cross-module redirect rules
summary: Moving between Library and Voices is done with permanent redirects from Django and temporary redirects from nginx.
details: Django cross-module redirects are 301 and use DOMAIN_MODULES[<interface lang short code>][module] (reader/views.py:5250-5257).
library /settings/profile and /community -> voices; voices about-sidebar static pages -> library; voices non-sheet refs -> library.
nginx library /sheets*, /collections*, /profile* -> 307 voices.
voices /sheets -> 301 /getstarted/.

name: 404 and error pages
summary: Missing pages show a bilingual, header-only 404; server errors show a 500 page.
details: Http404 -> custom_page_not_found renders 404.html (extends base.html, header-only, bilingual, title 'Page Not Found | Sefaria') status 404; 500 -> 500.html.
404 triggers: bad ref; topic not found or not in module pool; unknown collection/translation slug/profile/inactive profile; sheet load error (make_sheet_panel_dict); unknown annual-report year;
segment history w/o version.
Unrecognized extra panels p<N> are skipped silently rather than 404.

name: External and donation redirects
summary: Memorable short URLs forward to donation, help, docs and campaign destinations.
details: All 302 unless noted (sites/sefaria/urls.py:85-106).
/donate/mobile -> donate.sefaria.org english/he ?c_src=App by interface lang; /donate by interface lang; /give/<channel_source> -> c_src=<channel>; /give -> c_src=mu; /giving; /gala.
/powered-by -> developers docs (301); /wiki; /developers; /request-a-text (Google form); /request-a-training; /contribute (GitHub wiki).
/faq and /help -> help center by interface lang.
/jf or /jfn (regex ^jfn?$) -> https://voices.sefaria.org/sheets/60494.
/nechama... and /Nechama... (regex ^[nN]echama/? no end anchor) -> /collections/גיליונות-נחמה.
/contes... -> /powered-by-sefaria-contest-2020; /contest itself is a static page because static routes come first.
/rabbis -> /educators; /connect -> /newsletter.

name: Version selection params (ven, vhe)
summary: The URL records which English-side/translation and Hebrew/primary version is displayed.
details: ven/vhe value format '<languageFamilyName>|<Version_Title>' with '_' for spaces; _extract_version_params -> currVersions.en (translation) / .he (primary).
Pre-normalized by _get_current_and_normalized_versions (see version normalization).
Missing -> {languageFamilyName:'',versionTitle:''} -> server picks defaults ('primary'/'translation').
Client writer Sefaria.util.getUrlVersionsParams: &ven=family|Title_With_Underscores, ';' -> %3B (encodeVtitle).
ven<N>/vhe<N> for panel N (suffix only when i>1), then override_version_with_preference for extra panels.
Per-book cached version from defaultVersions used when no version is set for the displayed language.

name: Display language param (lang, lang2)
summary: The URL records bilingual/Hebrew/English display for the text panel and a separate language for the connections panel.
details: lang: en/he/bi -> settings.language (short_to_long_lang_code); also read by LanguageSettingsMiddleware as contentLang.
Client writes &lang= from panel settings.language.substring(0,2).
lang2: connections panel language when 'with' present; must be en/he else falls back to lang (if en/he) else interface lang; applied to Connections panel only.
ConnectionsPanelHeader builds a toggle link via replaceUrlParam('lang2', ...) which is a full navigation link.
Content language order: ?lang -> contentLang cookie -> default (hebrew for he interface else bilingual).

VERIFIED 2026-10-06 on sefaria.org (scripts/probes/multipanel-probe*.mjs, scripts/parity-panels.mjs): a sidebar opened by the reader has one language (lang2=en, or he when the reader's default is Hebrew — openTextListAt never lets it be bilingual); an old link without lang2 shows and writes lang2=bi.

name: Connections sidebar param (with)
summary: The URL records which sidebar view or commentary filter is open next to the text.
details: with=all -> []; else '_' -> space, split on '+'; ignored on voices.
Present -> multi-panel: Text + Connections panels; mobile: single TextAndConnections panel. Sets highlightedRefs=[ref], showHighlight=True.
First filter determines connectionsMode via get_connections_mode: sidebar-mode list (Sheets, Notes, About, AboutSheet, Navigation, Translations, Translation Open, Version Open, WebPages,
extended notes, Topics, Torah Readings, manuscripts, Lexicon, SidebarSearch, Guide, LinkerAdmin) -> that mode, filter cleared.
'<Cat> ConnectionsList' -> ConnectionsList + connectionsCategory; 'WebPage:<site>' -> WebPagesList + webPagesFilter; else TextList (commentator filter e.g. with=Rashi).
Client writes &with=<sources>: filter list joined by '+', or connectionsMode if in sidebarModes, ' ConnectionsList' suffix for category lists, WebPage:<site> for web pages list.

name: Sidebar sub-state params (vside, lookup, sbsq, namedEntity)
summary: Sidebar details like version filter, looked-up words, in-book search query and selected named entity are stored in the URL.
details: vside: version filter for 'Translation Open'/'Version Open' -> [vside.replace('_',' ')]; client writes &vside= (panel 1) and &vside<i> for later panels, but server only reads base vside (BUG).
lookup: selectedWords for Lexicon sidebar; sbsq: sidebarSearchQuery (search-in-book sidebar); namedEntity / namedEntityText: selected named-entity slug/text for Lexicon.
BUG: client writes literal &sbsq{i}= (missing $) for later panels (ReaderApp.jsx:857-859).
SidebarSearch connection copies the parent panel's refs into the URL.

name: Aliyot param
summary: Torah books record whether aliyot (Torah portion divisions) are shown.
details: aliyot=1 -> aliyotOn, else aliyotOff override of panel settings.
Client writes &aliyot= only for Torah books (Sefaria.titleIsTorah: /^(Genesis|Exodus|Leviticus|Numbers|Deuteronomy)/).
BUG: at panel index 1, aliyot is appended to stale local url not hist.url (ReaderApp.jsx:816-818) so it is lost.
Per-panel aliyot<N>; shouldHistoryUpdate watches settings.aliyotTorah.
Canonical URL strips ?aliyot=0 along with default lang.

name: Version notes param (notes)
summary: A book-level URL with notes=1 opens the 'extended notes' page for a version.
details: notes=1 on a book-level ref -> menuOpen 'extended notes' with currVersions.
Client hist.url = '<Book>&notes[i]=1' (ReaderApp.jsx:544-549).

name: Menu tab param (tab)
summary: Pages with tabs (book TOC, topics, profile, collections) record the open tab in the URL.
details: Server: tab -> initialTab prop; used for book TOC tab (ReaderApp.jsx:111-113).
Client addTab appends &tab= for menu pages except search.
Defaults: topics 'notable-sources'; profile 'sheets'.
setTab on TabView mount uses replaceState.

name: Multiple panels in the URL (p<N> params)
summary: Side-by-side panels are encoded in the URL as numbered params so a multi-panel session can be shared.
details: p<N> (N>=2) = additional panel ref; p<N>=search -> search panel; invalid refs silently skipped.
Per-panel suffixed params: ven<N>/vhe<N>, w<N> (connections filter; all->[]), lang<N>, aliyot<N>, notes<N>, lookup<N>, sbsq<N>, namedEntity<N>, namedEntityText<N>, vside (base only).
Search panel: q<N>, tab<N>, search_tab<N>, tpathFilters<N> via get_search_params; URL is search&q=...&tab=... with '=' replaced by '<N>='.
Client merge: Text/Sheet followed by Connections at i=1 -> short form /<ref>?...&with=<sources> (+ vside, lookup, namedEntity, sbsq, namedEntityText, debug_mode);
for i>=2 Connections -> &p<i>=<connections ref> + versions/lang/aliyot of preceding text panel.
Other panels -> &p<i+1>=... with every '=' in sub-URL suffixed by i+1; titles joined with 'and'.
BUG: sheet in non-first panel serializes p<N>=sheet&s<N>=... which server cannot parse (Ref('sheet') fails) -> panel dropped.
Final step: all '?' in URL -> %3F (refs with question marks), then first '&' -> '?'.
See SHL-066: the old numbering (a sidebar takes a slot) is now written as well as read.

name: Layout and debug params (mobile, embed, debug_mode)
summary: A few params force layout or developer modes.
details: mobile: presence forces single-panel/mobile layout (base_props multiPanel).
embed: template var EMBED -> body.embeded class; for sheets embed=1 -> legacy embed page.
debug_mode: _debug_mode prop; 'linker' enables linker debugging; client re-appends &debug_mode=linker to every URL; Sefaria.util.setLinkerAdminUrlParams sets with=LinkerAdmin&debug_mode=linker.
Params not parsed server-side by the reader: sidebarLang, layout, filter, mode, qh (do not exist).

name: Cookie, tracking and chatbot params
summary: Utility params change cookies, applink behavior, chatbot version or profile output.
details: set-language-cookie: see Language domains.
no_applink=1: stripped on load by client.jsx:12-18; added to redirects by WebSessionRedirectMiddleware.
chatbot_version=<int>|clear: stored in session, swaps chatbot script to https://<n>.ai-server.coolifydev.sefaria.org/... (context_processors.py:148-172).
prof[&sort=]: DEBUG only cProfile output.

name: Other page params (login/next, activity, topic, profile)
summary: Non-reader pages have small param conventions.
details: next on /login, /register, /logout, /interface/*, /enable-library-assistant, /gauth (validated); /register?educator=1; welcome forwarded.
/activity*: type, api. /linker-editor: book. /visualize/links-through-rashi: level.
/collections/<slug>: tag, tab. /topics/<slug>: tab, sort. /profile/<slug>, /my/profile: tab.
/sheets-with-ref/<tref>: search filter/sort/field params with prefix 's' (ReaderApp.jsx:530-537).
Legacy new?assignment= appears in register next.

name: Query parameters rewritten on load (aliyot=0, lang2)
summary: After load the old reader rewrites the address bar's query string: Torah pages gain aliyot=0, and opening the sidebar adds lang2 (the sidebar's language).
details: VERIFIED 2026-10-04: /Genesis.1?lang=en → /Genesis.1?lang=en&aliyot=0 (~0.7s after load); /Genesis.1.3-5?lang=en&with=all → …&lang2=bi then &lang2=en.
Not ported: these are defaults written back into the URL, they add no information and make shared links noisy. The rebuild reads both parameters but only writes them when the reader changes them.

name: URL generation per panel type (makeHistoryState)
summary: Every panel state is turned into a URL and title, so each screen is addressable.
details: Auth: {state:{showAuth,authPath,authSource,panels:[]}, url:authPath}.
navigation -> /texts[/<cats>]; voices -> /; sheetsWithRef -> /sheets-with-ref/<encodeURIComponent(en ref)> + 's' search params; book toc -> /<Book_Title>; extended notes -> /<Book>&notes[i]=1.
search -> /search&q=<enc>&tab=<text|sheet>&search_tab=<tab> + t/s filter params; topics -> /topics/<slug> (or /topics/<testVersion>/<slug>) + &sort=, /topics/category/<cat>, /topics;
allTopics -> /topics/all/<letter>.
profile -> /profile/<slug>; collection -> /collections/<slug>&tag=; editCollection -> /collections/<slug>/settings or /collections/new; collectionsPublic -> /collections;
translationsPage -> /translations/<slug>; sheets -> /; updates -> /updates; linkerEditor -> /linker-editor&book=; user_stats -> /torahtracker; notes -> /texts/notes;
also notifications, calendars, modtools, saved, history.
Text panel: URL ref = highlighted range if it overlaps currentlyVisibleRef else currentlyVisibleRef, via Sefaria.normRef; &aliyot= for Torah; currVersions -> ven/vhe.
Connections panel: sources = WebPage:<filter> or filter list/sidebar mode/'all' with ' ConnectionsList' suffix; adds versionFilter, SidebarSearch query, Lexicon words/entity.
TextAndConnections (mobile) -> /<ref>?with=<sources>.
Sheet panel 0 -> /sheets/<id>[.<node>].
No panels (headerMode over static page): URL = current path + query; title = document.title.

name: Push vs replace history behavior
summary: Browser history only gets a new entry for meaningful navigation; scrolling and refinements quietly update the current entry.
details: Called from componentDidMount with replace=true and from every componentDidUpdate; skipped right after popstate (justPopped).
shouldHistoryUpdate compares to history.state: showAuth/authPath, panel count, mode, menuOpen, bookRef, last ref, highlightedRefs, filter, connectionsMode, connectionData, currVersions, searchQuery,
tab, topicSort, collectionName/Tag, linkerEditorBook, search filters/field/sort, settings.language, settings.aliyotTorah, navigationTopicCategory, navigationTopic, navigationCategories,
highlightedNode, sheet title availability.
BUG: versionFilter check calls prev.versionFilter(next.versionFilter) as a function and keys off next.mode (never 'Translation Open') (ReaderApp.jsx:447).
Push never pushes an identical URL; then trackPageview. Title set via $('title').html(hist.title).
Replace used for: scroll/infinite load (updateTextColumn), currentlyVisibleRef change, setTextListHighlight/setFocusedText, collection name load, language option change,
ref normalization in TextRange, mobile TextAndConnections focus changes, setTab on TabView mount, Linker Admin params, SearchPage programmatic tab.
On replace with changed URL, delayed (3s) intent analytics.
Client preserves location.hash on push/replace.

BUG (VERIFIED 2026-10-05): selecting a verse adds TWO history entries — /Genesis.1.2?lang=en&with=all, then the same URL with &lang2=en appended (a second push). One Back press therefore lands on the same view with the sidebar still open. Loading a Torah page likewise rewrites the URL (&aliyot=0, RTE-064), costing another entry. The rebuild adds one entry per choice and never rewrites the URL after load.

name: Back/forward and scroll restoration
summary: Using the browser back button restores previous panels, search state and scroll position.
details: Scroll position persisted into history.state.scrollPosition (300ms debounce) and restored on pop.
handlePopState: restores panels (re-hydrating SearchState objects), labels search-analytics source 'back_click' when popping into search, deep-clones panels.
VERIFIED 2026-10-05: after Back/Forward the text column's scrollTop is restored from history state (643 after returning from a later scroll position).

Rebuild: each history entry remembers every panel's place as a segment ref plus its offset from the column top (not a raw scrollTop, which is meaningless once the column holds different sections); saved at every history change while the page being left is still on screen, kept in sessionStorage, restored before paint on Back/Forward. Back to a different text starts a new column for it.

name: In-app link interception (openURL)
summary: Clicking a link inside the app navigates within the app instead of reloading, for known internal paths.
details: Global click handler on .readerApp; in headerMode on all <a> outside React.

Modifier clicks (cmd/ctrl/shift/alt) left to browser, but data-target-module links are first rewritten to the right subdomain and search-result clicks reported; right-click also rewrites module links.
Skips: default-prevented, legacy S1 sheet builder (sjs defined), non-_self target, missing href.
Mobile: every link replaces the panel; desktop: links inside .sheetItem open a new panel at end.
Unsaved sheet-editor changes -> confirm() before navigating.
External hosts or data-target-module != active module -> window.open(_blank).
Handled in-app: /, /texts, /history, /saved, /texts/notes, /texts/<cats>, /collections, /my/profile[?tab], /notifications, /calendars, /torahtracker, /linker-editor[?book], /sheets/<id>, /topics,
/topics/category/<c>, /topics/all/<l>, /topics/<slug>, /profile/<slug>[?tab], /collections/<slug>[?tag], /translations/<slug>, any ref (ven/vhe from params, ranged refs highlighted).
Not handled (full page load): /search?..., /sheets-with-ref, /collections/new, static pages.

name: Bootstrap URL event and settings-updated event
summary: External code like the chatbot can steer the app through DOM events.
details: sefaria:bootstrap-url: external code navigates the app; refs go through handleNavigationClick.
BUG: passes {replaceHistory} as panel options rather than the replace flag (ReaderApp.jsx:1299), likely ineffective.
sefaria:settings-updated updates translation preference, reading-history flag, calendars.

name: Panel open/close operations and widths
summary: Opening and closing panels follows rules that change the URL and layout.
details: openPanel/openPanelAt: book title -> book toc panel; 'Sheet <id>[:<node>]' -> sheet panel; commentary->base conversion; spanning arrays.
openTextListAt (connections panel; never bilingual); openComparePanel (menuOpen navigation, compare:true).
closePanel closes following Connections/compare; last panel -> showRoot (voices home or library TOC).
Widths: Text/Sheet + Connections|search|compare = 68/32%; 3-panel layouts 37/26/37 or 37/37/26; else even split, min panel width 360px with horizontal scroll and auto-scroll to newly opened panel.

name: Language-domain redirect
summary: A user whose language does not match the language-specific domain is bounced to the other-language domain.
details: If host is pinned to a language (current_domain_lang; ambiguous hosts like localhost unpinned) and differs from interface language: humans 302 to the same module on the other-language domain with
?set-language-cookie.
LanguageCookieMiddleware on target sets interfaceLang cookie (cookie domain = language's common suffix), saves to profile, redirects to same URL minus the param.
Crawlers/bots get the domain's language with no redirect: Googlebot, Bingbot, Slurp, DuckDuckBot, Baiduspider, YandexBot, Facebot, facebookexternalhit, ia_archiver, Sogou, python-request, curl, Wget,
sefaria-node.

PROBE NOTE 2026-10-05: an automated visit to www.sefaria.org from this machine was redirected to www.sefaria.org.il with a Hebrew interface (geo/language domain redirect); set the interfaceLang=english cookie for www.sefaria.org to keep English.

name: Regex anchoring quirks in URL patterns
summary: Several URL patterns accept typos or lack end anchors.
details: ^contest?... redirect effective for typos; ^jfn?$ matches /jf and /jfn; ^settings/account?$, ^activity/leaderboard?$, ^api/texts/random?$ allow a missing last letter;
^my/profile and ^[nN]echama/? have no end anchor; visualize/unique-words-by-commentator regex has no $.

name: Reader URL parsing gaps (client/server mismatch)
summary: Some URL params the client writes are never read by the server, so they are lost on reload.
details: vside<N>, sbsq{i}, aliyot at i==1, and p<N>=sheet panels are written but not parsed server-side.
Direct URL load of commentary refs (Rashi on Genesis 1:1:1) is not converted to base text + filter on the server.
Hash/legacy params emitted by old code (?editor=1, #onload=exportToDrive) are not consumed by the React app (except afterLoading).

name: Sidebar mode in URL (with= param)
summary: Sidebar state is encoded in the URL so a specific tool, filter or category can be shared or opened in a new tab.
details: makeHistoryState sidebarModes: Sheets, Notes, Translations, Translation Open, Version Open, About, AboutSheet, Navigation, WebPages, extended notes, Topics, Torah Readings, manuscripts, Lexicon, SidebarSearch, Guide, LinkerAdmin.
with= carries joined filter ('+' separated), the mode name if a sidebar mode, or 'all'; ConnectionsList appends ' ConnectionsList'; WebPagesList written 'WebPage:<site>'.
Extra params: vside (version filter), lookup (selected words), namedEntity, namedEntityText, sbsq (sidebar search query), debug_mode=linker, lang2 (sidebar language).
Panels after the first use w{i}, vside{i}, lookup{i}, namedEntity{i}, namedEntityText{i}, sbsq{i}.
BUG: sbsq{i} written without '$' (`&sbsq{i}=`) so sidebar search query lost for panels after the first (ReaderApp.jsx:858).
BUG: server reads 'vside' instead of 'vside{i}' for panels 2+ (reader/views.py:881).
Page title: '<ref> with <mode/filter>' unless value is 'all' or a ConnectionsList.

Server get_connections_mode/make_panel_dict: 'with' ignored in voices module; with=all -> empty filter; '_' -> space; sidebar-mode names delete the filter; 'X ConnectionsList' sets connectionsCategory; 'WebPage:x' sets webPagesFilter; lang2 sets connections language; highlightedRefs/showHighlight set when filter present.
Tools buttons are real <a href=replaceUrlParam('with',mode)> so ctrl-click opens that mode in a new tab; category/text filters link to /<ref>?with=<Category> ConnectionsList or ?with=<Book>.
When writing history, SidebarSearch panel's refs overwritten with previous panel's refs.

name: Commentary URL converts to base text plus filter
summary: Opening a commentary ref from inside the app (a link, a citation, search) — e.g. Rashi on Genesis 1:1:4 — shows the base text with that commentator selected in the sidebar. Loading the commentary's URL directly does not convert.
details: Converted to base text + filter:['Rashi'], filterRef, connectionsMode 'TextList', connectionsCategory 'Commentary'.
Desktop opens two panels; mobile opens TextAndConnections.
Commentary click from sidebar Open button does NOT convert (handleTextListClick).

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: direct page loads never convert — /Rashi_on_Genesis.1.1.4 and /Tosafot_on_Berakhot.2a.1.1 open the commentary as its own text (server-built panels skip openPanelAt). Earlier wording ('Opening a commentary URL…') implied they did.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: an in-app click on /Rashi_on_Genesis.1.1.4 → /Genesis.1.1?lang=en&with=Rashi (Genesis 1:1 highlighted, Commentary sidebar); /Tosafot_on_Berakhot.2a.1.1 → /Berakhot.2a.1?with=Tosafot; /Rashi_on_Genesis.1.1 (depth 2) and /Mishnah_Berakhot.1.1 open as themselves. All open panels are replaced (openURL → openPanel).

name: Dead handleAppClick analytics handler
summary: An old root click handler for analytics exists but nothing calls it.
details: DEAD: handleAppClick calls this.eventIsAnalyticsEvent and this.handleAnalyticsEvent, neither defined; root onClick is handleInAppLinkClick.

name: Vestigial Beit Midrash / chat remnants
summary: Leftover code from the retired Beit Midrash presence/chat feature remains in the shell.
details: DEAD: socket.io-client io imported but never used (ReaderApp.jsx:40).
DEAD: state.beitMidrashStatus only read for panel-box width calc(width - 330px); nothing sets it (2553).
DEAD: generateCurrentlyReading() / getDisplayString() unused (2178-2202).

name: Unused rerender and undefined panel props
summary: Several props passed to the reader panel point at functions that do not exist.
details: DEAD: rerender() unused (ReaderApp.jsx:2337).
BUG: toggleSheetEditMode, openSidePanel, openDisplaySettings passed as props but never defined (ReaderPanel.jsx:1119,1131,1186); openSidePanel isRequired in ReaderControls propTypes.
BUG: ReaderControls gets hasSidebar from this.state.hasSidebar, which never exists (it is a prop), so openTextConnectionsPanel's 'already open' guard always passes (ReaderPanel.jsx:1185,1310).
DEAD: ReaderPanel.componentWillReceiveProps reads nextProps.searchQuery/initialMenu which ReaderApp never passes; menuOpen set undefined then overwritten by initialState (ReaderPanel.jsx:88-93).
BUG: TopicPageAll receives typo'd prop intiialWidth (ReaderPanel.jsx:1040).
DEAD: showBaseText={props.onNavTextClick || this.showBaseText}; ReaderApp never passes onNavTextClick (1010).

name: History-state bugs (URL building)
summary: Several defects in how panel state is serialized to URLs would be copied by a literal port.
details: BUG: shouldHistoryUpdate calls prev.versionFilter(next.versionFilter) (array as function) at ReaderApp.jsx:447; branch effectively dead since Translation/Version Open are connectionsModes.
BUG: makeHistoryState emits '&sbsq{i}=' missing '$', so URL contains literal {i} (ReaderApp.jsx:858).
BUG: in the 2-panel short-form URL, aliyot is appended to url instead of hist.url so it is dropped (ReaderApp.jsx:816-818).
BUG: didDefaultPanelSettingsChange returns undefined (falsy) when settings exist but nothing changed (1564-1578).

name: Missing/phantom hooks and events
summary: Some documented hooks have no counterpart in the repo.
details: No dispatcher for the 'sefaria:bootstrap-url' DOM event exists in the repo (listener at ReaderApp.jsx:230,1246; comment says 'Route bot refs'); 'sefaria:settings-updated' is dispatched by templates/account_settings.html:318.
No beforeunload handler; unsaved-editor protection uses only window.confirm on in-app navigation/panel close.
No text-to-speech in the shell.
No global hotkeys other than Esc (close panel), Tab detection, menu/radio key handling.
ReaderNavigationMenuCloseButton does not exist; equivalent is CloseButton with class readerNavMenuCloseButton (Misc.jsx:1233-1263).

name: Color theme (light/dark/sepia) hooks
summary: Panels carry a color theme class read from a cookie, but no UI lets readers change it.
details: settings.color defaults to 'light'; applied as CSS class on each panel (ReaderPanel.jsx:1159); read from cookie server-side (reader/views.py:362).
DEAD: no current UI changes color; dark/sepia exist only as cookie/CSS hooks.

name: Reading settings defaults
summary: Reading preferences start from sensible defaults, overridden by the user's saved cookies.
details: Precedence: panel state, then props.initialSettings, then hard-coded defaults (ReaderApp.jsx:975-994).

Defaults: language bilingual, layoutDefault segmented, layoutTalmud continuous, layoutTanakh segmented, aliyotTorah aliyotOff, vowels all, punctuationTalmud punctuationOn, biLayout stacked, color light, fontSize 62.5.
Server initialSettings come from cookies with same defaults; language from request.contentLang (reader/views.py:353-363).

name: Settings persistence in cookies
summary: Reading choices are remembered across visits.
details: setOption writes every option to a cookie of the same name: $.cookie(option, value, {path:'/'}) (ReaderPanel.jsx:547).
language also writes the contentLang cookie, sets replaceHistory=true and calls setDefaultOption so NEW panels inherit the language.
Layout option name remapped to category-specific key via getLayoutCategory(): layoutTanakh/layoutTalmud for those primary categories, else layoutDefault (526-529).
Any option other than fontSize closes the display settings menu (displaySettingsOpen=false).

name: Font size stepping
summary: Readers can enlarge or shrink text in geometric steps.
details: fontSize: 'smaller' divides by 1.15, 'larger' multiplies by 1.15 (ReaderPanel.jsx:530-549); menu stays open on font change (FontSizeButton.jsx).

name: New panels inherit display settings
summary: Opening another panel keeps the reader's current display choices.
details: When a panel's settings differ from defaults, setPanelState copies them into defaultPanelSettings (ReaderApp.jsx:1559-1561,1564-1578); setDefaultOption updates a single key (1716-1721).

VERIFIED 2026-10-06 on sefaria.org (scripts/probes/multipanel-probe*.mjs, scripts/parity-panels.mjs): a new panel takes the reader's default language (the last one set), not the language of the panel it was opened from: the citation's panel is lang2=bi beside a lang=en panel. The rebuild's new panels write the stored setting (UrlDefaults).

name: Effective layout resolution
summary: The layout actually used depends on language, panel width, panel type and category.
details: currentLayout() (ReaderPanel.jsx:637-645): bilingual -> biLayout if panel width > 500 else 'stacked'; Connections panels always 'segmented' (no continuous in sidebar); else category-specific layout key.

name: Auto bilingual layout flip for same-direction texts
summary: When both languages run the same direction, side-by-side layout flips automatically.
details: When bilingual and not stacked and loaded data's primary/translation directions are equal (both rtl or both ltr) and differ from before, biLayout becomes heRight (primary rtl) or heLeft (ReaderPanel.jsx:113-126).

name: Content-language override by context
summary: Menus and sidebars show content in a language suited to the interface, not the text setting.
details: getContentLanguageOverride (ReaderPanel.jsx:145-161): menus topics/allTopics/calendars/collection -> bilingual for English interface, hebrew for Hebrew interface.
Other open menus, or Connections panel not in TextList mode: hebrew interface -> hebrew; english interface -> english if bilingual else original language.
Result becomes ReaderPanelContext.language.

name: Sidebar panels never bilingual
summary: Connections panels show a single language even if the text is bilingual.
details: openTextListAt coerces Connections panels to hebrew/english (ReaderApp.jsx:1861).
Opening a text from a Connections panel while master is bilingual restores bilingual (ReaderPanel.jsx:270-274).

name: Non-Torah site forces English in library menu
summary: On white-label deployments without Torah-specific mode, the Library menu opens in English.
details: showLibrary forces english language when !Sefaria._siteSettings.TORAH_SPECIFIC (ReaderApp.jsx:2010-2012).

name: Link language override when following links
summary: Links inside translation pages carry their own language into the opened text.
details: openURL(..., overrideContentLang=true) maps lang=bi/en/he into default language; used for links inside .translationsPage (ReaderApp.jsx:1368-1372,1235).

name: Display options dropdown container
summary: A text-display options button in the panel header opens a dropdown of reading settings.
details: Opened from DisplaySettingsButton inside DropdownMenu(positioningClass='readerDropdownMenu') in ReaderControls right buttons (ReaderPanel.jsx:1463-1478); reads values from ReaderPanelContext.
Menu is role=dialog aria-label 'common.text_display_options', tabIndex -1, data-prevent-close so inside clicks do not close (ReaderDisplayOptionsMenu.jsx:122-131).
On mount focuses checked radio, else first enabled button/switch (100-104); arrow keys not propagated; Tab/Escape trapped via Util.trapFocusWithTab; close via document.body.click() (15-21,106-120).
Toggle rows are ToggleSwitchLine (checkbox role=switch, aria-labelledby).

name: Source / Translation / Both language toggle
summary: The settings menu lets readers choose source only, translation only, or both.
details: Shown when TORAH_SPECIFIC, or when text lacks Hebrew or English; on non-Torah sites hidden if both exist (showLangaugeToggle) (27-33,132-139).
Radios: Source (hebrew), Translation (english), Source with Translation (bilingual); bilingual option hidden in side panels (mode not Text/Sheet) (SourceTranslationsButtons.jsx:9,24-26).
Radio name/id suffixed with panelPosition for uniqueness.

name: Side-panel settings reduced to language only
summary: In sidebar panels the settings menu only offers the language toggle.
details: Panels whose mode is not Text and not Sheet show ONLY the language toggle; layout, aliyot, font, vowels, cantillation, punctuation hidden (ReaderDisplayOptionsMenu.jsx:24,140).

name: Settings menu show/hide rules per option
summary: Each option in the menu appears only when it applies to the text being read.
details: Layout buttons hidden when (width <= 600 and bilingual) or (Sheet and not bilingual) (43-46).
Aliyot toggle: only Genesis-Deuteronomy and Onkelos Genesis-Deuteronomy, not sheets; toggles aliyotTorah aliyotOn/Off (48-59); URL carries aliyot=0/1 for Torah refs (ReaderApp.jsx:686-688).
Vowels toggle: only if sample text (first leaf of he or text, for visible side) contains nikud [ְ-׃ׇ]; toggles vowels none/partial (70-78).
Cantillation toggle: only if sample contains te'amim [֑-֯]; disabled when vowels off; toggles partial/all (80-89). vowels is a 3-state setting all/partial/none.
Punctuation toggle: only when primary_category === 'Talmud' and source visible; toggles punctuationTalmud On/Off (91-98).

name: Layout buttons by language-direction state
summary: Layout choices offered depend on whether the text is mono- or bilingual and the text directions.
details: State: mono (not bilingual); mixed (primary and translation directions differ, or Sheet); bi-rtl (both rtl); bi-ltr (both ltr) (LayoutButtons.jsx; constants.js:1-13).
Options: mono continuous/segmented; bi-rtl stacked/heRight; bi-ltr stacked/heLeft; mixed stacked/heLeft/heRight.
Icons /static/icons/{state}-{option}.svg; mixed uses direction-aware names (beside-rtlltr etc.); sheets with no primary default to rtl; missing translation direction inferred as reverse (19-31).
Option key is biLayout when bilingual else layout (remapped by category). Labels: 'show text as a paragraph', 'segmented', 'stacked', 'rtl text right/left of ltr'.

name: Client entry and hydration
summary: The client app boots from server-rendered HTML and takes over the page.
details: client.jsx strips 'no_applink' query param via history.replaceState (14-18); inits Sentry with sample rates from remoteConfig.sentry (20-35); inits Django CSRF helper (40).
Uses ReactDOM.hydrate, or render when #appLoading placeholder exists (41-44).
With DJANGO_VARS.inReaderApp: renders full ReaderApp after Sefaria.unpackDataFromProps (45-50).

name: Header-only mode over static pages
summary: Static Django pages get the live header and nav; clicking into the app turns the page into the reader.
details: Without inReaderApp, ReaderApp renders in headerMode over a static page with multiPanel = window.width > 600 (client.jsx:52-63).
setSinglePanelState replaces all panels with one panel and sets headerMode:false - how a static page 'becomes' the app (ReaderApp.jsx:2076-2080).

setContainerMode (995-1014): with panels/auth: removes #s2.headerOnly, body overflow hidden, adds .inApp, removes .hasBannerMessage; else adds headerOnly, overflow auto, removes inApp; called on update, popstate and Banner close.
In headerMode, links on the static page outside React are bound to the same click handler via jQuery (220-224).
No panels in headerMode: current path/query preserved with mode 'Header' in history (771-782).

name: Render arbitrary components into containers
summary: The same bundle can render exported static-page components into designated containers.
details: client.jsx renders an exported component into DJANGO_VARS.containerId (66-71).

Exports: ReaderApp, sefariaSetup, unpackDataFromProps, loadServerData, EditCollectionPage, ContestLandingPage, PBSC2020/2021LandingPage, PoweredByPage, RambanLandingPage, EducatorsPage, DonatePage, WordByWordPage, JobsPage, TeamMembersPage, ProductsPage, SheetsLandingPage, NewsletterPage, UpdatesPanel (ReaderApp.jsx:2680-2702).

name: Server-side single vs multi-panel decision
summary: Mobile user agents get the single-panel reader; desktop gets multi-panel; ?mobile forces mobile.
details: multiPanel = !request.user_agent.is_mobile && 'mobile' not in request.GET (reader/views.py:347).
Client checks window.width > 600 in headerMode.

FOUND 2026-10-05: sefaria.org decides single-panel mode from the User-Agent, not the width — a desktop browser squeezed to 390px keeps desktop rules (text x=56, sort dropdown on the Books tab) while a phone UA gets the phone rules (text x=34, filter button). The rebuild decides by width (≤842px) and, for the 34px text padding, by a coarse pointer.

name: Reader app render tree and providers
summary: The shell wraps everything in providers and mounts header, panels, modals and notices in a fixed order.
details: StrapiDataProvider > AdContext.Provider(getUserContext()) > #readerAppWrap: skip link, InterruptingMessage, Banner(onClose=setContainerMode), GoogleOneTap (2583-2586).
Root div.readerApp has multiPanel/singlePanel + interface-{lang} classes and onClick=handleInAppLinkClick (2567-2570,2587).

Children: Header, optional ChatbotExperimentBanner, <main id=main role=main> with AuthPage (when showAuth) or .panelContainer > #panelWrapBox > .readerPanelBox*, optional lc-chatbot, SignUpModal, CookiesNotification.
BannerImpressionProbe rendered outside the root div.

name: Reader app props and defaults
summary: The shell is configured by server-supplied initial props describing what to open first.
details: Defaults: multiPanel true, headerMode false, interfaceLang 'english', initialPath '/', initialPanelCap 2 (2633-2678).

Props: initialRefs/Filter/Menu/Collection/CollectionData/Query, initialSearchTab/Filters/Field/SortType/FilterAggTypes, initialTopic/Profile/NavigationCategories/Settings/Panels/DefaultVersions, topicTestVersion, initialLinkerEditorBook, sheetsWithRef.

Also: initialTab, initialTopicSort, initialNavigationTopicCategory/Title/Letter, initialTopicTitle, initialCollectionName/Slug/Tag, initialTranslationsSlug, translationLanguagePreference, notificationCount, authResetUid/Valid, remoteConfig, chatbot_*, show_join_chatbot_banner, is_moderator, _debug.

name: App-level reader state
summary: The shell tracks all open panels plus shared state such as default versions and settings.
details: State: panels, headerMode, defaultVersions ({indexTitle:{lang:{versionTitle,languageFamilyName}}} cloned from initialDefaultVersions, 1707-1715), defaultPanelSettings, layoutOrientation (rtl for hebrew interface; drives left/right offsets and horizontal scroll), path, panelCap, windowWidth.

Also: initialAnalyticsTracked, showSignUpModal, modalContentKind, translationLanguagePreference, editorSaveState (set by sheet editor), notificationCount, showAuth/authPath/authSource, mobileNavMenuOpen.
DEAD: beitMidrashStatus (vestigial).
Instance fields: MIN_PANEL_WIDTH=360, _aboutSidebarPaths Set from Sefaria._siteSettings.ABOUT_SIDEBAR_PAGES, replaceHistory flag, justPopped, scroll-intent timers, _lastOpenURLNavigatedInApp.

name: Panel state model
summary: Every panel carries a standard set of fields describing what it shows and how.
details: mode: Text | TextAndConnections | Connections | Sheet | Menu ('SheetAndConnections' appears only in comments, not implemented).

Defaults: refs [], filter [], versionFilter [], connectionsMode 'Resources', connectionsCategory null, currVersions {en:null,he:null}, highlightedRefs [], highlightedNode null, scrollToHighlighted false, compare false, openSidebarAsConnect false, bookRef null.
currentlyVisibleRef ALWAYS reset to refs[0]; incoming value ignored (161); callers override later (1796). displaySettingsOpen always reset false.
recentFilters default to filter; recentVersionFilters default to versionFilter. filterRef keeps the full commentary ref (e.g. 'Rashi on Genesis 1:1:4') after commentary->base conversion.

Other fields: sheetID, sheetsWithRef {en,he}, nodeRef, navigationTopic/Title/Letter/Category, collectionName/Slug/Tag/Data, translationsSlug, searchQuery, showHighlight, searchState (type from active module), selectedWords, sidebarSearchQuery, selectedNamedEntity(+Text), textHighlights, profile, tab, topicSort, webPagesFilter, sideScrollPosition, topicTestVersion, connectionData (e.g. linker admin span, previousMode), linkerEditorBook.

Valid menuOpen values: navigation, voices, sheetsWithRef, book toc, extended notes, search, topics, allTopics, profile, notifications, collection, editCollection, collectionsPublic, translationsPage, calendars, sheets, updates, modtools, linkerEditor, user_stats, saved, history, notes, display (legacy).
Version auto-fill: on construction, if the visible language has no version set, currVersions[lang] filled from per-book defaultVersions cache (203-210).

ReaderPanel-local state: width (1000 multi / 500 single initially), backButtonSettings, data, forceGuideOverlay, error, noteBeingEdited, highlightedRefsInSheet, previousCategories (ReaderPanel.jsx:55-62).

name: Initial panel construction from server props
summary: On load, the shell reconstructs the full set of open panels from what the server sends.
details: If initialMenu set, panel[0] is a Menu panel populated from menu/search/topic/profile/collection/translations/linkerEditor props; searchState built from initial filters/field/aggTypes/sort with type by module (59-91).
initialPanels cloned and appended (95-96).
Language inference: panel without settings but with currVersions becomes bilingual (both), hebrew (he only) or english (en only) (98-105); settings merged onto defaults (106).
Any *AndConnections mode sets highlightedRefs = refs (108-110).
menuOpen 'book toc' gets tab = props.initialTab (known hack, 111-113).
initialMenu -> panel 0 {mode:'Menu', menuOpen, searchQuery, tab, topicSort, searchState (type: library->text, voices->sheet), sheetsWithRef, navigationCategories, navigationTopicCategory,
navigationTopic, navigationTopicTitle, navigationTopicLetter, topicTestVersion, profile, collectionName/Slug/Tag, translationsSlug, collectionData, linkerEditorBook}.
initialPanels cloned and appended; panels without settings but with versions infer language (both->bilingual, he->hebrew, en->english); *AndConnections panels set highlightedRefs=refs;
book toc panels get tab=initialTab.
Hard defaults: language bilingual, layoutDefault segmented, layoutTalmud continuous, layoutTanakh segmented, aliyotTorah aliyotOff, vowels all, punctuationTalmud punctuationOn, biLayout stacked,
color light, fontSize 62.5; overridden by initialSettings cookies.
Layout orientation rtl for Hebrew interface.
makePanelState defines the full panel schema (ReaderApp.jsx:148-212).

name: Text panel (reading column)
summary: The main reading mode: a scrolling text column for the current ref.
details: Renders TextColumn keyed by book title (changing books remounts, 752-796) with srefs, currVersions, highlightedRefs, currentlyVisibleRef, showHighlight = state.showHighlight || highlightedRefs.length > 1, basetext, withContext, loadLinks, prefetchNextPrev, settings clone, hasSidebar, filter, textHighlights, translationLanguagePreference, navigatePanel.
Callbacks: setOption, showBaseText, updateTextColumn, segment/citation/linker-admin/named-entity clicks, setTextListHighlight, setCurrentlyVisibleRef, setSelectedWords.

name: Sheet panel
summary: Source sheets open inside a reader panel.
details: Renders Sheet keyed by sheet id with highlightedNode, highlightedRefs, highlightedRefsInSheet, scrollToHighlighted, onSegmentClick, openSheet, setSelectedWords, contentLang, style(fontSize), historyObject, toggleSignUpModal, editor save state, showGuide (797-818).

name: Connections sidebar panel (shell wiring)
summary: The resources sidebar opens as its own panel next to the text.
details: Renders ConnectionsPanel (820-887) with srefs (refs in Connections mode, highlightedRefs in TextAndConnections), filter, connectionsMode, recentFilters, connectionsCategory, connectionData, contentLang, title, currVersions, fullPanel=multiPanel, allOpenRefs, canEditText.
canEditText true when hebrew version not locked (hebrew mode), english version not locked (english mode), or moderator and mode not bilingual (823-826).

Other props: scroll position, web pages filter, nodeRef, sheet click, openNav, note editing, handleTextListClick (opens without commentary->base conversion), selectedWords, sidebarSearchQuery, named entity, master panel layout/lang/mode, version filters, viewExtendedNotes('Connections'), setPreviousSettings, filterRef, backButtonSettings.

name: Menu panels (page-type routing in panel)
summary: The panel can show a full page (library, topics, collections, profile, etc.) instead of text; a menu replaces content.
details: navigation -> TextsPage (compare mode: openNav becomes openComparePanel, openTextTOC becomes openCompareTextTOC; keyed by categories) (889-907).
sheetsWithRef -> SheetsWithRefPage (search state; result click calls handleSheetClick) (908-917).

book toc -> BookPage (tab,setTab,close=closeMenus,title=bookRef,currVersions,settingsLanguage,category,compare w/ onCompareBack to navigation w/ previousCategories, narrowPanel=!multiPanel, selectVersion, showBaseText, viewExtendedNotes('toc')) (918-943).
extended notes (not Connections mode) -> BookPage extended-notes mode, back=backFromExtendedNotes (945-962).
search with non-empty searchQuery -> ElasticSearchQuerier; search with EMPTY query renders nothing (964-982).

topics -> TopicCategory (navigationTopicCategory) | TopicPage (navigationTopic; tab, sort, setTopic, setNavTopic, openSearch, translationLanguagePreference, topicTestVersion) | TopicsLandingPage (Library) | TopicsPage (Voices) (983-1034); allTopics -> TopicPageAll(letter) (1035-1048).

notifications -> NotificationsPanel(setUnreadNotificationsCount); collection -> CollectionPage (updateCollectionName replaces history); collectionsPublic -> PublicCollectionsPage; translationsPage -> TranslationsPage(slug); editCollection -> EditCollectionPage(collectionData).

user_stats -> UserStats (Torah Tracker); modtools -> ModeratorToolsPanel; linkerEditor -> LinkerEditorPage(initialBook,onBookChange); saved|history|notes -> UserHistoryPanel; voices -> SheetsHomePage; profile -> UserProfile(profile,tab); calendars -> CalendarsPage.
'sheets' and 'updates' have history URLs (627-636) but NO render branch in ReaderPanel; 'updates' is served by static UpdatesPanel export.
readerContent (fontSize style) wraps items only when no menu (1222-1225).

name: Panel error state
summary: If a panel fails, it shows a bilingual 'Something went wrong' message with the error text.
details: Rendered at ReaderPanel.jsx:715-731.

Strings (source): 'Something went wrong! Please use the back button or the menus above to get back on track.' / 'ארעה תקלה במערכת. אנא חזרו לתפריט הראשי או אחורנית על ידי שימוש בכפתורי התפריט או החזור.' then 'Error Message: ' / 'שגיאה: ' + the text. Not reproduced live (no safe way to make the live reader fail). Rebuild: the router's default error component (RouteError) with the same words and a Try again button.

name: Panel root element, classes and landmarks
summary: Each panel is an accessible region carrying classes that drive its look.
details: div.readerPanel role=region id=panel-{n} onKeyDown=handleKeyPress, data-anl-batch analytics JSON (1180-1181).

Classes: serif, narrowColumn (width<730), content language (hebrew/english/bilingual), current layout (segmented/continuous/stacked/heLeft/heRight), colour, rtl/ltr text-direction class when panel is monolingual or has no text (1156-1166).

name: Compare panel header
summary: Panels used to pick a second text have their own header with search and settings.
details: Search mode: back chevron (MenuButton compare), search input opening search on Enter or button, display settings dropdown NOT shown for Hebrew interface (ComparePanelHeader.jsx:19-43).
Category mode: colour line, back, category title (ContentText), display settings (hidden placeholder in Hebrew interface) (44-57).

name: Compare / 'other text' panel
summary: Readers can open a second text beside the first by picking it through a library browse flow.
details: openComparePanel(n,connectAfter) replaces panel n with 'navigation' menu panel with compare:true and openSidebarAsConnect; event 'Reader / Other Text Click' (1830-1839).
Triggered from setConnectionsMode('Add Connection') when only one text open (ReaderPanel.jsx:554-557) and ConnectionsPanel 'Other Text' control.

In compare panel: TextsPage back -> closePanel; selecting a book -> openCompareTextTOC (book toc w/ compare, remembering categories) (444-453,891-892); compare book TOC back returns to navigation with previous categories (919-924).
Compare close button runs convertToTextList: closes compare panel and reopens connections list for base highlight; for Sheet bases uses highlighted node's source ref (2469,1990-2006).

name: Panel cap and widths
summary: The number of visible side-by-side panels depends on window width; special ratios give text more room.
details: panelCap = floor(window.outerWidth/360), recomputed on resize (ReaderApp.jsx:1015-1024,216).
Panels <= cap: even percentage widths; more than cap: 360px each plus wrapBoxScroll with box width = windowWidth (2389-2417).
Special ratios: [Text|Sheet, Connections|search menu|compare] 68/32; [Text|Sheet, Connections, Text|Sheet] 37/26/37; [Text|Sheet, Text|Sheet, Connections] 37/37/26.
Each panel box absolutely positioned with left (LTR) or right (RTL) offset = sum of previous widths (2444-2446); class 'sidebar' for Connections panels (2485).
Panel React key = index + book title, so panels remount on shifting position or book change (2482-2484).
VERIFIED 2026-10-04 at 1600px: [Text, Connections, Text] = 592/416/592px (37/26/37); four text/sidebar panels = 400px each (cap = floor(1600/360) = 4).

name: Auto-scroll to newly added panel
summary: When panels overflow, the view scrolls horizontally to reveal a new panel.
details: When panels exceed cap and one was added: compute first changed index, scroll #panelWrapBox so new panel fully visible, RTL-aware (ReaderApp.jsx:280-308).
Rebuild: a panel that arrives beside the first is scrolled into view (inline: nearest) when the row of panels overflows; the browser handles right-to-left. Tested with six panels at 1280px.

name: Scrollbar-compensating padding
summary: Single-panel text stays centered under the header despite a scrollbar.
details: setPaddingForScrollbar: with one panel, .textColumn and .sheetsInPanel get paddingLeft = scrollbar width; multi-panel clears it; runs after each history update (ReaderApp.jsx:1025-1036).
ConnectionsPanelHeader.setMarginForScrollbar does the same for the connections header, RTL-aware (ConnectionsPanelHeader.jsx:30-40).

name: Panel width measurement
summary: Each panel measures itself so layout controls respond to its actual width.
details: ReaderPanel measures width on mount, resize and when layoutWidth changes (77-78,97-99,580-583); used for narrowColumn (<730), biLayout fallback (>500), layout toggle visibility (<=600).

name: Open text (replace all panels)
summary: Navigating from the header or a top-level link replaces the whole panel set with the new text.
details: openPanel(ref, currVersions, options, replaceHistory) clears this.state.panels directly then openPanelAt(0,...,replace=true) (ReaderApp.jsx:1722-1729); used by header ref navigation, mobile links and openURL.

name: Open panel at position
summary: A ref can open as a new panel after, or replace, an existing panel.
details: openPanelAt(n,ref,currVersions,options,replace,convertCommentaryRefToBaseRef=true,replaceHistory,saveLastPlace=true,forceOpenCommentaryPanel=false) (1730-1808).
ref is an index/book title -> menuOpen 'book toc' panel with bookRef = index.title.
ref parses to book 'Sheet' -> Sheet panel with sheetID and highlightedNode from sections.
Array refs: currentlyVisibleRef = normRef(array); highlightedRefs = split ranging refs of all entries; currentlyVisibleRef always humanized (1796).
Inserts at n+1, or replaces at n; a connection panel is appended at end of array (1799-1803); calls saveLastPlace if enabled (1805-1807).
openPanelAtEnd (1823-1825) used by openURL when replace=false; replacePanel(n,...) = openPanelAt with replace (1826-1829).

name: Commentary ref opens as base text plus commentary
summary: Opening 'Rashi on Genesis 1:1:4' shows Genesis 1:1 with Rashi alongside.
details: If Sefaria.isCommentaryRefWithBaseText(ref, force): split via getBaseRefAndFilter; ref 'Genesis 1:1', filter ['Rashi'], filterRef keeps full ref; showHighlight=true (1809-1821).
Multi-panel: pushes second Connections panel (connectionsMode TextList, connectionsCategory Commentary). Mobile: single panel in TextAndConnections with highlightedRefs = refs.
handleTextListClick opens without this conversion; compare-panel showBaseText does not convert (ReaderPanel.jsx:268).
VERIFIED 2026-10-05: in-app opens only; direct loads read the commentary as its own text (see RTE-063).

name: Segment click opens connections sidebar
summary: Clicking a text segment opens the resources sidebar for it.
details: handleSegmentClick(n,ref) multi-panel only (1052-1065): sets text-list highlight on panel n; does nothing more if any panel is in 'Add Connection' mode; else opens/updates Connections panel at n+1.
a11y: focuses first focusable element in new panel if no text selection and anchor node is not a text node.

ReaderPanel.handleBaseSegmentClick (170-182): TextAndConnections -> close connections; Text+multi-panel -> set showHighlight, open sidebar (event 'Reader / Open Connections Panel'); Text+mobile -> TextAndConnections.
onSegmentClick is null for mobile panels (ReaderApp.jsx:2447).

name: Open connections list at panel
summary: The sidebar panel is created or updated, inheriting filters and versions from its parent text.
details: openTextListAt(n,refs,textListState) (1840-1875): if panel n not Connections, splices a new one (saving last place for parent with sidebar=true).

Inherits from parent Text/Sheet: filter, versionFilter, recentFilters, recentVersionFilters, currVersions; connectionsMode 'Add Connection' if parent openSidebarAsConnect; language coerced non-bilingual; extra state (e.g. named entity) merged.
setTextListHighlight(n,refs) updates highlight and re-points next Connections panel (if no menu) at the refs (1876-1886).
openConnectionsInPanel replaces history when already TextAndConnections (222-230).

name: Close panel
summary: Closing panels cascades sensibly and the last close returns home.
details: closePanel(n) (1955-1989): n==0 with unsaved sheet editor changes asks confirm and aborts on cancel; last panel closing routes to showRoot() (library or voices home).
