details: Click a.namedEntityLink (TextRange.jsx:500-509): selects text, onNamedEntityClick(slug,sref,text) opens connections with connectionsMode Lexicon + selectedNamedEntity(+Text); desktop new/next panel; mobile in-panel; tracks 'Named Entity Link Click'.

Sefaria.getTopic(slug,{annotated:false}); each possibility title links to /topics/<slug> (new tab); three-dots tooltip: Jerusalem Talmud: '...by Sefaria', otherwise 'based on the research of Dr. Michael Sperling' (hard-coded, TODO).
timePeriod name + year range; description markdown or 'No description known for ...'; ambiguous entity intro '"<text>" could refer to one of the following:'.
New selected word clears named entity and vice versa; closeNamedEntityInConnectionPanel resets to Resources.

openNamedEntityInNewPanel -> openTextListAt(n+1,[ref],{connectionsMode:'Lexicon',selectedNamedEntity,selectedNamedEntityText}) (1089-1092; ReaderPanel.jsx:231-242); single-panel switches to TextAndConnections.
closeNamedEntityInConnectionPanel(n): when highlight changes, a named-entity sidebar resets to Resources (1071-1076; ReaderPanel.jsx:319-321).
closeConnectionPanel(n) closes n+1 if Connections (1066-1070).

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Berakhot 2a, English): clicking 'Rabbi Eliezer' selects the verse and the address becomes /Berakhot.2a.1?namedEntity=rabbi-eliezer-b-hyrcanus&namedEntityText=Rabbi Eliezer&with=Lexicon; the sidebar shows 'Rabbi Eliezer b. Hyrcanus' (link to /topics/<slug>, new tab) + 'Tannaim - Third Generation' + 'c.80 – c.110 CE' + the markdown description. Request: GET /api/v2/topics/<slug>?annotate_time_period=1&ref_link_type_filters=about|popular-writing-of&with_html=0&with_links=0&annotate_links=0&with_refs=0&group_related=0&with_indexes=0.

An ambiguous name's slug ends in '-(ambiguous)' (e.g. /topics/רג-(ambiguous)); the response then carries `possibilities` (Rabban Gamliel → three people) and the sidebar says '"Rabban Gamliel" could refer to one of the following:' / 'ייתכן ש-"…" מתייחס לאחד מהבאים:' above each. No description: "No description known for '<title>'" / "לא קיים מידע עבור '<title>'".

Rebuild: links in the text carry the library's absolute /topics URL (a modified click or a new tab works), a plain click opens the sidebar; choosing another verse ends the card (back to Resources). Params namedEntity, namedEntityText (+N per panel) in the workspace URL.

name: Topics for this ref
summary: Lists topics related to the selected passage with a short description and why it is connected.
details: Sefaria.topicsByRef de-dupes across expanded refs, aggregates dataSources, sorts by order.pr desc; null if nothing loaded; topics arrive in /api/related from get_topics_for_ref(annotate=True).
Empty: 'No known Topics Here.' / 'אין קשרים ידועים.'.
Item: link /topics/<slug> new tab, title en/he, three-dots tooltip 'This topic is connected to "<ref>" by <dataSources joined with &>', markdown description.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: Genesis 1:1 → Creation, "In the Beginning of" (the quotes are part of the title), Heavens, Creation of Heavens and Earth, Parashat Bereshit, Earth, Ai — seven, matching the Resources count; Berakhot 2a:1 → Laws of the Recitation of Shema, Laws of Blessings, Shema, Prayer, Priesthood… Each item: title link (/topics/<slug>, new tab), three-dots tooltip, markdown description. Header '‹ Resources'.

Data is the topics array of /api/related/<section>?with_sheet_links=1 (already loaded for the Resources counts): each entry carries title, description, dataSource and order.pr; one topic has several entries (one per data source), merged and ordered by order.pr descending. No extra request.
Rebuild a11y: description links are underlined (axe link-in-text-block); the three dots are an icon with the note as its accessible name.
VERIFIED geometry of the Topics view: names 18px black serif; descriptions 13px/18px #666 with plain blue links; a 22px #ededec round button with three dots; rows ruled. Rebuilt.

VERIFIED geometry of the Topics view: names 18px black serif; descriptions 13px/18px #666 with plain blue links; a 22px #ededec round button with three dots; rows ruled. Rebuilt; deliberate difference: links in the descriptions keep an underline (live has colour alone, which fails WCAG 1.4.1).

name: Add topic to ref (moderator)
summary: Moderators can tag a text reference with a topic, or create a new topic, from the sidebar.
details: Only when masterPanelMode==='Text': TopicSearch autocompleter over Sefaria.getName(word,undefined,['Topic']) top 4 + 'Create a new topic: <word>'.
Input must match a suggestion exactly else alert 'Please select an option through the dropdown menu.'.
Selecting runs Sefaria.postRefTopicLink -> POST /api/ref-topic-links/<ref> (moderator-only); pushes link into _refTopicLinks for each sref and section; alert 'Topic added.'.
'Create new topic' opens inline TopicEditor prefilled with title; on success the topic is linked.
Server topic_ref_api supports GET, DELETE, POST staff only; link type 'popular-writing-of' for author topics else 'about' (reader/views.py:3864-3891).
TopicSearch uses Autocompleter; getName(word, undefined, ['Topic']); top 4 results plus last row '<createNewTopicStr><word>'.
Selection must exactly match a name case-insensitively else alert('Please select an option through the dropdown menu.').
Valid -> Sefaria.postRefTopicLink(normRef(srefs), {topic, interface_lang}); pushes link into Sefaria._refTopicLinks for each sref and section ref; update(); alert('Topic added.').
'Create new' opens TopicEditor with origEnTitle; onCreateSuccess posts link.
BUG: await Sefaria.getRef(...).sectionRef awaits a property of a promise, so section-ref cache key is undefined.
Placeholder 'Search for a Topic', button 'Add Topic'. Text mode only.

name: Add private note on a ref
summary: Signed-in users can write a private note attached to the selected passage.
details: Notes button opens SignUp modal when logged out; AddNoteBox shows LoginPrompt when logged out.

Textarea 'Write a note…' auto-focused; 'Add Note'; empty text ignored; POST /api/notes/ {json:{text,refs,type:'note',public:!isPrivate}}; server squashes refs into one ranged ref; isPrivate defaults true.
Success: Sefaria.addPrivateNote (or clearPrivateNotes when editing), track 'Note Save Private/Public', clear textarea, onSave -> mode Notes; errors via alert.
Optional 'layer' posting creates 'discuss' notifications; POST/update goes through tracker with API-key support.
Signed-out behaviour verified (modal). The note editor itself is not built (needs accounts).

name: My notes for these refs
summary: Shows the user's existing notes on the selected passage with a link to all notes.
details:
Sefaria.privateNotes(srefs,cb) GET /api/notes/?private=1 per unloaded ref; each rendered as Note (linkified, newlines ->
) with edit pencil.
'Go to My Notes' links to /texts/notes; note count on Notes button = notesTotalCount (public not mine + mine).

BUILT 2026-10-07 (src/ui/NotesView, src/lib/user/notes.ts): signed in, the Notes tool shows a box (Add Note), Go to My Notes (Django's /texts/notes) and the reader's notes on the selected verses — GET /api/notes/<ref>?private=1 per verse, combined — each with a pencil to edit (Save / Cancel / Delete Note); POST /api/notes/ json={text, refs, type:'note', public:false[, _id]}; DELETE /api/notes/<id>. Notes are private (public notes are off on sefaria.org). The Tools row counts them. Note: the server's DELETE has no ownership check and no CSRF (legacy security issue, reader/views.py notes_api, sefaria/tracker.py:301-319) — reported, not changed here.

name: Edit and delete note
summary: Users can edit or delete a note from the sidebar.
details: Edit pencil -> editNote -> mode 'Edit Note' with prefilled textarea, Save, Cancel, Delete Note.
Delete: confirm, Sefaria.deleteNote DELETE /api/notes/<id>, clears private-notes cache, tracks 'Delete Note'; every action returns to Notes mode.

name: Public notes (disabled)
summary: Sharing notes publicly is switched off; all notes are private.
details: /api/related always returns notes: [] ('Hiding public notes for now', reader/views.py:2632).
DEAD: PublicNotes component defined (ConnectionsPanel.jsx:1426-1448) but never rendered.
DEAD: public/private toggle in AddNoteBox commented out (ConnectionsPanel.jsx:1355-1366).

name: Web pages citing this text
summary: Lists external websites that cite the selected passage, grouped by site.
details: Not in /api/related; GET /api/related/<ref>/websites per segment ref (section expanded to segments, ranges split, loaded refs skipped); server returns [] when remote config ENABLE_WEBPAGES off (reader/views.py:2643-2654).
States 'Loading web pages...', load error or 'Unable to load web pages.', 'No web pages known [from <site>] here.'.
Sites view grouped by siteName with favicon, name, count; sorted interface-language sites first then count; click sets filter (URL with=WebPage:<site>); keyboard accessible.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Berakhot 2a:1): 516 pages in 31 sites — Halachipedia (145), Torat Har Etzion (120), Orthodox Union (OU Torah) (48), Times of Israel Blogs (28), Hadran (21)… then the Hebrew sites (פרויקט בן-יהודה (48), סִינַי (19)…); footer 'Sites that are listed here use the Sefaria Linker'. For Genesis 1:1 the live view stays on 'Loading web pages...'.

BUG (vendored toolkit, not the old site): the generated response contract for /api/related/<ref>/websites required authors and articleSource to be strings, but the API sends null (and arrays/objects when present), so every response failed validation. Fixed in vendor/sefaria-toolkit (docs/VENDOR.md).

name: Web page list items
summary: Each web page shows its title, source, authors and the passage it cites.
details: Pages sorted by interface-language match, fewer anchorRefExpanded first, non-range before range, linkerHits desc (webPagesByRef, memoised _processedWebpages).

WebPage item: favicon, title link (new tab), domain, description, authors ('Last, First' reversed, joined with commas and 'and'/' ו'), article source with related_parts, 'Citing: <localized anchor ref>'; Hebrew pages get class 'hebrew'.
Sorting verified through the site order above and the old code (interface-language pages first, fewer anchor verses, single verses before ranges, Linker hits).

name: Linker promo in web pages view
summary: A footer invites sites to use the Sefaria Linker.
details: When TORAH_SPECIFIC footer 'Sites that are listed here use the Sefaria Linker' links to /linker.
VERIFIED 2026-10-05: the Linker footer is present on the sites list.

name: Add selected source to a sheet
summary: Users can add the selected passage (or a connected passage) to one of their sheets or a new sheet from the sidebar.
details: Entry points: Tools 'Add to Sheet' (addSource mainPanel; uses srefs, currObjectVersions, selectedWords, nodeRef when main panel is a sheet); per-link button (connectionsPanel; connectionRefs/versions, no selected words); NoteListing modal AddToSourceSheetWindow; global Sefaria.AddToSourceSheetWindow for legacy Gardens.

UI: 'Selected Citation' joined ref list en/he or '<sheet title>, Section #n (refs)' for sheet node; 'Add to' dropdown of user's sheets most recent first, default first sheet or 'Create a New Sheet' if none.
Dropdown is accessible listbox: Arrow/Home/End navigate, Enter/Space select, Escape closes, focus management, scrolls focused option into view.
New sheet: name input + 'Create' POST /api/sheets/ {title, options:{numbered:0}, sources:[]} then selects it.
Logged out: SignUp modal; no sheet selected: abort.
POST /api/sheets/<id>/add {source: JSON, note?}; sheet node in main panel copied with POST /api/sheets/<id>/copy_source {sheetID,nodeID}.

Confirm '<ref link> has been added to <sheet link>.' with data-target-module links; tracks 'Add to Source Sheet Save'; updates user-sheets cache; BroadcastChannel('refresh-editor').postMessage('refresh') refreshes open sheet editor; confirmation resets when srefs/nodeRef change.
Signed-out behaviour verified (modal). The Add to Sheet flow is not built (needs accounts).

name: Add to sheet: version and partial-selection handling
summary: When adding to a sheet, the right version text is used and a highlighted portion is trimmed precisely.
details: Version handling: both versions same direction -> two separate sources posted (handleSameDirectionVersions); otherwise en/he swapped when directions reversed; source gets version-he/version-en.

Partial selection (words highlighted and panel not bilingual): sheetsUtils.getSegmentObjs fetches segments; first segment trimmed to longest suffix that is prefix of selection, last to longest prefix that is suffix; '...' ellipses; text set for that language only (AddToSourceSheet.jsx:194-223).
Images unsupported: alert 'We do not currently support adding images to source sheets.' when any ref text is a full-segment image (l.266-276).

name: Google Docs extension promo in Add to Sheet
summary: A promo box in Add to Sheet advertises the Sefaria Google Docs extension.
details: GDocAdvertBox 'new Google Docs extension' with Install Now; hidden once gdoc_installed cookie set; tracks impressions and clicks (Promotions.jsx:114-145).

name: Legacy Gardens add-to-sheet path
summary: Old Gardens hook that no longer works.
details: BUG: AddToSourceSheetBox.makeSourceForEden references undeclared 'source' (AddToSourceSheet.jsx:180-192); legacy Gardens path only.

name: Torah Readings (audio clips)
summary: Plays recorded audio readings of the selected passage with a custom player.
details: Data Sefaria.mediaByRef from /api/related media (server get_media_for_ref); title 'Torah Reading'/'קריאה בתורה'.

Per clip: source title and description en/he; custom player with play/pause, elapsed / clip length (m:ss), range slider start_time..end_time; <audio> src uses #t=start,end fragment, preloads metadata, seeks to start on load; stops and resets to start when playback passes clip end.
License line (Hebrew label typo 'עסק רשיון') and source link.
BUG: empty state shows 'Loading…' forever instead of an empty message (Media.jsx:32-35).
BUG: play/pause icons use relative path static/img/play.svg (Media.jsx:129) which breaks on nested URLs.
VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Genesis 1:1): 'Torah Reading / קריאה בתורה', PocketTorah / "פוקט"-תורה, the description, a player reading '0:00 / 0:06', License: CC-BY-SA, Source: PocketTorah.

Rebuild fixes: the empty state says so instead of 'Loading…' forever; the Hebrew licence label is 'רשיון' (the old 'עסק רשיון' is a typo); the play button is a labelled button, not an image input with a relative path.

name: Manuscripts for this ref
summary: Shows thumbnails of manuscript pages that contain the selected passage.
details: Data from /api/related manuscripts (ManuscriptPageSet.load_set_for_client); GET /api/manuscripts/<ref> exists (reader/views.py:5392-5398) but client does not use it.

Item: thumbnail linking to full image (new tab); caption manuscript title in interface language; 'Location: <page_id with _ -> spaces>'; 'Courtesy of: <description/he_description>'; license linking to license map; 'Source: <host>'.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Genesis 1:1): one card — thumbnail (links to the full image), 'Leningrad Codex (1008 CE)', 'Location: LC Folio 1v', 'Courtesy of: Bruce Zuckerman, West Semitic Research…', 'Source: dornsife.usc.edu'. Rebuild adds an empty-state message ('No manuscripts known here.').

name: Share link and social options
summary: Users can copy a link to the current view or share it by Facebook, X or email.
details: Share Link: input with window.location.href; copy via navigator.clipboard, fallback execCommand('copy'); mobile selection range set.
More Options: Facebook sharer, X (twitter.com/share?url=), Email mailto:?&subject=Text on Sefaria&body=<url>; all open new tab.
DEAD: sheet-collaboration code (sheetID loads sheet and re-POSTs /api/sheets/ with options.collaboration on shareValue change); ConnectionsPanel never passes sheetID.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Genesis 1:1): the Share view has sections 'Share Link' / 'שיתוף קישור' (a box with the full current address — it includes with=all&lang2=bi — and a copy button) and 'More Options' / 'אפשרויות נוספות' with 'Share on Facebook' (פייסבוק), 'Share on X' (X), 'Share by Email' (אימייל). Header '‹ Resources'.

VERIFIED: opening Share (or Feedback) from the Tools row does NOT change the address bar — it stays with=all; and loading ?with=Share directly is read as a text filter named 'Share' ('No connections known for Share here.'). So on the old site these two views are state-only and cannot be deep-linked. Rebuild: they are normal sidebar views (with=Share, with=Feedback), because the owning panel's sidebar state lives in the URL — an intentional improvement.
BUG (old, not ported): the copy button's accessible name is 'Copy Link to Sheet' although it copies the text's link. Rebuild: 'Copy link' and a 'Link copied' status.

name: Add translation
summary: Starts the flow to contribute a translation for the selected text.
details: Logged out: SignUp modal AddTranslation; logged in: tracks 'Add Translation Click' then navigates to /translate/<ref>?next=<path> (edit_text view).
Signed-out behaviour verified: Advanced > Add Translation opens the AddTranslation modal ('Have your own translation of this text?').

BUILT 2026-10-07: signed in, Add Translation goes to Django's /translate/<ref>?next=<this page>, as the old addTranslation. Edit Text and Linker Admin Tools need editor/moderator rights the client does not know yet: not shown.

name: Edit text
summary: Allows editing the version of the text currently shown.
details: Only if canEditText and textsData exists in ReaderPanelContext; uses translation when master language english else primary.
Navigates /edit/<ref>/<langFamily>/<versionTitle>?next=<path>; tracks 'Edit Text Click' with hitCallback; server enforces auth.

name: Linker Admin tools entry (moderator)
summary: Moderators get an Advanced entry that turns on linker debug mode.
details: Wrench-icon button sets URL params with=LinkerAdmin&debug_mode=linker; if linker debug already on server-side only switches mode via replaceState, else reloads.

name: Create connection between two texts
summary: Signed-in users can link two open texts together with a relationship type.
details: Advanced -> 'Add Connection': logged out SignUp modal AddConnection; uses srefs = allOpenRefs (every open Text panel's ref).
1 ref: 'Choose a text to connect.' + Browse button opens compare panel; >2 refs: 'We currently only understand connections between two texts.'.

2 refs: summary 'A & B' en/he (Hebrew refs from cache or getRef, '...' meanwhile); type dropdown: None, commentary, quotation, midrash, ein mishpat (Ein Mishpat / Ner Mitsvah), mesorat hashas, reference, related (passage).
POST /api/links/ {json:{refs,type}}; success: track 'Add Connection', clearLinks, onSave, flash message; errors via alert.
Server: login or API key; saved async via save_changes/LinkChange (reader/views.py:2392-2455).
Signed-out behaviour verified: Advanced > Add Connection opens the AddConnection modal ('Want to document a connection to another text?').

BUILT 2026-10-07 (src/ui/AddConnectionView): signed in, Advanced → Add Connection with the texts open in the panels: one → 'Choose a text to connect.' (Browse waits for Compare Text, MULTIPANEL_PLAN Step 4); two → both refs, the type (None, Commentary, Quotation, Midrash, Ein Mishpat / Ner Mitsvah, Mesorat HaShas, Reference, Related Passage), Add Connection → POST /api/links/ json={refs, type}; more → 'We currently only understand connections between two texts.'

name: Compare text from sidebar
summary: The Compare Text tool replaces the sidebar with a text chooser to open a second text side-by-side.
details: ReaderApp.openComparePanel(n, connectAfter) replaces the connections panel with a navigation-menu panel (compare:true, openSidebarAsConnect); tracks 'Other Text Click'.
If openSidebarAsConnect, its sidebar opens in 'Add Connection' mode (ReaderApp.jsx:1865); compare panel has its own header (ComparePanelHeader.jsx) and book TOC (openCompareTextTOC).
Desktop only (no Compare button on mobile).

name: Feedback / report an issue
summary: Users can report text issues, request translations, report bugs or send thanks from the sidebar.
details: Types: content_issue ('Report an issue with the text'), translation_request, bug_report, help_request, feature_request, good_vibes ('Give thanks'), other; textarea 'Describe the issue'.
Email field for logged-out users validated by regex; aria-live alerts 'Please select a feedback type' / 'Please enter a valid email address'.
POST /api/send_feedback {refs,type,url,currVersions,email,msg,uid}; view switches to 'Feedback sent!' immediately (optimistic); tracks 'Send Feedback'; errors via alert.
Intro 'Have some feedback? We would love to hear it.'

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: text 'Have some feedback? We would love to hear it.' / 'אנחנו מעוניינים במשוב ממך', a type dropdown (placeholder 'Select Type' / 'סוג משוב'), a textarea ('Describe the issue...' / 'טקסט המשוב'), for signed-out readers an 'Email Address' box, and 'Submit' / 'שליחה'. Types: Report an issue with the text (דיווח על בעיה בטקסט), Request translation (בקשה לתרגום), Report a bug (דיווח על תקלה באתר), Get help (עזרה), Request a feature (בקשה להוספת אפשרות באתר), Give thanks (תודה), Other (אחר).

Messages: 'Please select a feedback type' / 'אנא בחרו סוג משוב'; 'Please enter a valid email address' (no Hebrew string exists in the interface file); failure: 'Unfortunately, there was an error sending this feedback. Please try again or try reloading this page.' / 'לצערנו ארעה שגיאה בשליחת המשוב. אנא נסו שוב או רעננו את הדף הנוכחי'.

BUG (old, not ported): the failure handler calls this.setState inside a non-bound callback, so after the alert the box stays on 'Feedback sent!' (or throws). Rebuild: a failed send returns to the form with the error and the typed text.

Not exercised live (it would send a real report to Sefaria): the request shape (form field json = {refs, type, url, currVersions, email, msg, uid}) is taken from the source and reproduced by the rebuild; its e2e intercepts the request. The response's CORS headers for a cross-origin caller are UNVERIFIED — ask the owner before testing against production.
2026-10-07: a signed-in reader is not asked for an email, and the feedback carries their uid (the sidebar had passed neither).

name: Guided Learning (Key Questions)
summary: An experimental AI-generated study guide for a passage with key questions, answer summaries and the related commentary.
details: Data Sefaria.guidesByRef from /api/related guides (GuideSet.load_set_for_client); shares _guides cache with getGuide.
Header: 'Guided Learning', 'Experiment' label, AiInfoTooltip saying Q&A were AI-generated (hidden while viewing a commentary).

Three states with own history stack: QUESTIONS ('Key Questions' list, 'N Answers'), SUMMARIES (question title + each answer summaryText with commentary index title), COMMENTARIES (TextRange of chosen commentaryRef).
Back button: setState overridden to push history and call setPreviousSettings; header shows '‹ Questions' / '‹ Summary' instead of 'Resources'; stack empty clears; changing ref resets guide.
BUG: pluralisation uses length>0?'Answers':'Answer' -> '1 Answers'/'0 Answer' (GuideBox.jsx:22).
Constructor assumes guides[0] exists and crashes otherwise; button only shown when guides exist.

gtag: guide_question_clicked and guide_answer_clicked with panel_type 'sidebar', panel_number 1.5, panel_name 'Learning Guide', panel_category 'Resources | Guide', ref, position (Q.A decimal), experiment true, text, feature_name 'Key Questions', engagement_type 'consult', item_id.

name: Quick-start guide overlay for sheet editor
summary: A one-time onboarding overlay with video cards teaches new users the sheet editor.
details: ReaderPanel.getGuideType: desktop, first panel only, mode==='Sheet' and shouldUseEditor (ReaderPanel.jsx:477-526); never shown on mobile.
Auto-show once per user via cookie guide_overlay_seen_<type> (20-year expiry); can be forced via showGuide/forceShow.
Sefaria.getGuide(type) GET /api/guides/<key>; 7s timeout then overlay closes and alerts 'Something went wrong…'; load errors same alert.

Cards: title with optional prefix, autoplay/muted/loop/inline video (Sefaria._v(videoUrl) per language), markdown text with newlines -> breaks; circular prev/next 'n of N'; footer links; close button.
gtag: guide_view_auto, guide_view_manual, guide_close (duration seconds + card), guide_nav, guide_click (footer links and text links); project 'Quick Start Guide'.

name: Sidebar header title, back and close
summary: The sidebar header shows the current section, a context-aware back link, a language toggle and a close button.
details: Priority: (1) backButtonSettings from GuideBox '‹ <backText>'; (2) Resources: static title 'Resources'/'קישורים וכלים' (centred on mobile); (3) TextList with previousCategory or any mode with previous mode: '‹ <prev>'; (4) else '‹ Resources' href ?with=all.

Previous-mode map: Translation Open -> Translations; extended notes -> Translations; WebPagesList -> WebPages; or connectionData.previousMode (Version Open -> About); click goes to previous mode or setConnectionsCategory(prevCategory).
Label text desktop only (mobile chevron only); Hebrew label from CONNECTION_MODE_STRING_IDS else raw name; href ?with=<prev>; chevron flips for RTL.

Desktop right buttons: LanguageToggleButton (when TORAH_SPECIFIC and not (Resources/ConnectionsList while interface Hebrew); sets lang2 in URL) and close circled X (closePanel, href with 'with' removed).
Mobile header: top border coloured by category in TextList; RecentFilterSet next to back link; no close button inside it.
Header marginRight (left for Hebrew) equal to scrollbar width to stay centred (l.30-40).

VERIFIED on sefaria.org: the header is #ededed, 60px, 34px sides; title 16px weight-100 (light) #666 with 1px letter-spacing, upper-case; at the right an aleph/ayin button (18px, 40% grey; shows the language it will switch TO) and the circled × (20px). It sets `lang2` (the sidebar's own language) and never touches the text's. Rebuilt (ConnectionsPanel `lang`/`onLang`, TextPanel `onSidebarLang`).

name: Related data API and caching
summary: One call bundles links, sheets, topics, manuscripts, media and guides for a ref and is split per segment into caches.
details: related(ref,cb)/relatedApi GET /api/related/<ref>?with_sheet_links=1; each type split per segment via _saveItemsByRef which keeps the larger cached list; _related[ref] holds original data.
relatedPrivate GET /api/related/<ref>?private=1 (my sheets and notes; marks empty subrefs loaded).
getLinks GET /api/links/<ref>?with_text=0 caches index stubs from collectiveTitle and essay displayedText terms; clearLinks resets _related, _links, _linkSummaries.

getIndexDetails, getLexiconWords, privateNotes, webpagesApi, topicsByRef/postRefTopicLink, mediaByRef/manuscriptsByRef/guidesByRef, sheets.*, bookSearchPathFilterAPI, getGuide, pollTask, getTopic, saveUserHistory(secondary:true) support sidebar tools.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: connection counts include sheets from collections listed in the library, served as links when `with_sheet_links=1` (old client: /api/related?with_sheet_links=1). Genesis 1:1 Commentary = 958 with them, 957 without (/api/links?with_text=0 omits them; add with_sheet_links=1).

Tracks 'Reader / Set Translation Language Preference'; persists via editProfileAPI({settings:{translation_language_preference, ..._suggested}}).
Passed to getTextFromCurrVersions, TopicPage, ConnectionsPanel, TextColumn.
'sefaria:settings-updated' event from account settings updates it live, plus readingHistory (-> Sefaria.is_history_enabled) and textualCustom/diaspora (-> Sefaria.updateCalendars) (1259-1271).

name: Version preferences by corpus cookie
summary: The app remembers preferred versions per corpus.
details: VersionPreferences maps corpus -> {lang: vtitle}; getVersionPref(ref) looks up index corpus; failures (sheets, missing index) return null; update is immutable.
Every construction writes cookie version_preferences_by_corpus (JSON).
ReaderApp itself only uses the per-book defaultVersions cache; VersionPreferences is consumed by the Sefaria singleton.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: the cookie is a SESSION cookie (no expiry) holding URL-encoded JSON {"Tanakh":{"en":"<title>"}}; choosing a German translation stores it under the 'en' key (the version's `language` field is 'en' for every translation). Signed-in users also save it to the profile (not ported).
Rebuild difference: the cookie lasts a year (max-age=31536000) instead of the browser session.

name: Select version from panel (shell logic)
summary: Choosing a version updates the panel and its linked sidebar/text and remembers it per book.
details: selectVersion(n,versionTitle,versionLanguage,languageFamilyName) (1639-1662): sets currVersions[lang], caches in defaultVersions for the book; event 'Reader / Choose Version / {book} / {vtitle} / {lang}'; null selects default version.

Auto language switch (_getPanelLangOnVersionChange, 1605-1622): if panel bilingual, has both versions, or chosen version's language not currently visible -> bilingual; else version's language; Connections panels collapse bilingual to version's language.
Multi-panel: dependent panel (master<->connections) gets same currVersions and own language recomputation; mobile has no dependent panel.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: choosing a translation always sets lang=bi, whether the panel was English, Hebrew or bilingual (/Genesis.1.1?lang=en → …&ven=english|The_Koren_Jerusalem_Bible&lang=bi). The atlas's conditions ('has both versions…') are always true in a text panel, so the rule is simply 'bilingual'.

Else 'Want to change the translation?' banner when Sefaria.openTransBannerApplies(book,language) and open_trans_banner_shown cookie missing; 'Go to translations' opens Translations sidebar; x sets cookie.

TextColumnBannerChooser (ReaderPanel.jsx:1482): first translation-language-preference suggestion (Prefer to see <lang> translations when available? Yes/No) from server-provided Sefaria.translation_language_preference_suggestion
No -> cookie translation_language_preference_suggested + profile setting; Yes -> sets preference and thank-you
Else OpenTransBanner (Want to change the translation? opens translations in resources panel; cookie open_trans_banner_shown)
Generic TextColumnBanner with buttons/close

summary: Selecting a translation switches the reader to it and remembers the preference for that corpus.
details: openVersionInMainPanel: gtag onClick_select_version; translation mode calls openVersionInReader(vtitle,'en',langFamily) -> ReaderApp.selectVersion.

For translations only: Sefaria.setVersionPreference(ref,vtitle,'en') updates versionPreferences per corpus, tracks 'Set Version Preference', POSTs profile version_preferences_by_corpus (sefaria.js:1114-1122).
Link href /<ref>?v<lang>=<vtitle> keeping other-language version; merged versions href '#'.

selectVersion(n,vtitle,lang,langFamily): sets panel.currVersions[lang], caches default version per book, tracks 'Choose Version', can switch panel language (_getPanelLangOnVersionChange), mirrors to dependent connections panel on desktop; null title resets to default.

BUG (VERIFIED 2026-10-05): the Select link's href repeats the parameter: /Genesis.1.1?ven=THE_JPS_TANAKH:_Gender-Sensitive_Edition&ven=THE_JPS_TANAKH:_Gender-Sensitive_Edition, and omits the language family. The rebuild writes ven=<family>|<Title>.

Rebuild: choosing a translation swaps the loaded text in place and keeps the reader's verse still; the sidebar stays on Translations with the new one marked current. Corpus preference cookie (VER-002) not yet ported.

name: Translation Open sub-mode

details: VersionsTextList: RecentFilterSet of recently opened versions; TextRange of humanRef(srefs) in that version using useVersionLanguage so only that language column shows.

Back returns to Translations (ConnectionsPanelHeader.previousModes).
Version key format 'vTitle|lang' via getTranslateVersionsKey (sefaria.js:1112).

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: each preview is <a class=versionPreview href='/Genesis.1.1?ven=<current>&vside=The_Koren_Jerusalem_Bible&with=Translation Open'>; the click handler rewrites the URL to …&vside=The_Koren_Jerusalem_Bible|en&with=Translation Open (key '<title>|<language>', language = the version's `language`, 'en' for every translation). Both forms must be read.

One extra request: /api/v3/texts/Genesis.1.1?version=english|<title>&version=hebrew|…. The rebuild reuses the translations list it already fetched (no extra request).
Rebuild: 'Add to Sheet' needs sign-in and arrives with the signed-in tools; the recent-versions chip row shows only the previewed version.

name: Version resolution order
summary: Defines which version a passage is shown in when none is explicitly chosen.
details: getTextFromCurrVersions/_getVersionObjects: explicit choice, then user's corpus translation preference, then translationLanguagePreference language, then default; withContext refetches the section.
getVersions GET /api/texts/versions/<ref> buckets by actualLanguage and fills _translateVersions; getSourceVersions filters isPrimary; getTranslations filters isSource:false.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Exodus 1:1, signed out, cookies set by hand): no cookies → Revised JPS, 2023; version_preferences_by_corpus={"Tanakh":{"en":"The Koren Jerusalem Bible"}} → Koren; translation_language_preference=es → 'Alfredo cerhy [es]'; both → Koren (corpus preference wins); a preference naming a version the text lacks → default; explicit ?ven= beats the cookie.

Client rule (Sefaria._getVersionObjects): explicit translation must exist among the text's non-source versions or it is dropped; the corpus preference must also exist for this text; the language preference takes the highest-`priority` translation whose bucket (title '[xx]' suffix, else `language`) matches. Corpus = `corpora[0]` of the book's index (/api/v2/raw/index/<title>); only some books have one (Tanakh, Mishnah, Bavli…).
An unknown ?version= is not an error in /api/v3/texts: it answers 200 with the primary version only and a warning (code 101) — so preferences must be validated against available_versions before use.

summary: The old standalone Versions sidebar mode is gone; browsing happens in About and Translations.
details: CONNECTION_MODE_STRING_IDS retains 'Versions' key (constants.js:23) but nothing uses that mode.

Version notes HTML by interface language plus 'Read more' link to extended notes (href /<title>/<lang>/<vtitle>/notes -> viewExtendedNotes); showNotes=false in Translations box.
Details (VersionInformation + VersionImage) not shown for merged versions.

details: Each row hidden when attribute missing. Source: link host with www. stripped. Digitization: 'Sefaria' linking /digitized-by-sefaria.
License: translateLicense -> link via getLicenseMap (Public Domain, CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-ND, unknown -> #).
Revision History link /activity/<ref>/<lang>/<vtitle> (segment_history) always shown; Buy in print link to purchaseInformationURL.

details: makeVersionLink: main panel uses v<lang>= keeping only same-language param; sidebar uses vside= keeping ALL current-version params plus &with=Translation Open.
Spaces become '_'; returns null when no other params (edge: no current versions -> null link).

details: Pencil only for moderators and only in book-page mode.

Fields: Version Title, Hebrew Version Title, Short Version Title, Short Hebrew Version Title, Version Source, License (known + current + '(None Listed)'), Direction, isSource, isPrimary, Digitized by Sefaria, Priority, Locked (status='locked'), Version Notes, Hebrew Version Notes, Purchase Information (Buy URL, Buy Image).

Server: staff or API key only; tracker.update_version_metadata; empty license deletes license (reader/views.py:2779-2829).

Language toggle 'עברית'/'English' when both exist; missing-language messages.

Back link only if backFromExtendedNotes passed; BUG: not passed in sidebar so ExtendedNotes.jsx:30 calls undefined prop and can crash when version has no extended notes; header back goes to 'Translations'.
Book-TOC variant (menuOpen 'extended notes') served at ?notes=1 via make_panel_dict (reader/views.py:551-559).

summary: Texts with three or more levels (e.g. volume/chapter) show a heading per top-level unit with its sections beneath.
details: JaggedArrayNodeSection depth>2: for each non-empty top section a .sectionName heading '<SectionName> <n>' (Hebrew hebrewTerm(sectionName)+Hebrew numeral/daf) then recurse one level down.
Examples cited: Zohar volume/paragraph; depth-3 texts list chapters within each.
Ported and unit-tested on a synthetic three-level record (no recorded book is deeper than two levels in the sidebar): headings 'Volume 1', 'Volume 3', the empty one skipped.

name: Zoomed-out TOC levels
summary: Some texts' contents are shown at a coarser level than their full depth so links land on sections rather than segments.
details: toc_zoom: zooms TOC out by N levels - shows depth-zoom levels, trims sectionNames/addressTypes, current ref zoomed via Sefaria.zoomOutRef.
refPathTerminal for zoomed TOCs appends first non-empty deeper address so links land at section level.
Ported and unit-tested on a synthetic record; links end at the first branch the old refPathTerminal finds (arrays count as non-empty even when all zeros — kept).

name: Section numbering by address type
summary: Section labels follow each text's own addressing: Talmud pages (2a, 2b), folios, years and Hebrew letters.
details: Sefaria.getSectionStringByAddressType handles Talmud daf ('2a','2b'), Integer, Folio, Year (+1241 offset, Hebrew gematria with gershayim), default Hebrew numeral.
Talmud daf grid in the TOC is produced via this path.

Rebuild: Talmud/Folio labels come from the shared address helpers; Hebrew dafs use the same punctuation as the text headings ('ב.' / 'ב:'); Year = 1241 + n with gershayim. Section-name terms in Hebrew come from a small static table (hebrewTerm) — extend it as live comparisons find missing terms.

name: Alternate structure nodes (ArrayMap)
summary: Alternate tables of contents (e.g. Parasha, Talmud chapters) list their sections or link to whole spans.
details: ArrayMapNode with refs and includeSections (default true): list of section links; numbering via explicit addresses or offset + skipped_addresses; empty ref '' skipped; labeled via addressTypes[0]; .current if ref contains visible ref.
displayFixedTitleSubSections (Torah Parasha): title itself links to first ref of wholeRef (splitSpanningRefNaive), always open, aliyot beneath.
Else collapsible titled block (default open).
Without includeSections: single link to wholeRef (e.g. Parasha for non-Torah, Talmud 'Chapters' alt struct where each perek links its span) with current highlighting.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: Berakhot's default structure is 'Chapters' (the schema is excluded): 'Chapter 1; MeEimatai' … each over its dafs (2a … 13a), the shared daf 13a appearing under both chapters; the first/last dafs of a range link to the range ('Berakhot 2a:1-14'). Essay nodes of Zohar are titled blocks ('1', '2', …) over paragraph numbers.

name: Dictionary node letter browse
summary: Dictionary-type texts show a Browse by Letter list linking to each letter's entries.
details: DictionaryNode: if headwordMap -> header (node title or 'Browse By Letter / לפי סדר הא״ב') and letter links to refs; current letter derived from current section ref substring.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Jastrow): 'Browse By Letter' + 22 letters, then 'Preface', 'Hebrew or Aramaic Abbreviations', 'List of Abbreviations' links. The old TOC also renders a DictionarySearch box for lexicon books — not yet rebuilt.

name: Alternate structure tabs toggle
summary: Books with alternative tables of contents (e.g. by topic or portion) get a toggle to switch between structures, which is reflected in the URL.
details: Default active struct = indexDetails.default_struct if in alts, else 'schema'.
Options: 'schema' (label schema.sectionNames[0] else 'Contents') unless in exclude_structs; plus each alt struct (key name label) not excluded; default struct sorted first.
Shown only if >1 options and not dictionary and not Torah.
TabbedToggleSet links have href with ?tab=<name> replaced; narrowPanel -> rows of 2 (if 4 options) or 3.

CORRECTION (VERIFIED 2026-10-05 on Zohar, Introduction): the toggles are real <a class='altStructToggle' href='…&tab=<Struct>'> anchors, but a click only changes component state — the address bar does not change (the atlas summary 'reflected in the URL' is wrong). The tab labels are the alt-structure keys ('Daf', 'Essay'); the plain schema tab is absent when exclude_structs lists it (Zohar, Berakhot).
The rebuild matches the contents of both Zohar tabs text-for-text (46,284 characters in Essay).

name: Torah books: Chapters plus Torah Portions
summary: Genesis through Deuteronomy show the chapter list and, below it, the weekly portions with their aliyot, with no structure toggle.
details: isTorah = Genesis/Exodus/Leviticus/Numbers/Deuteronomy.
All nodes of alts['Parasha'] get displayFixedTitleSubSections=true (titles are links; aliyah subsections always shown, not collapsible).
Schema header 'Chapters' then .torahNavParshiot with header 'Torah Portions', disableSubCollapse.
No struct toggle for Torah.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05: Genesis sidebar = 'Chapters' + 50 links, 'Torah Portions' + each portion (title links to its first aliyah) with aliyot 1-7; no toggle. isTorah is by TITLE (the five books), not by category.

VERIFIED on the book page: 'Torah Portions' is a small grey label over the portions in TWO columns, each portion's name large (a link to its first aliyah) over the aliyot as small plain numbers; 'Chapters' is a grid of 50px pale tiles with serif numbers.

name: Dictionary search on book page
summary: Dictionary books show a search box above their contents to look up headwords.
details: If indexDetails.lexiconName -> DictionarySearch box above TOC (lexicon search within the dictionary).
Dictionaries: no struct toggle, no DownloadVersions module, letter grid instead.

name: Current version attribution (legacy)

details: getCurrentVersion builds {versionTitle, versionSource, versionStatus, license, sources (merged), versionNotes, digitizedBySefaria, shortVersionTitle(+Hebrew), versionNotesInHebrew, extendedNotes(+Hebrew)}; merged = !!sources; falls back lang if no text in chosen lang.
DEAD: only for non-book-toc and appears unused in render.

name: Read More text truncation (legacy)
summary: A helper truncates long descriptions to 30 words with 'Read More', apparently no longer used; extended notes mode in BookPage is commented out.
details: DEAD: ReadMoreText truncates after 30 words with 'Read More ›'.
DEAD: ExtendedNotes mode commented out in BookPage (BookPage.jsx:1545-1555); extended notes now in ReaderPanel 'extended notes' mode.

name: Related topics of a book
summary: The book page sidebar suggests topics connected to the text, expandable beyond the first five.
details: From indexDetails.relatedTopics; first 5 then 'More' expands all; links /topics/<slug>.
Server get_topics_for_book: topics linked to any ref in the book, excluding parashat-*, ranked by user votes, top 18, cached 24h (helper/topic.py:501-518).
VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (Berakhot): Prayer, Shema, Amidah, Blessings (Halakhah), Women, then 'More'. Links go to /topics/<slug> (sefaria.org until topic pages exist in the rebuild).

name: Book index details data
summary: The book page depends on a detailed index record: structure, content counts, authors, dates, dedication and related topics.
details: /api/v2/index/<title> returns schema with content_counts, alts, default_struct, exclude_structs, firstSectionRef, authors, compDateString, compPlaceString, pubDateString, dedication, lexiconName, relatedTopics, heCategories, collective_title, base_text_titles.
index_api GET with counts/related topics; POST staff/API key; DELETE staff.

name: Topic URLs and legacy redirects
summary: Topics have landing, category, A-Z and individual topic URLs, and old sheet-tag URLs redirect to topics.
details: /topics -> topics_page; /topics/category/<slug> -> topics_category_page; /topics/all/<letter> -> all_topics_page; /topics/b/<slug> -> topic_page_b (A/B test version); /topics/<slug> -> topic_page (urls_shared.py:53-57).
Legacy: /sheets/tags -> /topics, /sheets/tags/<tag> -> /topics/<tag> (301) (urls_shared.py:60-61; reader/views.py:1151-1173).

Client (ReaderApp.jsx:1421-1431, 2059-2104): /topics -> menuOpen 'topics'; category -> navigationTopicCategory + title via Sefaria.topicTocCategoryTitle; all -> menuOpen 'allTopics' + navigationTopicLetter; topic -> fetches Sefaria.getTopic first then sets navigationTopic, topicTitle, topicTestVersion.

History URL (ReaderApp.jsx:561-582): topics/<slug> (or topics/<testVersion>/<slug>) + &sort=<topicSort> + &tab=<tab>; category topics/category/<slug>; all topics/all/<letter> titled 'Explore Jewish Texts by Topic - <letter>'.

name: Module-specific topics home
summary: The library shows the new topics landing page, while the Voices site shows the older grid of topic categories.
details: ReaderPanel (983-1048) menuOpen 'topics': navigationTopicCategory -> TopicCategory; navigationTopic -> TopicPage (tab, setTab, onSetTopicSort, topicSort, translationLanguagePreference, topicTestVersion, toggleSignUpModal, multiPanel); else library -> TopicsLandingPage, voices -> TopicsPage.
menuOpen 'allTopics' -> TopicPageAll.

name: Topics landing page layout
summary: The library's topics home presents search, a word cloud of topics, a featured topic, a newsletter, sample topics and this week's seasonal content.
details: h1 'Explore by Topic'; sections in order: TopicLandingSearch (numOfTopics = Sefaria.numLibraryTopics), TopicSalad, FeaturedTopic, TopicLandingNewsletter, RandomTopicCardWithDescriptionRow, then TopicLandingParasha + TopicLandingSeasonal.
Sidebar: TopicLandingTopicCatList, TrendingTopics, AZTopicsLink.
Analytics attrs: data-anl-project='topics', panel_name, panel_type='Topic Landing', feature names per section.

name: Topic search with autocomplete
summary: A search box on the topics landing page suggests topics as you type, showing each topic's category path.
details: GeneralAutocomplete (Downshift): ignores <=1 char; Sefaria.getName(word,20,['Topic'],'library',exactContinuations=true,orderByMatchedLength=true) -> /api/name; detects Hebrew input to pick he/en.

Suggestion title first-letter capitalized; trailing '(disambiguation)' removed if equal to one of its topic-TOC category names; category path text '(Cat > SubCat)' from Sefaria.topicTocCategories(slug).
Item: hashtag icon + title + gray path; click/Enter opens topic via openTopic(slug); Enter with no highlight opens first suggestion.
Placeholder 'Search <N> Topics A-Z' (en, N localized) / 'חיפוש לפי נושא' (he); maxLength 75; SearchButton icon.
'Explore all topics' prompt smooth-scrolls .content to #browseTopics offset by header height + 16px.

name: Topic word cloud (salad)
summary: A colorful cloud of randomly chosen topic names links straight into topics.
details: Sefaria.getTopicsByPool('general_<en|he>', 50) random order, uncached -> /api/topics/pools/<pool>?n=50.
Animated RainbowLine while loading (upper), static lower rainbow after.
MultiPanel: WordSalad numLines=5, bullets between items on same line (computed via offsetTop), CSS clamp --num-lines. Mobile: RowedWordSalad single horizontally scrollable row.
Items link /topics/<slug>.

name: Featured topic of the day
summary: The landing page highlights a featured topic with image, description and a link.
details: Sefaria.getFeaturedTopic() -> /_api/topics/featured-topic?lang=<en|he> (cached per day; Django TopicOfTheDay).
Shows header 'Featured Topic', topic.secondary_image_uri (4:3 crop; alt = image caption), title, markdown description, 'Go to Topic ›'. Hidden if no topic.

name: Topics newsletter sign-up
summary: Visitors can subscribe to the weekly topics newsletter from the landing page.
details: Heading 'Stay curious: get the timeless topics newsletter'; inputs first name, last name, email; Enter submits; validation (names required, valid email).
Sefaria.subscribeSefariaNewsletter(first,last,email,educator=false,lists) -> POST /api/subscribe/<email> with lists ['Weekly Topics Newsletter'] for English interface only; Hebrew = [].
States: 'Subscribing...', 'Subscribed! Welcome to our list.', error (role=alert). Analytics form_start, form_submit.

name: Random topic cards with descriptions
summary: A row of randomly picked topics, each with a short description and an Explore link.
details: multiPanel -> 3 cards, mobile -> 10. Fetches numTopics^3 topics from pool general_<lang>; keeps those with description in interface lang.
Card with title, markdown description, bottom link 'Explore <title> ›' (relative hrefs topics/<slug>).

name: This week's Torah portion card
summary: The landing page features this week's Torah portion with a topic link and a Read the Portion button.
details: Sefaria.getUpcomingDay('parasha') -> /api/calendars/topics/parasha?lang=xx (parasha_data_api) cached per date.

TopicLandingCalendar card: header 'This week's Torah portion', title parasha displayValue, description, link topics/<parasha topic>; 'Learn More about <Parasha> ›', ParashahLink (current ref from Sefaria.calendars), 'Read the Portion' /<parasha.url>, 'Browse All Torah Portions' -> /topics/category/torah-portions.

name: Seasonal Jewish calendar topic card
summary: The landing page features a topic tied to the current time of the Jewish year with dates and a link to the Jewish calendar topics.
details: Sefaria.getSeasonalTopic() -> getUpcomingDay('holiday') -> /api/calendars/topics/holiday?lang=xx -> seasonal_topic_api (Django SeasonalTopic: topic, optional secondary_topic, display start/end (diaspora-aware), date prefix/suffix).
Card header 'On the Jewish Calendar', topic title/description/link; 'Learn more about <title> ›'.

Date message '<prefix> <secondary topic link> <suffix>' and Intl formatRange date range (en/he month-day) only when secondary topic exists; 'Explore the Jewish Calendar' -> /topics/category/jewish-calendar2.
Dates created timezone-agnostically (Util.createTimeZoneAgnosticDate).

name: Topics category grid (Voices)
summary: The Voices site's topics home is a grid of topic category cards plus an All Topics A-Z card.
details: Cards for each Sefaria.topic_toc top-level category via TopicTOCCard + extra card 'All Topics A-Z' -> /topics/all/a (or א in Hebrew).
Title 'Explore by Topic' in CategoryHeader type='topics' toggleButtonIDs ['subcategory','reorder'] (admin).
Mobile: inline AboutTopics. Sidebar: TrendingTopics, JoinTheConversation.
Voices module: only Sheets topic pool, markdown links stripped in cards, trending = trending sheet tags.

name: Topic card
summary: A card represents a topic or category with title, description and link.
details: Title link /topics/category/<slug> if topic has children else /topics/<slug>; description categoryDescription for categories, description for leaves (markdown; showDescription flag).
Strips leading 'Parashat ' / 'פרשת ' from titles; hidden if missing en or he title.
Click: categories setNavTopic(slug,{en,he}); leaves setTopic(...).
Card (common/Card.jsx): analytics title link; markdown disallowed elements ['p'] plus 'a' in Voices (links stored with library domain; sefaria.js:3946-3950); optional bottom link.

name: Topic category page
summary: A topic category page lists its subtopics as cards, sorted and filtered for the current site.
details: TopicCategory loads Sefaria.getTopic(topic) (admin edit data) and Sefaria.topicTocPage(slug).

Subtopics filtered by Sefaria.shouldDisplayInActiveModule (shouldDisplay && pools include library->'library', voices->'sheets'); sorted by Sefaria.sortTopicsCompareFn (displayOrder, top-level ignored; tie alphabetical by interface-lang title stripping leading '"'/'#'; Hebrew missing titles last).
h1 in CategoryHeader type='topics' data=topicData (admin: add subcategory / edit).
Sidebar: AboutTopics, Promo, TrendingTopics, SponsorADay; for torah-portions in English inserts StudyCompanion after AboutTopics.
Analytics data-anl-panel_category; server topics_category_page 404s unknown slug and sets SEO title/desc (reader/views.py:1013-1037).

name: All Topics A-Z index
summary: An alphabetical index of every topic with letter navigation and a filter box.
details: Sefaria.topicList() -> /api/topics?limit=0 (topics_list_api -> get_all_topics(limit, active_module, min_sources); minified; cache 1h); computes normTitles.
Filter input 'Search Topics' with reset button; applies only when >=2 chars; matches any title (all languages) substring; keeps server order (by #sources) with interface-lang-titled first.
Without filter: topics whose interface-language primary title starts with URL letter, alphabetical (nikkud stripped).
AlphabeticalTopicsNav: A-Z or Hebrew א-ת (final letters excluded) links /topics/all/<letter>.
Excludes topics not displayable in active module; TopicTOCCard grid; 'There are no topics here.' when empty.
Sidebar: Promo, TrendingTopics, GetTheApp, SupportSefaria.

name: Topic page data loading
summary: A topic page fetches the topic's details, sources, sheets and related links, sorted into tabs.
details: Sefaria.getTopic(slug,{with_html:true}) -> /api/v2/topics/<slug>?annotate_time_period=1&ref_link_type_filters=<about|popular-writing-of>&with_html=1&with_links=1&annotate_links=1&with_refs=1&group_related=1&with_indexes=1.

Author special case: if topic TOC category is 'authors' and module is library, ref_link_type_filters=['popular-writing-of'] only (hides 'about' Sources) (sefaria.js:3070-3079; server mirror reader/views.py:3902-3912).
If topic has parasha -> Sefaria.getParashaNextRead(parasha) -> /api/calendars/next-read/<parasha>.
If topic has portal_slug -> Sefaria.getPortal(slug) -> /api/portals/<slug>; sidebar replaced by portal modules. BUG: getPortal called every render.
Cancelable load; resets when slug changes.

Server topic_page (reader/views.py:3542-3591): normalizes slug; 404 if missing or not in active module pool; initialTab default 'notable-sources'; initialTopicSort 'Relevance'; noindex if fails should_display(min_sources=MIN_SOURCES_FOR_TOPIC_DISPLAY); SEO desc includes topic description.
BUG: _topic_page_data lacks a return, so the topicData prop is always None; server computes and discards; client always fetches (reader/views.py:3905-3906).

API (helper/topic.py:40-101): omits orphaned ref links; strips unpublished description; groups links by type; refs sorted by relevance with similar/overlapping refs merged (except learning-team sources); 'indexes' for AuthorTopic; 'possibilities' for ambiguous topics (not rendered by client).

name: Topic source tab bucketing
summary: Sources linked to a topic are sorted into Notable Sources, Sources, Top Citations and Sheets tabs depending on site and annotation.
details: processTopicsTabsData (sefaria.js:3093-3185): Voices -> only sheet links in 'Sheets' tab.

Library non-sheet links: popular-writing-of -> 'Top Citations'; about -> 'Notable Sources' if link has published description (title or prompt) in interface lang, else 'Sources'; 'Sources' becomes superset notable+plain (titled 'All Sources' if created only from notable).
Moderator: 'Admin' tab = copy of Sources.
Order normalized: availableLangs, numDatasource, tfidf, pr, curatedPrimacy{he,en}.

name: Topic page header
summary: The topic header shows the title, category link, description, image on mobile and sponsorship dedication, with an AI disclosure marker when relevant.
details: h1 in CategoryHeader type='topics' toggleButtonIDs ['source','edit','reorder'] (moderator).
Category link (topicCategory) to /topics/category/<parent slug> (SPA via setNavTopic) unless topic is itself a category.
AiInfoTooltip (outline 24) when any about-link has published ai_title in current lang, library only: hover popup + Learn More (/ai) + Feedback (formstack).
Description markdown (with HTML, disallowed elements per module); topic image under description on mobile (non-multiPanel) via TopicImage (ImageWithCaption).
Loading placeholder 'Loading...'.

name: Parasha topic sponsorship text
summary: Certain Torah portion topic pages show a hard-coded sponsorship dedication.
details: TopicSponsorship hard-coded text for parasha topics: bereshit, lech-lecha, toldot, vayigash, achrei-mot, vaetchanan, vzot-haberachah; only for topics with ref; markdown.

name: Read the portion and Study Companion buttons
summary: Topics with a text reference (portions, holidays) show a button to read it, and English portion pages offer the free Study Companion.
details: Blue button to the ref in library module: 'Read the Portion' if parasha else the ref (he ref with geresh/gershayim stripped).
English-only 'Get the Free Study Companion' button (learn.sefaria.org/weekly-parashah, promotion analytics).

name: Topic page tabs
summary: Topic pages have tabs for notable sources, all sources, top citations, sheets and (for authors) Works on Sefaria, plus filter and language controls.
details: Source tabs (useAllPossibleSourceTabs 464-509): popular-writing-of, admin, notable-sources, sources, sheets; sort options refs: Relevance, Chronological; sheets: Relevance, Views, Newest; tabs appear only if present in topicData.tabs.

'Works on Sefaria' (author-works-on-sefaria) prepended when topic has indexes and library module: AuthorIndexItem list (title link to index or category URL, description). Backend AuthorTopic.get_aggregated_urls_for_authors_indexes groups works by category/collective title e.g. 'Rashi on Talmud' (topic.py:794-880).
Filter pseudo-tab (funnel icon, right-justified) not shown on notable-sources or works tabs; toggles filter/sort header.
Language toggle 'A' pseudo-tab (library, not works tab) opens LangSelectInterface popover Source / Translation / Source with Translation -> local langPref hebrew/english/bilingual.
Tab URL-driven (tab prop / setTab); pseudo-tabs via onClickArray.
Empty -> null; loading -> LoadingMessage.

name: Topic source incremental loading
summary: Topic source lists load in batches as the reader scrolls and remember how far they were scrolled on return.
details: useIncrementalLoad per tab fetches chunks of Sefaria._topicPageSize=70 refs via Sefaria.getBulkText(refs, asSizedString=true, 500, 600, translationLanguagePreference) (text trimmed to 500-600 chars) or getBulkSheets(ids).
Results cached into topicData.tabs[key].loadedData; _refsDisplayedByTab remembers how many displayed (restore on back).

name: Topic source filter and sort
summary: Readers can filter a topic's sources by text and sort by relevance, date or views.
details: FilterableList pageSize=20 scroll pagination on page's scroll container; showFilterHeader toggled by filter tab -> text input + 'Sort by' options.
refFilter (:81-88) matches text in en, he, ref, or ref categories; sheetFilter (:91-97) matches title, summary, publisher name/position/organization.

refSort (:100-132): items with order first; Chronological -> comp_date then order_id; Relevance -> curatedPrimacy (interface lang) desc, then (English UI) sources having English first, then pagerank pr, then numDatasource*tfidf.
sheetSort (:135-159): prefer sheets whose title/content language matches interface; Views -> views desc; Newest -> dateCreated desc; Relevance -> log(views)*relevance.
Sort lifted to ReaderPanel (onSetTopicSort/topicSort) and persisted in URL &sort=.
First details element (first curated source) forced open on data load (:836-841).

name: Topic source cards
summary: Each source on a topic page shows the text excerpt with its citation, and curated sources show a title and learning prompt.
details: TopicTextPassage render modes: admin (descriptions + show language-missing), notable-sources (descriptions, hide missing langPref), sources/popular-writing-of (no descriptions, hide missing language).
Bilingual text via ContentText (Hebrew first in bilingual), override to the only available language; body links /<ref>?<version params>; ref citation subHeading link; ColorBarBox by category.
Curated + displayDescription -> SummarizedStoryFrame <details>: summary shows curated title + primary category (uppercase); inside, learning prompt then source. Guard for deleted indexes (sc-38063).
Analytics batch per item: position, ai/human, item_id (ref), content_id (index title), content_type (categories).
DEAD: dataSources tooltip text computed but afterSave element never rendered (TopicPage.jsx:186-194).

name: Topic sheet cards
summary: Sheets tagged with a topic appear as cards with title, summary, author and save/follow actions.
details: SheetBlock: title link /sheets/<id>, Save button (history object 'Sheet <id>'), summary, ProfileListing (author image/name/position/org with follow button).
Sheets tab is the only tab in Voices module.

name: Topic side column: metadata and links
summary: The side column shows the topic image, lifespan, external reference links and related-topic groups.
details: TopicMetaData (:1114-1172): topic image on multiPanel; 'Lived' (timePeriod name + yearRange for PersonTopics); 'Learn More' links Wikipedia, Jewish Encyclopedia (jeLink), National Library of Israel; picks interface-lang URL else other lang with ' (Hebrew)'/' (English)' suffix; new tab.

Related-topic groups (preprocessLinksByType :894-973): grouped by link type (server group_links_by_type); only shouldDisplay types with at least one link displayable in module; links filtered by module, sorted (interface-lang title first, then order.tfidf); plural title when >1.
If no groups -> fallback group of category siblings (first 20 from topic TOC; title = category name or 'Explore Topics'/'נושאים כלליים'); groups sorted 'Related' first then alphabetical.
TopicSideSection shows first 10 with More/Less; TopicLink -> /topics/<slug> or /topics/category/<slug>, SPA click, analytics related_click.
Promotions (sidebar ads) under side column.

name: Parasha readings panel
summary: A Torah portion topic shows the next reading date, aliyot, and haftarah links.
details: ReadingsComponent (:1058-1105) for parasha topics with next-read data: 'Readings' header, next read date (Gregorian locale + Hebrew calendar string), Torah ref link, aliyot links 1-7 and 'M' (maftir; Hebrew numerals, 'מ'), Haftarah link(s), all targeted at library module.

name: Portal topic pages
summary: Some topics are partner portals whose side column shows partner about, app, organization and newsletter modules instead of the usual links.
details: Topic with portal_slug: PortalNavSideBar modules in order about, mobile, organization, newsletter, each only if present in portal object.

Portal model (sefaria/model/portal.py): about{title,title_url,image_uri,image_caption,description}, mobile{title,description,android_link,ios_link}, organization{title,description}, newsletter{title,description,api_schema?}.
/api/portals/<slug> portals_api (reader/views.py:3953-3959).

name: AI-generated topic text disclosure and admin prompt tools
summary: Topic pages flag AI-generated source titles, and moderators can generate and publish AI prompts for sources.
details: Generate button (if links have ai_context but no prompt): POST /api/topics/generate-prompts/<slug> with ref_topic_links; alert (staff, Celery LLM).
Publish button (unpublished but reviewed links): set published=true, POST /api/ref-topic-links/bulk; confirm then reload.
ReviewStateIndicator per lang (Reviewed / Not Reviewed / Edited); click marks reviewed via POST /api/ref-topic-links/<ref> review_state 'reviewed'.

name: Topic page analytics batch
summary: Topic pages tag their root with analytics context for impressions.
details: Root container data-anl-batch = {project:'topics', content_lang, panel_category}.

name: Topic data model behaviors
summary: The client relies on topic fields for display gating, ordering, images and link groupings.
details: Subclasses Topic, PersonTopic (time period/place annotation; Hebrew birth/death place auto-filled from Place), AuthorTopic (authored indexes, aggregated works; is_author).

Fields: titles (disambiguation, transliteration flag), description (+description_published gate), categoryDescription, isTopLevelDisplay, displayOrder (default 10000), numSources, shouldDisplay, parasha, ref{en,he,url}, good_to_promote, isAmbiguous, data_source, image{image_uri (GCS img.sefaria.org/topics/...), caption}, secondary_image_uri, portal_slug, properties (enWikiLink, heWikiLink, jeLink, enNliLink, heNliLink, birthPlace, deathPlace, birthYear, deathYear, era), pools (library, sheets, general_en, general_he...).
should_display(min_sources): shouldDisplay != False and (numSources>=min or has description or data_source=='sefaria').
contents(minify) used in topic TOC and lists includes slug, shouldDisplay (true if has children), displayOrder, pools, categoryDescription, published description.

Link types: displays-under/displays-above (TOC hierarchy), is-a, related-to; RefTopicLink linkTypes about, popular-writing-of; descriptions per lang {title, prompt, ai_title, ai_context, published, review_state}.

Collections 6*PAD, only listed:true and not moderationStatus nolist; Users 7*PAD - sheet count, only users with public sheets, with small profile pic.

Filters, &

name: Entity search API
summary: A single endpoint serves topic, author and book name search with sort, category filter and paging.
details: GET /api/entity-search ?q&type=topic|author|book&sort&filter=<path>(repeatable)&start&size; size default 20 clamped 1..100; start clamped [0,9999]; final page shortened to stay within 10,000 window.
Validation errors as JSON error: missing q, bad type, invalid sort for type, filter on non-book type; other exceptions logged and generic error returned.

name: Entity relevance ranking
summary: Name search ranks exact title matches first, then phrase, all-words, prefix and any-word matches.
details: ENTITY_SORTS: topic relevance/alpha; author & book relevance/alpha/year_asc/year_desc; alpha sorts title_en.sort; years sort sortYear (authors death else birth) or compDate; missing last; _score ties.

Tiers: 1 exact case-insensitive keyword (primary 1000, variant/authored 100); 2 phrase on titles x4; 3 all words cross_fields AND x2; 4 all-words prefix x1.5 (multi-word); 5 phrase_prefix x1; 6 any word x0.1.
Field boosts overridable via RemoteConfig SEARCH_ENTITY_FIELD_BOOSTS_{TOPIC,AUTHOR,BOOK}, allow-list validated.
Descriptions never searched; tokenization mirrors exact_english analyzer (quote folding, combining marks, Hebrew ר׳).
Topics and authors share the topic index filtered by subtype.

name: Author and category resolution for books
summary: Searching an author's exact name returns that author's works; naming a category returns its books and a category row.
details: Only when no category filter set. Author exact title/variant -> works aggregated by category (_author_works_response): eponymous work first, then category rows, then the rest; individual works carry authors/author_names.

Category exact name (incl. Term variants like 'Bible'->Tanakh, shallowest first): eponymous books in categories (max 5), then one category row per match (isCategory, url /texts/<path>, parent path breadcrumb), then flat books excluding matched categories; paging walks lead rows first.
Otherwise flat book search.
Every book response has categoryCounts via terms agg on path (size 10,000); category filter applied as post_filter so counts ignore it; author/category paths compute via separate agg-only query.

name: Topic search index
summary: Only library-pool topics with titles are searchable; authors carry era and years.
details: Only Postgres 'library' TopicPool topics with a title (library_topic_slugs / make_topic_index_document).
Authors add era, birthYear, deathYear, sortYear, authored_titles_en/he.
Index updated on topic, index, category save hooks.

name: Search wrapper API
summary: The client posts search queries to a wrapper that queries Elasticsearch.
details: POST /api/search-wrapper[/es8|/es6] JSON (or form json=); elasticsearch-dsl Search on index type text|sheet with 5 s timeout.
/es6 and bare flatten hits.total to int for old clients; web client uses /es8; ES failure returns {error}.
/api/dummy-search returns canned 'please upgrade your app' for old mobile apps.

name: Search request body and caching
summary: The client builds a structured query with field, slop, filters, aggregations and sort, and caches results.
details: Body {type, query, field, source_proj, slop (exact?0:10), start, size, filters, filter_fields, aggs, sort_method, sort_fields, sort_reverse, sort_score_missing}; cached by sorted JSON key sefariaQuery|…
Sefaria.search._cache keyed by sorted args, cloned on write; in-memory for the session.

name: Query construction and ranking
summary: Text queries match phrases with lemmatized or exact fields, ranked by relevance or chronology.
details: Internal " between non-space chars replaced by gershayim ״ (רמב"ם -> רמב״ם).
match_phrase on field with slop: All Results naive_lemmatizer slop 10; Exact Phrase exact slop 0.
relevance -> function_score field_value_factor pagesheetrank missing 0.04; chronological -> comp_date, order asc; sheets dateCreated desc, views desc.
Aggregations terms size 10,000; highlight fragment_size 200 .
Text path filters regexp path|path/.* OR'd together; sheet filters term, AND'd (must) so two collections require both.
linked_refs filter supported (segment-ref expansion) but unused by web UI.

name: Text index document fields
summary: The text search index stores ref, version, categories, ranking and lemmatized fields per segment/version.
details: Fields: ref, heRef, version, lang, version_priority (default 1000), hebrew_version_title, categories, order, path '<search cats>/<Index title>', pagesheetrank, comp_date, exact, naive_lemmatizer, languageFamilyName, isPrimary, linked_refs.
Categories may be rewritten under a TOC searchRoot.

name: Dicta Hebrew Tanakh search merge
summary: Hebrew all-results queries also search Dicta's Tanakh index and replace Sefaria's own Tanakh hits.
details: Active when type=text, query Hebrew, not exact (isDictaQuery); reset per new query.

dictaQuery POSTs to sefaria.loadbalancer.dicta.org.il/search {query, from, size, limitedToBooks ('/'->'.', ' '->'_'), sort pagerank|corpus_order_path, smallUnitsOnly:true}; skipped when Dicta results exhausted.
Hits adapted: version 'Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra', lang he, isPrimary, heRef via reformatDictaRef, comp_date=-10000+i, score=-pagerank.
dictaBooksQuery POST /books with 3 s timeout gives per-book counts as path buckets; on failure sets queryDictaFlag=false and falls back to Sefaria Tanakh hits silently.

mergeQueries: replaces Sefaria Tanakh/* buckets with Dicta counts; total = matching buckets sum if filters else Sefaria+Dicta; removes Sefaria Tanakh hits, concatenates Dicta, sorts by score or comp_date; rescales Dicta scores to Sefaria mean/std.
Sefaria scores negated (score=-_score) so ascending = best first.
BUG: mean computation divides by sefariaHits.length for both sets.

VERIFIED 2026-10-05 (scripts/parity-search.mjs): for the Hebrew query אור with 'All Results' sefaria.org shows 10,182+ sources, Tanakh (182) and Genesis 1:14 first — Dicta's Tanakh hits replace Sefaria's (the Sefaria API alone gives 10,000+, Tanakh (233), Genesis 1:3 first). The page's single search-wrapper POST (aggs ['path'] + 100 hits together) is unchanged; the Dicta calls go to another host.

Rebuild: NOT built — it would send the user's Hebrew query to dicta.org.il, a third party. Owner decision needed. Until then Hebrew 'All Results' is Sefaria's own Tanakh hits (the old client's fallback when Dicta fails). Exact Phrase is identical to live.

OWNER DECISION 2026-10-06: merge with Dicta as sefaria.org does. BUILT (src/lib/search/dicta.ts, a port of search.js dictaQuery/dictaBooksQuery/mergeQueries): Hebrew 'All Results' sends /search and /books to sefaria.loadbalancer.dicta.org.il beside Sefaria's own query (CORS: any origin, content-type allowed); Sefaria's Tanakh hits are dropped and Dicta's verses ('Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra') merged; relevance rescales Dicta's -pagerank to Sefaria's mean/spread — the old quirk of dividing both means by the Sefaria count is KEPT so the order equals sefaria.org's; chronological puts Dicta first; filter-tree Tanakh counts are Dicta's; the total is the sum ('10,182+'), or under filters the merged buckets' sum; a failed /books (3 s timeout) or /search falls back to Sefaria's results. Every page re-sorts all hits loaded so far. VERIFIED with scripts/parity-search.mjs: 'אור' and 'שמע ישראל' (relevance), 'אור' chronological, filtered to Tanakh and to Talmud — tabs, first 2,500 characters of results and the filter list identical to sefaria.org.

name: Filter tree construction
summary: Aggregation results become a hierarchical category/book filter tree ordered like the library TOC.
details: buildFilterTree combines applied filters (always shown, seeded with bucket count, sc-44603) with aggregation buckets.
Drops paths not in client TOC (Sefaria._tocOrderLookup) to cover TOC updated before ES.
Sorted by TOC order (compareSearchCatPaths; _cacheFromToc with searchRoot rewriting); Hebrew titles via Sefaria.hebrewTerm; counts summed from leaves.

details: CopyModal clones cached sheet, status 'unlisted', title + ' (Copy)'; if copier != owner sets via=<orig id>, viaOwner=<orig owner>, owner=me
Strips id, owner image/url/org/name, views, dates, displayedCollection, collection name/image, likes, promptedToPublish, _id; POST /api/sheets/
Shows non-closable 'Copying...' then 'View your Copy' link (new tab) or error
Backend duplicates GCS-hosted images for new sheets (sheets.py:540-547)

name: Save sheet to my saved items
summary: Users can bookmark a sheet to their Saved list from the options menu.
details: SaveModal toggles saved item; messages 'Saved sheet.' / 'Sheet no longer saved.'; non-closable while saving
Logged-out -> sign-up modal kind Save

name: Export sheet to Google Docs
summary: Owners and readers can export a sheet to their Google Drive as a Google Doc.
details: POST /api/sheets/<id>/export_to_drive?language=&layout= uses current panel language/layout; success shows 'View in Google Docs' (webViewLink)
401 -> redirect /gauth?next=<url>#afterLoading=exportToDrive; modal auto-opens when hash contains afterLoading=exportToDrive
gauth_error hash handled: access_denied, invalid_grant, scope_mismatch messages; non-closable while exporting
Backend @gauth_required scopes drive.file + userinfo.email; renders gdocs_sheet.html; stores gauth_email on profile; disconnect in account settings
GET /api/sheets/<id>/export_to_drive?language=&layout= (sourcesheets/views.py ~1075, @gauth_required scopes openid, drive.file, userinfo.email)
renders gdocs_sheet.html (2234 lines) + gdocs_text_source.html to HTML and uploads as vnd.google-apps.document.
Stores gauth_email on profile; /gauth, /gauth/callback, /unlink-gauth (sefaria/views.py:372-384).

name: Delete sheet
summary: Owners can delete a sheet after confirming; they are returned to their profile.
details: DeleteModal calls deleteSheetById then navigates to author profile; non-closable
POST /api/sheets/<id>/delete (owner or owner's apikey) also removes from collections, notifications and ES
BUG: add_source_to_sheet_api/copy_source_to_sheet_api reference undefined id on missing sheet

name: Sheets-with-ref page
summary: A page lists community sheets that cite a given text reference, with filters and sorting.
details: Data: /api/sheets/ref/<ref>?include_collections=1, de-duped by sheet id; backend get_sheets_for_ref returns public sheets whose expandedRefs include any segment
Title 'Sheets with “<ref>”' (Hebrew quote marks); result count; AI badge tooltip when sorted by relevance; sort box desktop / filter button mobile
Filters client-side by topics (topics_en) and collections; counts recomputed; empty filters hidden
Sorts: relevance (combined_score = 0.3 LLM title interest + 0.3 percentile ref score + 0.4 creativity), views, dateCreated; then current user's sheets first, then title language matching UI language
Result click opens sheet in a panel with connected refs; search state reset on unmount
Frozen copy of search layout; SSR props sheetsWithRef {en,he} and initial filters/sort from GET

name: Sheet topic and tag lists
summary: Public APIs list sheet topics alphabetically, by count, and trending.
details: /api/sheets/tag-list[/<sort>] (alpha, count, alpha-hebrew; cached 1h); /tag-list/user/<uid>
/api/sheets/trending-tags?n= last 30 days, public, excluding copies/assignments, >=2 authors; 6h cache
/api/sheets/tag/<tag> and /api/v2/sheets/tag/<tag> (story form); client getTrendingSheetsTopics

name: Sheet and collection listing components
summary: Reusable list rows show sheets, collections and people consistently across profile, collections, saved and search.
details: SheetListing: author pic/name (unless hidden), title link (analytics), summary, info row (unpublished, author, views, created date, collections incl. displayed) or topics row, actions collect/delete/save/pin, collections modal
CollectionListing, ProfileListing, FilterableList (text filter, sort dropdown old design or 'Sort by' pills new design, infinite scroll, header/footer/empty renderers)
SheetMetaDataBox, SheetTitle, CollectionStatement, SheetAuthorStatement; LoginPrompt; SignUpModal kinds AddToSheet/Save/Follow/Default
SheetListing: owner pic+name, views/lock, title, summary, topics or info (unlisted, author, views, date, collections)
Action icons: add-to-collection (CollectionsModal), delete (confirm + Sefaria.sheets.deleteSheetById), save, pin/unpin; many tracking events
CollectionListing: name, unlisted flag, sheet count, editor count
CollectionStatement: collection image + name inside sheet header
SheetTopicLink: topic tag link; SheetAccessIcon: lock icon
BUG: SheetAccessIcon references undefined msg variable (Misc.jsx:2653)

name: Sheet Google auth routes
summary: Google OAuth endpoints connect and disconnect a user's Google account for sheet export.
details: /gauth, /gauth/callback, /unlink-gauth (urls_shared.py:256-258); gauth_email stored on profile

name: Rich-text sheet editor (owner)
summary: Sheet owners edit their sheet inline in a Slate-based editor that saves automatically.
details: Used only when Sefaria._uid === owner (sheetsUtils.js:127-130)
Sheet JSON mapped to Slate: root Sheet element carrying metadata with SheetContent child; ref->SheetSource, comment/outsideText->SheetOutsideText, outsideBiText->SheetOutsideBiText, media->SheetMedia
Headers stored as outsideText starting <h1>; a source's custom title becomes a preceding header node
Spacers inserted between non-outside-text items and at bottom so there is always somewhere to type
Void elements: ProfilePic, SheetMedia, SheetSource, SheetOutsideBiText, horizontal-line
Hotjar using_new_editor event on load

name: Sheet HTML import and export mapping
summary: Existing sheet text is converted in and out of the editor, preserving formatting from older sheets.
details:
