Save payload: status, id, promptedToPublish, lastModified, summary, options, tags, displayedCollection, title, sources, nextNode

name: Editor element rendering
summary: The editor renders each sheet block type (sources, comments, media, lists, tables, headers) with in-place editing styles.
details: Element types: spacer, SheetSource & SheetOutsideBiText (boxed), SheetComment, SheetOutsideText (auto lang class), SheetMedia, he/en, TextRef, SourceContentText, paragraph, bulleted/numbered list, list-item, header (h1.serif), link, table/tr/td, horizontal-line
Media: image; YouTube embed rel=0&showinfo=0; Vimeo 315px; Spotify 380px; SoundCloud 120px; Bandcamp 120px; mp3 audio; else empty
Paragraph has 'add new line' ::before button, centered if text-align:center, loading spinner while a source loads
Highlight class when editor.highlightedNode matches; spacer shows Add interface when selected and caret collapsed

name: Boxed source editing
summary: Each source in the editor is a box where Hebrew and English text can be edited separately and the box can be dragged.
details: Each SheetSource/OutsideBiText has two nested Slate editors (he, en) synced to parent node; click activates box; clicking a language area makes it editable; blur deactivates
Chrome hack toggles parent contenteditable so Ctrl+A / Alt+Up work; mouse-down anti-jump hack
English editable always dir=ltr; bold/italic/underline hotkeys and basic hover menu (B/I/U/highlight) inside source
Ref link at top of each language column to library
Drag & drop whole sources: custom drag image (ref in he/en per UI lang, category color), sets slate fragment + html + text, handled in insertData

name: Editor guide
summary: A bulb button opens a how-to guide for the sheet editor to owners.
details: GuideButton in metadata box; guide type 'editor' shown only on multipanel, panel 0, mode 'Sheet' and user is owner
Content from /api/guides/editor; rendered by GuideOverlay

name: Open sheet at highlighted node
summary: Opening a sheet with a node in the URL scrolls to that node.
details: Scrolls .sheetsInPanel so data-sheet-node is 200px (multipanel) / 70px from top

name: Create new sheet
summary: Signed-in users create a new empty sheet and land directly in the editor.
details: /sheets/new login_required; creates empty unlisted sheet with default options then renders via catchall; referer /sheets/new sets sheet.editor=True
?assignment= no longer processed on /sheets/new
Entry buttons: profile 'Create Sheet' and CreateASheet sidebar module; /api/sheets/create/<ref>[/<sources>] makes a sheet from a text

name: Add source by citation
summary: Owners add a text source by typing a reference with autocomplete and a live preview.
details: '+' on an empty selected spacer opens Add Source / Add Image / Add Media

Autocompleter over Sefaria.getName(input, 5, ['ref']): category-colored suggestions, address-example helper text, live preview of section/segment text; Add Source button / Enter when input is section/segment ref
insertSource: sets paragraph loading; resolves normal en/he refs; fetches segments and builds HTML; segment numbers <small>(n)</small> (Hebrew numerals in he) except Talmud and Pesach Haggadah

Each segment its own

except Tanakh and Talmud (sheetsUtils.js:24-69); adds trailing spacer; fixes duplicate node numbers; deletes empty line above

name: Add image to sheet
summary: Owners upload an image (jpg, png, gif) and insert it into the sheet.
details: File picker accepts jpg/jpeg/png/gif else alert 'not an image'; base64 POST /api/sheets/upload-image
Backend: login required; GIFs stored as-is, others thumbnailed to max 1024x1024; uploaded to GCS UGC bucket as <uid>-<uuid>.<fmt>
Deleted GCS-hosted media removed from storage on save (sheets.py:489-497)

name: Add media by URL
summary: Owners paste a media link (YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Spotify, Bandcamp, mp3, image) and it is embedded.
details: 'Add Media' button appears only when URL recognized (isMediaLink)
YouTube watch/short/youtu.be -> /embed/<id>?rel=0&showinfo=0; Vimeo -> player URL; direct image URLs; .mp3; SoundCloud -> widget URL with color/auto_play/hide_related
Spotify open.spotify.com/<type>/<id> -> /embed/...; Bandcamp EmbeddedPlayer forces artwork=small
Tooltip: 'We can process YouTube and SoundCloud links, and hosted mp3's and images'

name: Typed citation auto-conversion
summary: Typing a reference on its own line and pressing Enter turns it into a source block.
details: While typing in outside text, lines <=50 chars checked with Sefaria.getName; if ref, styled isRef (inlineTextRef)
Enter on a line that is a section/segment ref replaces it with a SheetSource (getRefInText); triggered on space or caret on isRef text

name: Smart paste and drop
summary: Pasting Sefaria links inserts titled links, and pasted or dropped content is cleaned and numbered.
details: URL whose host starts with www.sefaria.org: fetches page and inserts link titled with page <title>; other URLs pasted as-is
Drag data into spacer handled with insert/delete 'dance'; always de-dupes node numbers afterwards
HTML paste uses Slate default + deserialize rules

name: Formatting toolbar and shortcuts
summary: Selecting text shows a floating toolbar for bold, italic, underline, highlight, links, headers and lists.
details: HoverMenu portal into #s2 above non-empty, non-collapsed, non-link selection while focused
Highlight has 5 colors (#E6DABC #EAC4B6 #D5A7B3 #AECAB7 #ADCCDB) plus clear; click outside closes
Full menu adds Link, Header (h1), Numbered list, Bulleted list; boxed-source menu has only B/I/U/highlight
Leaf renders big, small, superscript, color, text-align (no buttons; preserved from imported HTML)
Shortcuts mod+b/i/u; native formatBold/Italic/Underline beforeinput; manual Backspace/Delete handling

name: Inline link editing
summary: Owners add and edit hyperlinks in sheet text through a hover popover.
details: Hover 500ms shows URL popover input; URL normalized via new URL, email -> mailto:, else prepends http://
Empty URL on blur removes link; X removes link; new link inserted as 'New Link' or wraps selection
Links inside list items get trailing space on Enter to stop link continuation

name: Editor Enter/Backspace and structure rules
summary: The editor has custom rules for Enter, Backspace, cut/copy and tables so sources and spacers behave predictably.
details: Enter in middle of outside text = soft break; in header = new outside text; on empty list item exits list; otherwise inserts spacer
Backspace never past doc start; on SheetSource deletes it; from spacer selects rather than deleting source; end-of-doc spacer special handling
Cut/copy of a source selects surrounding characters so void is cut
Tables: no backspace/delete across cell boundaries; Enter disabled inside tables
Scroll caret into view near viewport bottom (ensureInView)

name: Editor document normalization
summary: Behind the scenes the editor keeps the document well-formed: merging text, adding spacers and numbering every item.
details: No nested Sheet/SheetContent; outside-text language auto RTL/LTR; wrap raw text in paragraphs; merge adjacent outside texts
Empty paragraph/outside text -> spacer; spacer with text -> outside text; lift misplaced spacers/sheet elements/headers
Ensure every item has a node id (increments nextNode); checkAndFixDuplicateSheetNodeNumbers
Spacers before/after boxed sources; at most one between boxed sources; only TextRef+SourceContentText inside he/en; '...' placeholder when a language empty

name: Inline title and summary editing
summary: Owners edit the sheet title and summary directly on the page.
details: contentEditable title and summary in SheetMetaDataBox; save on blur; empty content cleared
Summary box shown when editable even if empty

name: Sheet autosave
summary: Changes to a sheet save automatically shortly after typing.
details: Debounced 500ms after any change to content, title or summary; POST /api/sheets/ form field json
Response updates status/title/summary and cache
Optimistic concurrency: payload lastModified = cached dateModified; server rejects with 'Sheet updated.' rebuild:true if differs (sheets.py:476-481)
Server recomputes includedRefs/expandedRefs on every save; sheetLanguage inferred from title (all-Hebrew -> hebrew)

name: Save-state indicator and input lock
summary: The editor shows saved/saving/error state and blocks editing when saving fails so no work is silently lost.
details: States: saved, saving, unsaved, connectionLost (HTTP 0), userUnauthenticated (401), unknownError (other, or still saving after 20s)
On non-saved error states editor and title are input-blocked (mouse/keyboard/clipboard/drag/focus captured)
Connection lost -> re-save polling every 2s; unauthenticated shows Log in link with next
beforeunload warning when not saved; indicator EditorSaveStateIndicator with icon/tooltip/message, aria-live, shown in sidebar (multipanel only)
State machine only runs when Sefaria.multiPanel; on mobile autosave runs without it
Debug flag Sefaria.testUnknownNewEditorSaveError simulates failure

name: Cross-tab editor refresh
summary: When a source is added to a sheet from another tab or panel, open editors reload the sheet.
details: BroadcastChannel('refresh-editor') triggered by AddToSourceSheet; editors reload sheet from DB
No edit locking in React editor
Legacy sheets.js polled /api/sheets/modified/<id>/<ts> every 3s and replayed last edit

name: Publish sheet to Voices
summary: Owners publish an unlisted sheet by adding a title, short description and at least one topic.
details: Modal: Title (prefilled, 'Untitled' placeholder), Description textarea max 140 chars with live validation, Topics tag input (react-tag-autocomplete, suggestions from Sefaria.getName(input,5,['Topic']), Enter/comma delimiters, no duplicates)
Requires description AND >=1 topic, red highlight messages; onTagValidate rejects non-suggestions (though allowNew tags without slug have a backend 'TEMPORARY FIX')
Publish posts status:'public'; Unpublish immediately posts status:'unlisted'; modal non-closable while posting
Legacy promptToPublish (sheets.js:3681) and promptedToPublish field still carried

name: Publish side effects (backend)
summary: Publishing a sheet notifies followers, scores it, links it to topics and queues it for search.
details: First publish: set datePublished, record publication in history, notify all followers ('sheet publish'), run LLM scoring via Celery generate_and_save_sheet_scoring
Create RefTopicLink 'about' links 'Sheet <id>' <-> topic (dataSource sefaria-users) for public sheets only; queue ES sync
Unpublish: delete publication history, delete 'sheet publish' notifications, remove topic links, queue search removal
Topic normalization: '#' stripped (except #MeToo), titlecased, '|'->'-'; missing slug -> best existing topic (primary title, numSources) or create new topic

name: Sheet save permissions and sanitization
summary: The server controls who may edit a sheet and cleans submitted HTML.
details: Save requires login or apikey; owner, or collaboration anyone-can-edit, or anyone-can-add/assigner (can_add); anonymous -> 401 errorAction loginRedirect
bleach allowed tags/attrs/styles (a[href,name,target,data-ref], color/background-color/text-align, class); title and summary bleached
displayedCollection cleared if user is not a member
Protected fields on update: views, owner, likes, dateCreated, datePublished, noindex
POST /api/sheets/<id>/topics owner-only

name: Sheet collaboration (no React UI)
summary: Backend supports 'anyone can edit' and 'anyone can add' sheets, but the React app has no control for it and collaborators cannot edit.
details: can_edit/can_add enforced in save_sheet_api; React editor only used when Sefaria._uid === owner
DEAD: ShareBox shareValue/updateShareOptions has no rendered control; 'Added by <user>' attribution renders if addedBy set

name: Sheet content API surface
summary: A set of endpoints creates, reads, appends to and queries sheets for the app and API clients.
details: POST /api/sheets (apikey ok), GET /api/sheets/<id>[?more_data=1], /<id>.<node>, /<id>/add (ref|refs|outsideText|outsideBiText|comment|media; footnotes stripped; optional note appended as indented outside text; owner only), /add_ref, /copy_source
/api/sheets/user/<uid>[/<sort>/<limit>/<offset>], /modified/<id>/<ts>, /create/<ref>, /api/v2/sheets/bulk/<id|id> (?public=), /ref/<ref>, /all-sheets/<limit>/<offset>?lang=&filtered=
Client caches in sefaria.js: loadSheetByID, userSheets, publicSheets, sheetsByRef, getSheetTitle, getBulkSheets

name: Legacy highlighter mode and tag editor
summary: The old editor can highlight sheet segments with named colored tags and edit sheet tags with suggestions.
details: Highlighter mode with named colored tags and segment splitting (sheets.js:1707-1925, 3524-3870)
Tag editor with suggestions sjs.sheetTagger (:2103-2215)

name: Legacy assignments, embed and print
summary: The old editor supports assignments for students, an embed-code dialog and printing; none exist in React.
details: Assignments: make assignable, link /sheets/new?assignment=<id>, view students' copies, stop collecting (sheets.html:101-104, 981-1013); /sheets/new no longer processes ?assignment=
Embed code modal <iframe src=...?embed=1> (sheets.html:1140-1150; showEmebed sheets.js:3564); print (sheets.js:286-288)
'via'/assignment attribution: assignerName/viaOwnerName computed server-side (sheets.py:121-126, reader/views.py:676-684) but never rendered in JSX

name: Legacy sheet actions and parasha-to-sheet
summary: The old editor has its own copy, Drive export, delete, likes list, publish prompt and a modal to add a parasha's aliyot to a sheet.
details: copy (:3469), export to Drive (:3495), delete (:3586), likes + likers list (:879), publish prompt (:3681)
addParashaToSheetModal; API /api/sheets/<parasha>/get_aliyot (sourcesheets/views.py:1001-1013)
Polling for concurrent edits every 3s with rebuild/replay

name: Sheet title and metadata box
summary: Editable sheet title, summary and author info at the top of a sheet.
details: SheetTitle, SheetMetaDataBoxSegment, SheetAuthorStatement, SheetMetaDataBox: contentEditable title/summary with RTL detection
Meta box includes GuideButton, display-settings dropdown, sheet options; mobile author info

name: Collection page
summary: A collection page shows description, editors, an optional pinned-tag contents tab, and a filterable list of its sheets.
details: Data from SSR props or /api/collections/<slug>; resets on slug change; accepts old privateSlug and redirects to current slug; noindex if not listed; ?tag= and ?tab= supported

Header: TOC-backed collections show bilingual toc title and a language toggle (multipanel, non-Hebrew UI); otherwise name; Edit button for admins; 'Collection' label -> /collections; description (TOC bilingual HTML or raw); website link (protocol stripped)
Sidebar: image module; Editors block with member list
Tabs: Contents (only with pinnedTags), Sheets, Filter toggle; ?tag= preselects sheets tab and filter
Visibility: listed collections show only public sheets to non-members; members/private see unlisted+public (collection.py:202-209)

name: Collection contents by pinned tags
summary: Collections can show a Contents tab grouping their sheets by pinned tags.
details: Pinned tags grouped under label objects; clicking a tag filters sheets exactly (typed filter is partial match)
Special case: collection 'גיליונות נחמה' gets an extra 'English' tag in English UI

name: Collection sheet list: sort, filter, pin
summary: Visitors filter and sort a collection's sheets; members can pin sheets to the top.
details: FilterableList page size 20, infinite scroll, remembers rendered count (_sheetsDisplayed); sort Recent/Alphabetical/Views with pinned sheets always first; filter over title + topic en/he/asTyped
SheetListing: no author header, info underneath, summary, pin button (any member; pinned state shown to others), editable if mine, saveable if not mine and not member, collectable
Pin: POST /api/collections/<slug>/pin-sheet/<id> toggles; members only; re-entrancy guarded; alerts on error; backend pins to front
Empty states: filter no match; member -> 'add sheets on your profile' + Open Profile; non-member -> 'no sheets yet'
Footer 'Search the full text of this collection for <filter>' only for listed collections -> search with collection filter

name: Collection members and roles
summary: Collection admins manage editors and owners, and members can leave.
details: Member list: Owner ('admin') / Editor ('member') roles; invitations (mail icon) visible to admins only
Gear menu: admins set Owner/Editor and remove others; anyone can Leave Collection; confirm on demoting self; invitations Resend (once -> 'Invitation resent') and Remove
Backend: role API admins only except self-removal; roles member|publisher|admin|remove; sole owner can't leave/demote
BUG: CollectionMemberListingActions.handleClickOutside uses ReactDOM.findDOMNode but CollectionPage.jsx never imports ReactDOM

name: Invite people to a collection
summary: Collection admins invite editors by email.
details: Email regex validation, 'Inviting...' state, 5s flash message; POST /api/collections/<slug>/invite/<email>
Existing user added immediately as editor + 'collection add' notification; unknown email gets invitation record + email (collection_signup_invitation_email.html, register link ?next=<collection>)
On registration invited users auto-join (user_profile.py:629-636); invitations only returned to members

name: Add sheet to collections widget
summary: From any sheet, users tick which of their collections it belongs to or create a new collection inline.
details: Loads /api/collections/user-collections/<uid> and /api/collections/for-sheet/<id>; checked first then most recently modified, no reshuffle while open
Checkbox -> POST /api/collections/<slug>/add|remove/<sheetId>; updates collection, user collections, sheet and user sheets caches
Inline Create new collection: name input, Create appears when non-empty, auto-adds sheet; Close and Done
Backend: only members change contents; owner adding sets displayedCollection if none; removing the displayed one clears it
Legacy /groups/<g> redirects to collections

name: Create and edit collection
summary: Users create a collection with name, website, description and image, and can list it publicly or delete it.
details: Fields: Name, Website, Description, Collection Image upload (<=2MB, POST /api/collections/upload, recommended 350x350), legacy Default Sheet Header image (only if already set)
List on Sefaria toggle (editing only; replaced by moderator-rejection message if moderationStatus==='nolist'); Delete Collection (confirm; DELETE -> /my/profile)
Save POST /api/collections -> Voices /collections/<slug>; Cancel -> collection or /my/profile; beforeunload warning
Routes /collections/new (login_required, noindex) and /collections/<slug>/settings (404 if missing)
BUG: EditCollectionPage uses jQuery fail: option (ignored) so upload/delete network failures are silent; mailto typo hello@sefari.org
BUG: collections_post_api error formats collection['slug'] on None

name: Collection model rules
summary: The backend enforces slug, publishing and cleanup rules for collections.
details: Website forced to https; private collections get random 6-char URL-safe slug; publishing assigns name-based slug and saves privateSlug (old links redirect); unpublishing restores
Publishing requires unique public name, an image, and >=3 public sheets
Old GCS images deleted on change; TOC description bleached; deleting collection clears displayedCollection on sheets; slug change updates sheets
Creator becomes admin; only admins can edit/delete

name: Public collections page
summary: A directory lists all public collections in English and Hebrew grids.
details: /api/collections -> {private, public}; public = listed and not nolist, sorted
Sorted ignoring punctuation, numbers last, interface-language collections first; separate English and Hebrew grids ordered by UI lang
Card: image, name, 5-line clamped description; sidebar AboutCollections (in-content on mobile) + StayConnected
BUG: effect has no deps -> refetch each render (cached)

name: Collections API surface
summary: Endpoints for listing, creating, membership, invites and pinning collections.
details: GET /api/collections, GET/POST/DELETE /api/collections[/<slug>], user-collections/<uid> (others only see listed), for-sheet/<id>, upload, set-role, invite[/uninvite], add|remove, pin-sheet
Client: getCollection, getCollectionsList, getUserCollections, getUserCollectionsForSheet (+FromCache)

name: In-app login/register page integration
summary: Login and registration render inside the reader app instead of a separate page.
details: resolveInitialAuthState (auth/utils.js:61-68): showAuth true if path /login or /register (trailing slash ok) or authResetUid present (password reset confirm); authPath = current path+search.

openURL on auth path calls handleAuthNavigate(withNext(path,next),signupSource) (ReaderApp.jsx:1375-1379,144-147), hides sign-up modal; next is current path or existing next; safeNext rejects cross-origin next (auth/utils.js:43-51).
History: auth states push {showAuth,authPath,authSource,panels:[]} with URL=authPath (488-493,417-418).
While auth showing, main renders <AuthPage initialPath authSource resetValid onNavigate/> instead of panels (2596-2602). resumePendingSignUpAttempt() runs on mount (245).

REBUILD: the auth page is a route of the new client (src/features/auth/AuthRoute.tsx); in-app links to /login and /register (header, sign-up modal, cross-links) are router navigations and carry data-signup-source (src/features/auth/signup-source.ts). resumePendingSignUpAttempt runs once per page load in the root shell.

name: Google One Tap sign-in
summary: Anonymous visitors may see a Google sign-in prompt, at most once per session.
details: Skipped on /login and /register; shown once per session (sessionStorage sefaria_interruptive_ui_shown); waits 1.2s then re-checks auth path.
Suppressed if interruptive UI present (cookie notice, site-wide banner, .modal, aria-modal dialog); then marked as shown.
Posts credential to allauth provider-token endpoint with CSRF, reloads on success; waits for 'google-identity-loaded' event if GIS not yet loaded.
Fires signup funnel analytics: flow_started, method_chosen, process_started/ended, flow_ended.

REBUILD: src/features/auth/use-google-one-tap.ts — same session key, 1.2s delay, auth-path re-check, prompt listener, analytics burst on the credential callback, reload on success; also suppressed over the client's cookie notice ([data-interruptive-ui]) and open <dialog>s. GIS is loaded for signed-out readers when a Google client ID is configured, as base.html did.

name: Account settings page
summary: The classic server-rendered account settings page lets users set notification frequency, languages, reading history, customs, assistant, experiments, email and Google Drive.
details: Django template account_settings.html at Library /settings/account; Save POST /api/profile {settings} -> alert 'Settings Saved'; Cancel -> history back or /texts; arrow-key radio navigation
Notification Frequency (email) Daily/Weekly/Never; Site Language English/עברית (Torah-specific sites), reload on change
Preferred Translation Language from SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LANGUAGES, also stored in cookies
Reading History On/Off with warning; turning off permanently deletes non-saved history server-side (user_profile.py:475-478, 565-567)

Non-moderators or non-citation spans get a debug alert dumping status (SUCCESS/FAILED/AMBIGUOUS), ref, parts, part types, context ref/type, CRRD test string, topic slug or category path (sefaria.js:678-689).
Debug mode: debug_mode=linker added to v3 text API calls (sefaria.js:644); linker_output collected into _linkerOutputMap[ref|lang|charRange]; toggle switch reloads page with param on/off.
'Current Ref' = selected span's ref or currently visible reader ref (follows scrolling); selection cleared when visible ref moves from span's segment.
Display: single status line; 'Linker Resolution(s)': Disambiguated/Ambiguous/plain title; options sorted with rejected (llm_ambiguous_option_valid===false) last, each 'Linker → Disambiguator' refs.
Ref Parts chips colour-coded by type (NAMED, NUMBERED, DH, RANGE, RANGE_SYMBOL, IBID, RELATIVE, NON_CTS) with 'from curr. book / ibid' label.
'Options considered': parsings valid first then by matched parts; invalid show disqualification reason; collapsible 'Ref Part / Node Pairings' with node ref links.
CRRD Test String: click to copy, 'Copied to clipboard' 2s; format crrd(["@x","#1",...], lang='en') (sefaria.js:710-745).

Delete/Recreate Link: POST /_api/linker-admin/citation/delete|recreate {ref,versionTitle,lang,text,charRange,targetRef}; delete confirms (permanent, prevents re-creation); a.mutc elements restyled live (spanSucceeded, spanFailed, spanAmbiguous, spanDisambiguated, spanDeleted); warning if no linker link found.
Linker editor opens /linker-editor in new tab.
Re-parse: POST /_api/linker-admin/citation/parse {parts,lang,contextRef,prevRefs}; ranged parts flattened into NUMBERED, RANGE_SYMBOL, NUMBERED; ibid context passed as prevRefs.
+ Ref Dataset POST /_api/linker-admin/dataset/ref (reports number of labels); + Ref Part Dataset POST /_api/linker-admin/dataset/ref-part.

EditorForExistingCategory prefills en/he name, desc, short desc, isPrimary
CategoryEditorWrapper / CategoryAdderWrapper route to EditTextInfo (books), SourceEditor, CategoryEditor, TopicEditor

name: Admin editor form components

TitleVariants: ReactTags alt-title editor with duplicate validation

name: Moderator Tools page (/modtools)
summary: Staff get a single page hosting the live bulk-editing and link-management tools; non-moderators see a notice that tools are moderator-only.
details: URL ^modtools/?$ -> reader_views.modtools, menu_page(page='modtools', title='Moderator Tools'); @ensure_csrf_cookie @staff_member_required; library host only.

Renders in order: BulkDownloadText, BulkUploadCSV, WorkflowyModeratorTool, UploadLinksFromCSV, DownloadLinks, RemoveLinksFromCsv, BulkVersionEditor.
Barrel module static/js/modtools/index.js re-exports panel, 7 active components, 4 shared components, constants, utils.
Every section is bilingual (title + titleHe, int-en/int-he button labels); CSS in /static/css/modtools.css.
Code references docs /docs/modtools/MODTOOLS_GUIDE.md, COMPONENT_LOGIC.md, AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md that may not exist in repo.

name: Collapsible tool sections with help panels
summary: Each moderator tool sits in a collapsible section with an expandable help explanation and consistent status messages.
details: ModToolsSection.jsx: collapsible wrapper with EN/HE title, expandable helpContent panel, optional className.
HelpButton.jsx toggles help content; StatusMessage.jsx typed by MESSAGE_TYPES info/success/warning/error.
IndexSelector.jsx: checkbox list of index titles with categories, select all/none, count header, optional language filter; used by Version/Index editors.
utils/stripHtmlTags.js strips HTML from server error pages before display (tests in modtools/tests/stripHtmlTags.test.js).
utils/splitCsvByIndex.js (146 lines) used by bulk CSV upload.

name: Index and version field metadata catalog
summary: A shared catalog describes which Index and Version fields moderators can edit, with descriptions, validation and allowed values.
details: INDEX_FIELD_METADATA: enDesc, enShortDesc, heDesc, heShortDesc, categories, authors, compDate, compPlace, heCompPlace, pubDate, pubPlace, hePubPlace, toc_zoom (0-10 validated), dependence
(None/Commentary/Targum/auto), base_text_titles, collective_title, he_collective_title; several accept literal 'auto'.
VERSION_FIELD_METADATA: versionTitle, versionTitleInHebrew, versionSource, license select [CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-SA, CC-BY-NC-ND, CC0, Public Domain, Copyright], status, priority
(float), digitizedBySefaria, isPrimary, isSource, versionNotes(+Hebrew), purchaseInformationURL, purchaseInformationImage, direction rtl/ltr/auto.
status 'locked' = staff-only edit, enforced in sefaria/tracker.py:33.
BASE_TEXT_MAPPING_OPTIONS: many_to_one_default_only, many_to_one, one_to_one_default_only, one_to_one.
Tests: modtools/tests/fieldMetadata.test.js.

name: Bulk download texts as zip
summary: Moderators download many text versions at once, chosen by title and version-title patterns, as a zip in txt, plain txt, CSV or JSON.
details: Inputs: Index Title Pattern (regex), Version Title Pattern (regex), Language (Hebrew & English / he / en), File Format (txt with tags, plain.txt, CSV, JSON).
Enabled only when format AND (title pattern OR version title pattern) set.
Link: download/bulk/versions/?format=&title_pattern=&version_title_pattern=&language= -> bulk_download_versions_api (staff), Mongo $regex on title/versionTitle over VersionSet.
Zip entries named '{title} - {lang} - {versionTitle}.{format}' via _get_text_version_file; attachment name <alnum patterns>-<lang>-<format>.zip.
Errors as JSON: "A value is required for 'format'", 'No versions found to match query'.
BUG: copyrighted versions trigger an assert ('Cowardly refusing to export copyrighted text') which aborts the entire zip, not just that version.

name: Bulk upload text versions from CSV
summary: Moderators upload one or many CSV files of text; the tool splits multi-book files, uploads each book in turn with progress, then rebuilds the table of contents once.
details: Two CSV layouts detected by splitCsvByIndex: 'single' (5 header rows: Index Title, Version Title, Language, Version Source, Version Notes then [ref,text] rows)
vs 'multi' (4 header rows starting 'Version Title', rows span many books).
Multi files fanned out client-side with Sefaria.parseRef into one single-index CSV Blob per book via PapaParse; unresolved refs reported and skipped; fatal quote/delimiter errors abort the file.
Each job POST /api/text-upload (texts[] file + defer_toc_refresh=1, CSRF header) sequentially; progress 'Uploading i/N: <index>'.
After all jobs one GET /admin/reset/toc unless failures; summary shows uploaded/failed counts, unresolved refs sample, file errors, ToC failure hint.
Server: text_upload_api (staff) -> sefaria.export.import_versions_from_stream(f,[1],uid,skip_toc_refresh).

name: Workflowy outline upload to create texts
summary: Moderators upload Workflowy OPML outlines to create Index records and optionally text versions from outline notes.
details: Fields: workflowys[] multi-file .opml; c_index checkbox (Create Index Record, default true); c_version (Create Version From Notes on Outline);
delims (custom delimiters order: title language, alt titles, categories); term_scheme (optional Term Scheme name).
POST /modtools/upload_text -> modtools_upload_workflowy (staff) -> helper.text.WorkflowyParser(file, uid, term_scheme, c_index, c_version, delims).parse().
Per-file try/except; returns {successes:[names], failures:[{file,error}]}; result shown in readonly textarea with check marks.

name: Upload links from CSV
summary: Moderators bulk-create links between refs from a two-column CSV, choosing link type and project name; errors come back as a downloadable file.
details: Inputs: csv_file (two columns of refs, first row titles), link type select [Commentary, Quotation, Related, Mesorat hashas, Ein Mishpat, Reference] (lowercased), required Project name ->
generated_by='<project> csv upload'. Submit disabled until file+project set.
POST /modtools/links -> links_upload_api (staff) -> add_links_from_csv(file, linktype, generated_by, uid); returns {status:'ok', data:{message,index,errors}}.
If data.errors the browser auto-saves errors.csv via FileSaver saveAs; failure body shown with HTML stripped.

name: Download links as CSV
summary: Moderators export links between two refs (or from one ref to the whole library) as a CSV, optionally filtered by type and generator.
details: Ref1 required, validated live via Sefaria.getName(...).is_ref (red field + 'Not a valid ref'); Ref2 optional (placeholder 'all library, limited to 15k links');
checkbox 'iterate by segments (include empties)'; type and generated_by filters ('any').
Link: modtools/links/<ref1>/<ref2|all>?type=&generated_by= or modtools/index_links/... when by-segment -> get_csv_links_by_refs_api returns CSV attachment '{ref1}-{ref2} links.csv'.
SECURITY: get_csv_links_by_refs_api (views.py:2182) has no @staff_member_required, so the CSV endpoints are reachable by anyone who knows the URL; only the /modtools UI is gated.

name: Remove links from CSV
summary: Moderators delete links in bulk by uploading a two-column CSV of exact ref pairs.
details: Single csv_file, 2 columns, exact-match refs (no range expansion, case/space-sensitive); posts to same endpoint as upload with action=DELETE -> remove_links_from_csv(file, uid).
Errors returned as downloadable errors file; help recommends round-tripping through Download Links first.

name: Bulk edit version metadata
summary: Moderators find every text that carries a given version title and update that version's metadata (license, source, flags, notes) across all of them in one go.
details: Search: exact case-sensitive versionTitle + optional language -> GET /api/version-indices (staff; sorted distinct index titles from db.texts + metadata categories);
results in IndexSelector, all pre-selected.
Editable groups: Version Identification [versionTitleInHebrew]; Source & License [versionSource, license, purchaseInformationURL, purchaseInformationImage];
Metadata [status, priority, digitizedBySefaria, isPrimary, isSource, direction]; Notes [versionNotes, versionNotesInHebrew].
URL fields validated client-side with new URL(); 'Clear this field' checkbox per non-required field sends null (backend deletes); required fields (versionSource, isSource, isPrimary, direction)
cannot be cleared; only filled fields change; booleans converted from 'true'/'false'.
Save: POST /api/version-bulk-edit JSON {versionTitle, indices, updates}; whitelist VERSION_BULK_EDIT_ALLOWED_FIELDS; per-index tracker.update_version_metadata;
response status ok|partial|error + successes + failures[{index,error}].

name: Rename version title across texts
summary: Moderators rename a version title across all selected texts with a typed confirmation; large renames run in the background.
details: Two-step confirm UI (type confirm text) -> per-index POST /api/version-rename {versionTitle,newVersionTitle,index,language?}.
Server validates non-empty/different; if CELERY_ENABLED queues rename_version_title on TASKS queue and returns task_id (202), else sync run_version_rename.
UI treats task_id as success and tells moderators to check Slack #engineering-signal for background-task results (no in-app status).

name: Bulk delete versions (hard delete)
summary: Moderators permanently delete a version from all selected texts after typing a confirmation.
details: POST /api/version-bulk-delete {versionTitle, indices, language?}; version.delete() is a HARD delete.
Writes record_version_deletion history entry; Varnish invalidate_linked + invalidate_ref per ref.

name: Bulk Index Editor (disabled)
summary: A former tool for editing Index metadata across many texts at once, with auto-detection of authors and base texts; currently commented out.
details: Disabled in ModeratorToolsPanel.jsx:13-16,35-41,82-90 and modtools/index.js:16-19,39-42 ('open tickets to reintroduce'); component still exists (671 lines).
Selects indices by version title; edits INDEX_FIELD_METADATA fields; auto-detects authors/collective_title/base_text_titles/dependence from 'X on Y' titles using /api/name/<author>.
Auto-creates Terms via /api/terms/<enTitle> GET/POST when he_collective_title provided.
Saves POST /api/v2/raw/index/<title>?update=1 then fetch /admin/reset/<title>; reads /api/index and /api/version-indices.

name: Auto-link commentary tool (disabled)
summary: A former tool to mark texts as commentary on a base text and regenerate their automatic links; currently commented out.
details: Disabled (commented out); AutoLinkCommentaryTool.jsx 409 lines.
Sets Index base_text_mapping (options many_to_one_default_only/many_to_one/one_to_one_default_only/one_to_one), dependence, base_text_titles.
Then /admin/reset/<title> and /admin/rebuild/auto-links/<title> to regenerate commentary links.

name: Node title editor (disabled)
summary: A former tool for editing the titles of nodes in a text's schema; currently commented out.
details: Disabled; NodeTitleEditor.jsx 501 lines; validation rules plus shared-title handling.
GET /api/check-index-dependencies/<title> (staff; dependent indices, version count, link count) retained only for this tool.
Saves POST /api/v2/raw/index/<title>.

name: Shared admin edit form (AdminEditor)
summary: A reusable editorial form used by the topic, category, collection and source editors, with standard fields, markdown link checking and delete.
details: options_for_form catalog: EN/HE Caption, Title, Hebrew Title, English/Hebrew Description (textarea markdown), Prompt/Previous Prompt/Context for Prompt (ai_context 'Why was this source added'),
Previous Title, EN/HE Short Description (for ToC;
enCategoryDescription/heCategoryDescription), EN/HE Alternate Titles (TitleVariants), Birth/Death Place + Hebrew variants, Birth/Death Year (number input if name contains 'Year'), Era dropdown
(Sefaria._eras GN/RI/AH/CO).
Props: title, data, close, catMenu, pictureUploader, secondaryPictureCropper, updateData, savingStatus, validate, deleteObj, items (incl.
special tokens 'Category Menu','Picture Uploader','Secondary Picture Cropper'), isNew, extras, path.

Input sanitized with sanitizeHtml(value,{allowedTags:[]}) on every keystroke.
Before save every markdown field runs validateMarkdownLinks: each [text](url) slug checked (Sefaria.getTopicCompletions for /topics..., Sefaria.getName otherwise; refs accepted) and confirm()
shown if not found.
useEditToggle() toggles edit state via element ids editTopic / cancel; AdminEditorButton is the 'edit' pill; header from AdminToolHeader (Misc.jsx).

name: Moderator-only edit buttons in reader
summary: Moderators see edit buttons for topics, categories, collections, sources and index records directly in the reader.
details: Gated by Sefaria.is_moderator; covered in detail by other inventories (TopicEditor, CategoryEditor, collection/source editor, index editor).

name: Editing support endpoints (locks, flags, revert, bulk modify)

api/locks/set|release|check/..., api/locktext/<title>/<lang>/<version>, api/version/flags/..., api/revert/<ref>/<lang>/<version>/<revision>, api/history/..., api/v2/raw/index/<title>.

name: Cache and rebuild admin URLs
summary: Staff trigger cache resets and rebuilds (library, one text, counts, table of contents, autocompleter, Varnish) by visiting admin URLs, usually landing back on the homepage with a flash message.
details: /admin/reset/cache (library.rebuild + Redis multiserver publish + Varnish invalidate; redirect /?m=Cache-Reset; also served during maintenance mode).
/admin/reset/cache/<title> refresh one index (falls back to DB load when a Celery rename has not propagated). /admin/reset/counts/all and /<title> refresh VersionState.
/admin/reset/toc library.rebuild_toc (used by bulk CSV upload). /admin/reset/ac rebuilds full, lexicon and cross-lexicon autocompleters.
/admin/reset/varnish/<tref>; /admin/reset/api/<apiurl> re-runs a django_cache-decorated API view with action=reset;
/admin/reset/<tref> book-level refresh index cache+VersionState+ToC+Varnish, sub-ref Varnish only; /admin/reset-websites-data reloads WebSite collection.
/admin/delete/orphaned-counts remove_old_counts + template-cache purge.
/admin/rebuild/shared-cache: csrf-exempt, @webhook_auth_or_staff_required, library.init_shared_cache(rebuild=True) if not already regenerating.
Rebuild gotcha: these are GET URLs that 302 to /?m=<Message>; a flash-message handler is needed on the home page (or replace with real admin UI).

name: Link rebuild admin URLs
summary: Staff regenerate commentary links or citation links for a text, or delete citation links.

/admin/rebuild/citation-links/<title> -> rebuild_links_from_text; /admin/delete/citation-links/<title> -> delete_links_from_text.

name: Cache and memory diagnostics

/admin/memory/summary?limit= pympler summary. /admin/heapdump/ heapdump_view.
/admin/error cause_error deliberately logs/raises error (Sentry/logging test).
DEAD: /admin/run/tests run_tests is DEBUG-only shell script call, 'never fully developed'.

name: Full data export and versions CSV
summary: Staff can start a full export of all texts and metadata or download a CSV of every version.
details: /admin/export/all -> start_export_all(); JSON status+seconds. /admin/versions-csv -> make_versions_csv CSV of all versions.

name: Index sheets by timestamp (API key)

name: Update descriptions from Google Sheet

details: /admin/descriptions/authors/update, /categories/update, /texts/update -> sefaria.helper.descriptions; text/plain log (views.py:2104-2119).

Customizations: templates/admin/upload_csv_form.html and admin/reader/userexperimentsettings/change_list.html; UserExperimentsChangeForm adds Experiments checkbox to User admin.

summary: CMS content is cached and invalidated through two webhook endpoints.

POST /api/strapi/cache-invalidate: @webhook_auth_or_staff_required; invalidates *strapi_graphql* keys (views.py:1633-1668). Detail in inv_08.

name: Account and sheet stats pages
summary: Staff view plain-text statistics on account creation, sheets, contributors, and a list of public sheets lacking tags.
details: /admin/account-stats account creation stats + total accounts. /admin/sheet-stats total/public sheets, per-year totals, unique creators per month/year, all-time contributors (plain <pre> HTML).
/admin/untagged-sheets paginated (100) list of public sheets without tags.

name: Categorize sheets tool
summary: Staff step through public sheets one at a time assigning topics and categories, or marking them as having no tags.
details: /admin/categorize-sheets renders static/categorize-sheets.html (bodyclasses nochrome;
React 16 + jQuery from CDN) + categorize_sheets.js bundle (categorize_sheets.jsx 258 lines, react-tag-autocomplete).

UI: pseudorandom public sheet embedded, Topics/Tags autocomplete (topics only from Sefaria.getName completion_objects type Topic), 'No Tags' checkbox, Categories checkboxes + 'New Category', 'Save and
Next', 'Skip this sheet', toggle between sheets without Topics vs without Categories.
API PUT /api/sheets/next-untagged and /next-uncategorized (staff); update_sheet_tags_categories writes topics/categories/noTags and appends a moderators audit entry;
get_sheet_categorization_info in sefaria/sheets.py:1418.
UI at /admin/categorize-sheets (categorize_sheets.jsx); API /api/sheets/next-untagged and next-uncategorized (staff PUT)

name: Spam review dashboards (sheets and profiles)
summary: Staff review lists of suspected spam sheets and profiles and bulk mark them reviewed or purge them and their owners.
details: /admin/spam/sheets: sheets since ?date=YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days) with no ref sources, outsideText/comment containing href to non-sefaria links, not reviewed, includedRefs empty;
template spam_dashboard.html.
/admin/spam/profiles: new profiles with website/social links or bio links or slug matching /support|coin|helpline|base/, <10 history items, not reviewed.
POST /admin/spam (spam_dashboard): sheets: marks reviewed_sheets[] reviewed, hard-deletes spam_sheets[], queues search removal, purge_spammer_account_data on owners;
profiles: marks reviewed, purges listed profiles.

name: Purge spammer account data
summary: When marking spam, the system quarantines or removes everything the spammer owns and deactivates the account.
details: purge_spammer_account_data: CrmMediator.mark_as_spam_in_crm, sheets set unlisted (quarantined), deletes notes, notifications, following (both directions), profile, sets User.is_active=False.

name: Staff delete user account / sheet by id
summary: Staff can delete a user account by email or a sheet by id via password-confirmed forms.
details: /admin/delete/user-account: GET form (registration/delete_user_account.html, SefariaDeleteUserForm); POST requires staff's own password + target email; utils.user.delete_user_account.
/admin/delete/sheet: GET delete-sheet.html; POST staff password + sheet id (sid); deletes from Mongo, collections, notifications, queues search sync.

name: Linker editor page (/linker-editor)
summary: Staff edit per-text linker metadata (match templates, address types, node properties, non-unique terms) in a dedicated editor page.
details: URL /linker-editor?book=<title> -> reader/views.py:1407 (@ensure_csrf_cookie @staff_member_required @sanitize_get_params); menu_page(page='linkerEditor', props initialLinkerEditorBook).
URL kept in sync via onBookChange; back/forward handled.
Index search (IndexSearch, GeneralAutocomplete) loads GET /api/v2/raw/index/<title>?_=<ts>; schema tree as collapsible SchemaNodeCards incl.
alt-structure roots (AltStructGroup), jump-to-path with scroll, crumb ancestors.
All endpoints are StaffRequiredMixin class views (api/linker_admin_views.py:76-239) under /_api/linker-editor/... plus /api/linker/non-unique-terms.
Backend: sefaria/helper/linker_editor.py + api/linker_admin_views.py; LinkerEditorPage.jsx is 1446 lines.
Esc closes the term drawer and is swallowed so it doesn't close the reader.

name: Edit MatchTemplates per node
summary: Staff add, remove or extend the match templates that tell the linker how a text node can be cited.
details: Add via AddMatchTemplateForm: term autocomplete picks NonUniqueTerm slugs + scope in [combined, alone, any]; remove with confirm 'Delete this MatchTemplate?';
replace = add a term to an existing template.
POST/PUT/DELETE /_api/linker-editor/index/<title>/node/<dotted key path>/match-templates.
Default nodes' own templates are not offered (never consulted).

name: Edit AddressTypes per node level
summary: Staff choose how each level of a text is addressed (e.g. chapter, verse, daf) for the linker.
details: Select per level from GET /_api/linker-editor/address-types; PUT .../address-type.

name: Edit linker node properties
summary: Staff set per-node linker flags such as referenceable, numeric equivalent, dibur hamatchil patterns and skipped addresses.
details: PUT .../properties.
NODE_PROPERTIES: referenceable (3-state default/On/Optional), numeric_equivalent, referenceableSections (per-depth flags), isSegmentLevelDiburHamatchil, diburHamatchilRegexes, skipped_addresses
(numeric list), isMapReferenceable.
diburHamatchilRegexes presets: Bold ^(.+?), Dash ^(.+?)[\-–], Period ^(.*?)\. (mirrors scripts/linker_books/bulk_commentary.py).
nodePropertyApplies (:428-447) mirrors backend optional_param_keys by nodeType (JaggedArrayNode / ArrayMapNode). Each has a HelpTip (?) popover with what/example text.

name: Manage NonUniqueTerms
summary: Staff view, create, rename, swap and delete the shared terms used in match templates, seeing where each is used.
details: Badges show term EN/HE titles via GET /_api/linker-editor/non-unique-term-titles?slugs=; click opens TermDetailPanel bottom drawer: usages across other nodes (jump to node, loads other index).
Add alternate titles (language auto-detected); Create term (EN/HE primary) POST /_api/linker-editor/non-unique-term; Delete (blocked while used; permanent confirm) DELETE .../non-unique-term/<slug>;
Swap term in all usages POST .../<slug>/swap.
'Search Term' box GET /api/linker/non-unique-terms?q=; 'Add New Term' button.

name: Rebuild RefResolver and Dibur Hamatchils
summary: Staff trigger rebuilds of the linker's resolver (Hebrew, English or both) and of dibur hamatchil data, with progress polling.
details: POST /admin/reset/linker-resolvers {langs:['en','he']} -> Celery task id (202); Sefaria.pollTask(task_id,{interval:2000}) (/api/async/<id>); alert 'RefResolver rebuilt.'.
'Rebuild Dibur Hamatchils' shown when index has DH nodes or after DH edits -> POST /_api/linker-editor/index/<title>/rebuild-dibur-hamatchils, polls, shows count.
dhDirty guards: confirm on 'New search', beforeunload prompt.

name: In-reader Linker Admin panel
summary: Moderators open a panel in the reader's tools that shows how the linker resolved a citation and lets them re-run, delete/recreate or reparse it and add training examples.
details: Entry: Connections Tools item 'Linker Admin Tools' (ConnectionsPanel.jsx:1063-1081, moderators only) sets ?with=LinkerAdmin&debug_mode=linker (Sefaria.util.setLinkerAdminUrlParams) and reloads;
connections mode 'LinkerAdmin'.
Moderator click on linker citation a.mutc -> ReaderPanel.handleLinkerAdminCitationClick; non-moderators get Sefaria._makeLinkerDebugAlert instead (TextRange.jsx:480-500).
Buttons: Re-run linker (POST /_api/linker-admin/segment/rerun per visible version, pollTask, alert, reload); Delete/Recreate Link (POST /_api/linker-admin/citation/delete|recreate;
deletion prevents recreation even on re-run); Linker editor (new tab); Re-parse (POST .../citation/parse {parts,lang,contextRef,prevRefs}); + Ref Dataset (POST .../dataset/ref saves NER example);
+ Ref Part Dataset (.../dataset/ref-part).
Display: Linker resolution vs Disambiguator (LLM)

arrow, ambiguity options (rejected greyed), ref-part chips by type (NAMED, NUMBERED, DH, RANGE, RANGE_SYMBOL, IBID, RELATIVE, NON_CTS), 'Options considered' sorted valid-first, collapsible 'Ref Part /
Node Pairings', copy-to-clipboard 'CRRD Test String' for linker_test.py.
Backend api/linker_admin_views.py:10-74 -> helper.linker_resource_panel_admin (rerun returns 202+task; dataset adds return 201).

name: Linker debug mode (debug_mode=linker)
summary: A debug URL parameter makes the text API return linker output and colors each citation by outcome so moderators can see failures and ambiguities.
details: debug_mode=linker query param propagated in all reader URLs (ReaderApp.jsx:798-800, 834-836) and added to text API calls (sefaria.js:643).
API returns linker_output; Sefaria._buildLinkerOutputMap indexes by ref|lang|charRange (sefaria.js:665-675).
Citation anchors get classes spanSucceeded/spanFailed/spanAmbiguous/spanDisambiguated/spanDeleted.
Tightly coupled to reader text spans (a.mutc, data-range).

name: Remote config feature flags
summary: Admins change runtime settings and feature flags without redeploying, and the client reads active ones.
details: RemoteConfigEntry (key unique <=100, raw_value, value_type string|int|bool|json, description, is_active); bool raw values must be '1'/'0'; parse_value validated on save.
Process-local remoteConfigCache loaded in apps.ready(), reloaded on save/delete; other processes and Celery workers need restart/reload.
GET /api/remote-config returns all active entries; Django admin /admin/remote_config/remoteconfigentry/.
Keys: feature.linker.current_version (default '3'), feature.text.ref_cache_limit, feature.webpages.enable, feature.client.remote_config_json (JSON injected as client props 'remoteConfig' used for
remoteConfig.sentry.* in client.jsx:30-33 and remoteConfig.chatbot.hide), feature.cookies.expire_legacy, feature.sentry.config, search entity field boosts (topic/author/book), chatbot keys
(max_input_chars, max_prompts, promoLearnMoreUrls, show_join_chatbot_banner, promoMaybeLaterJSON, promoSessionLengthSeconds).
Client props: reader/views.py:225 props['remoteConfig']; unpacked in sefaria.js:4042.

name: Topic pool and schedule curation (django_topics)
summary: Product staff curate which topics belong to which pools and schedule the topic of the day and seasonal topics in Django admin.
details: Models: Topic (slug PK, en_title, he_title, M2M pools), TopicPool (name unique;
PoolType library, sheets, general_en, general_he, torah_tab), TopicOfTheDay + proxies FeaturedTopicEnglish/Hebrew (topic, start_date, lang), SeasonalTopic + proxies (topic, secondary_topic,
start_date, display_start/end for Israel and diaspora, display_date_prefix/suffix, lang). Topic.objects.build_slug_to_pools_cache. topic_of_the_day.py is an older duplicate model file.
Admin: Topic list filtered by pool (default Library) with boolean columns, search, bulk add/remove actions for each of 5 pools, read-only slug/titles, Sefaria link, no add/delete;
rebuilds pool cache on save.
Public use: /api/topics/pools/<pool>, /_api/topics/featured-topic, /api/calendars/topics/holiday, random-by-topic, trending.

name: Powered-by-Sefaria showcase
summary: Community projects built on Sefaria are submitted via form and listed publicly after review.
details: powered_by app: Project model (submission source formstack/in_the_wild/manual, tools, tech, vibe_coded, name/link/source code/reach/description/category, image_url, has_pbs_logo, tags, status
live/dead/unknown, is_buggy, last_checked, consent_to_display, is_published, featured); PRIVATE_FIELDS creator, creator_email, job title, salesforce_id, notes only for staff.
GET /api/powered-by public list (published only, PII stripped); POST creates from JSON (HMAC-verified Formstack webhook, translate_formstack_payload). Admin.

name: Dedications
summary: Dedication pages are editable in admin and rendered at /dedication/<slug>.
details: Dedication model (slug, en/he title, en/he HTML content); template static/dedication/dedication.html; admin-editable.

name: Email-as-username authentication
summary: Users log in with email; the underlying username is a hash.
details: emailusernames app monkey-patches User.__init__/save so username shows as email but is stored as hash (_email_to_username); EmailAuthBackend; EmailAdminAuthenticationForm for admin login;
overrides createsuperuser, dumpdata, loaddata; template email_usernames/login.html.
AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS = emailusernames + allauth.

name: Deploy promotion tracking files
summary: Plain text files record the version promoted to each environment for deploy automation.
details: promotions/ is NOT a Django app: files promotions/prod|staging|preprod each hold a version tag (e.g. 7.2.3-prod.2). Client promotions/banners are Strapi (inv_08).

name: Share image URL (/api/img-gen)
summary: Social share images are generated on demand from a text URL.
details: /api/img-gen/<path>: params lang (en/he; bi/invalid -> host language), ven/vhe (title or family|title), platform (facebook|twitter).
ModuleMiddleware processes this path even though /api/ is otherwise forced to library.
Classifies path against module's URLconf: static page -> generic image; library catchall -> rendered text image (ref title + text in chosen version/lang, category colors);
everything else -> module fallback image.
Output 1200x630 png.

name: Public JS library and linker scripts
summary: Third parties can embed the Sefaria JS library and the citation linker script on their own sites.
details: /sefaria.js: data.js + webpack SEFARIA_JS bundle; Sefaria.apiHost=https://www.sefaria.org (views.py:434-445, templates/js/sefaria.js)
/linker.js, /linker.v2.js, /linker.v3.js (+ .map)
EMBED flag adds embeded body class (embedded reader view)
/api/img-gen/<tref> social share images; OG tags
Remote config via api/remote-config (remote_config app) delivered also as remoteConfig prop

name: Embeddable citation linker plugin (v3)
summary: Third-party sites add one script and call sefaria.link(); citations of Jewish texts on their pages become links or hover/click popups showing the text.
details: Webpack entry linker.v3/main -> linker.v3.js (node/webpack.config.js:230-241, BundleTracker webpack-stats.linker.v3.json).
Bundles @mozilla/readability, dompurify, findandreplacedomtext, draggabilly, p-retry.
Served at /linker.js (version from remote config feature.linker.current_version, default '3'), /linker.v3.js, /linker.v2.js, /linker.v1.js (route ^linker\.?v?([0-9]+)?\.js$) and /linker.v3.js.map.
Public API sefaria.link(options) (main.js:518-536) on window.sefaria; applyDefaultOptions :493-514.
Hard-coded ns.maxParagraphs=20 -> max_segments param; always strips pre-existing sefaria links first (removeExistingSefariaLinks; the '|| true' at :528).
Deprecated options selector, excludeFromTracking, parenthesesOnly, quotationOnly are ignored with console warnings (:478-484).

name: Linker options (mode, language, whitelist, versions)
summary: Site owners configure link mode, languages, text selectors to include/exclude, popup styling and preferred text versions.
details: sefariaUrl default https://www.sefaria.org; mode link|popup-hover|popup-click (default 'link'); whitelistSelector (merged with site's whitelist_selectors from /api/websites/<domain>);
excludeFromLinking (always also excludes anything inside an existing <a>); popupStyles inline overrides.
interfaceLang english|hebrew (default english); contentLang bilingual|hebrew|english (also lang= param on target URL); dynamic (SPA: do not trust canonical URL for tracking);
versionPreferencesByCorpus {corpus:{lang:versionTitle}}.
hidePopupsOnMobile default true: viewport < 700px forces link mode (getPopupModeOnMobile :380-386).
debug default false: outlines links (green OK, red failed, orange ambiguous), alert with timing, 'Report' button in popup, console.log('MISSED'...), ambiguity options each wrapped.

name: Linker page-scan and wrapping pipeline
summary: The plugin reads the page's main text, asks Sefaria to find citations, and wraps each found citation in a link in the page.
details: Text via Mozilla Readability on a document clone (tables and <sup> removed), serializer adds newlines at non-prose elements, DOMPurify-sanitized (getReadableText :97-103);
whitelist selector text added if not covered (:21-29).
POST ${sefariaUrl}/api/find-refs?with_text=<1 if popup mode>&debug=<0|1>&max_segments=20 with {text:{title,body}, metaDataForTracking:{url (canonical unless dynamic), description, title},
version_preferences_by_corpus}.
Server returns 202 {task_id}; client polls GET /api/async/<task_id> with p-retry (15 retries, 500ms..5s, factor 1.5, 120s cap) until SUCCESS.
wrapRef (:275-306) locates citation text via findAndReplaceDOMText, disambiguating repeated strings by expanding context up to 10 words ('unique enough' > 30 chars, tolerance 5);
wraps in <a class='sefaria-ref' target=_blank data-ref data-result-index data-result-key aria-controls='sefaria-popup'> with 'all: unset' inline styles.
Skips failed links and ambiguous (>1 refs) unless debug. excluder.js never links text inside <a> and honors excludeFromLinking; tracking exclusion hook exists but unused (TODO).
bindRefClickHandlers sets href=<base>/<url>?lang=<xx>&utm_source=<host>&utm_medium=sefaria_linker (popup.js:406-425).

name: Linker popup UI
summary: Hovering or clicking a linked citation opens a draggable, accessible popup showing the text in Hebrew and/or English with a link to read more.
details: PopupManager.setupPopup builds #sefaria-popup: fixed, z-index 999999, 400px wide (max 90%), max-height 560px; draggable via header (Draggabilly #sefaria-linker-header);
header top border colored by primaryCategory from a 26-entry category->color table (:22-48).
Header shows ref (EN) and heRef (HE); scroll box .sefaria-text; footer 'Powered by [Sefaria logo]' (EN/HE), 'Read More ›'/'קרא עוד ›' (popup-click only), 'Report' (debug only).
Imports Google Fonts Crimson Text, Frank Ruhl Libre, Heebo.
role=dialog, tabindex=0, focus moved to text on open and returned to trigger on close. popup-click: close x, Escape closes, Tab trapped, click outside closes; Ctrl-click follows link.
popup-hover: mouseover show, mouseout hide.
showPopup interleaves he[] and en[] segment arrays, strips Hebrew nikud/cantillation (regex), respects contentLang; shows 'Read the complete text on Sefaria' message if isTruncated;
flips left/right, 'short-screen' shrink, recenters if off-screen.

name: Linker citation problem report
summary: In debug mode, site owners can report a wrongly linked citation back to Sefaria.
details: reportCitation (main.js:335-351): prompt('What is wrong with this citation?'), collects 20 chars before/after, citation, debugData, URL.
POST /api/find-refs/report stored in db.linker_feedback (sefaria/views.py:472-477).

name: Linker web-page tracking (feeds Web Pages sidebar)
summary: Pages that use the linker are recorded server-side so they appear in the Web Pages resource for the cited texts.
details: find-refs metadata (url/description/title/refs) stored as WebPage (helper/linker/linker.py _save_webpage_from_linker_metadata, _add_webpage_hit_for_url).
WebPages feed the reader's Web Pages sidebar (api/related/<ref>/websites) and the WebSite collection (domains, whitelist_selectors, exclude_from_tracking).
v3 does not respect meta robots noindex client-side (v2 _trackPage skipped noindex pages, v2:616-618).

name: Linker v1 and v2 (legacy)
summary: Older linker generations are still served for existing site integrations, using regex matching instead of the server-side find-refs flow.
details: Django templates templates/js/linker.v1.js (397 lines) and linker.v2.js (654 lines) inject book_titles via library.citing_title_list; both called as sefaria.link(options).
v2 defaults: mode popup-click, selector body, excludeFromLinking, excludeFromTracking, popupStyles, interfaceLang english, contentLang bilingual, parenthesesOnly, quotationOnly, dynamic,
hidePopupsOnMobile (:388-401). v1: mode default popup-hover, falls back to link when screen.width < 820.
v2 flow: titles in page -> GET /api/linker-data/<titles|> ?parentheses=&url= (per-title JS regexes + exclude_from_tracking selector) -> regex match with findAndReplaceDOMText (+XRegExp) -> GET
/api/bulktext/<refs|...>?useTextFamily=1 for popup text -> POST /api/linker-track form-encoded json=.
Legacy server endpoints still live: api/linker-data/<titles> (views.py:562), api/regexs/<titles> (582; parentheses flag), api/bulktext/<refs> (674;
asSizedString, minChar, maxChar, transLangPref, ven, vhe), api/linker-track (693, csrf_exempt), api/websites/<domain> (552, JSONP via callback), api/passages/<refs> (711, JSONP).

name: Linker CORS and remote-config version switch
summary: The cross-origin linker endpoints and the setting that decides which linker version /linker.js delivers.
details: find_refs_api and async_task_status_api are @cors_allow_all (views.py:480-503).
Remote config key feature.linker.current_version (remote_config/keys.py:1) default '3' selects the version served at /linker.js (views.py:448-465).

name: Linker install page and bookmarklet
summary: A public page explains how to install the linker and offers a bookmarklet to try it on any site.
details: /linker static page (templates/static/linker.html): install snippet pointing at developers.sefaria.org/docs/linker-v3.
Bookmarklet injects https://www.sefaria.org/linker.js and runs sefaria.link({mode:'popup-click'}) (linker.html:~100-115).
Test harness static/test/linker_test.html with sample EN/HE citations, excludeFromLinking/excludeFromTracking classes.

name: Sefaria JS client SDK (/sefaria.js)
summary: A packaged client SDK lets third-party pages call Sefaria data and text helpers.
details: /sefaria.js -> sefaria/views.py:434-445, bundle SEFARIA_JS (webpack entry sefariajs), data.js + sefaria JS; CORS-open.
Demo: static/examples/navigate.html (jQuery nav + output div).

name: Embedded sheets (iframe)
summary: A sheet can be embedded in another page via an iframe using the embed parameter, rendering a stripped-down page.
details: /sheets/<id>?embed=1 serves legacy Django-rendered sheet (sheets.html) with body_flags EMBED (context_processors.py:117) -> body class 'embeded'; canonical URL strips embed param.
Legacy sheet has 'Embed Sheet' option (id=embedSheet, sheets.html:70) showing iframe snippet; React sheet also offers embed link.
No XFrameOptionsMiddleware/X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors found in settings, middleware or nginx, so framing is allowed by default.
edit_text.html standalone also carries EMBED class.

name: Social share image generator (img-gen)
summary: Sharing a text link produces a branded image of the passage for social previews.
details: GET /api/img-gen[/<tref>]?lang=en|he&platform=facebook|twitter&ven=&vhe= (reader/views.py:1981-2024;
sefaria/image_generator.py 600+ lines): PNG with passage text (RTL aware, smart-truncate 180 chars), ref label, category color, module logo.
STATIC page types and MODULE_FALLBACK return generic images (library vs voices); version params select which version text. Used for og:image (1200x630); CORS-open.

name: Legacy D3 explorer URLs
summary: The old interactive Explorer shows link density between two books/categories.
details: /explore and /explore-<Top>-and-<Bottom>[/<book1>[/<book2>]][/<lang>] -> explore.html (not ReaderApp).
Default Tanakh/Bavli; category keys: Tanakh, Torah, Bavli, Yerushalmi, Mishnah, Tosefta, MidrashRabbah, MishnehTorah, ShulchanArukh, Zohar (dashes stripped).
'/he' suffix forces Hebrew content.
BUG: unknown category -> KeyError -> 500.

name: Visualization pages URLs
summary: Several experimental visualizations live under /visualize and are separate templates.
details: /visualize/library[/<lang>][/<cats>] -> visual_library.html; /visualize/toc; /visualize/parasha-colors; /visualize/talmudic-relationships; /visualize/sefer-hachinukh-mitzvot.
/visualize/links-through-rashi: BUG compares request.GET.get('level',1) == 1; any explicit ?level= string selects the Tanach file.
/visualize/timeline: timeline.html, staff only.
/visualize/unique-words-by-commentator...: regex has no $ anchor.
Sheets visualization: /sheets/visual/<int:id> -> legacy sheets_visual.html.

name: Visual garden URLs
summary: Visual gardens render custom data visualizations; two of three routes are unreachable.
details: /garden/<key> and /vgarden/custom/<key> -> custom_visual_garden_page (visual_garden.html for Garden sefaria.custom.<key>).
DEAD: /garden/sheets/<key> and /garden/search/<q> are shadowed by garden/<path:key> (path converter matches slashes).
Unrouted: garden_page, sheet_tag_garden_page (reader/views.py:5323-5367).

name: Orphan unrouted views
summary: Several view functions exist with no URL pointing to them.
details: DEAD: discussions / new_discussion_api (reader/views.py:4594-4630), index_node_api stub (:2094-2097), collections_redirect, profile_redirect_to_voices, sheets_redirect_to_voices (:5274-5310).

name: Legacy CKEditor sheet editor (embed mode)
summary: The old sheet editor is still served at /sheets/<id>?embed=1 and gives owners a different, older editing experience.
details: view_sheet with ?embed=1 renders templates/sheets.html + static/js/sheets.js (3,896 lines) with can_edit/can_add flags
Features absent in React: CKEditor autosave; drag-sort; add comment/outside text/media/connections ('Add all connections from...'); per-source language/layout overrides and reset
Sheet-level layout (stacked/side-by-side, heRight/heLeft), language, numbered sources, boxed sources, BS"D header
Divine-name substitution (YHVH/Adonai/Elokim variants; options yy/ykvk/h); Hebrew nikkud removal

name: Visual sheet view
summary: A graph-style visual view of a sheet with draggable nodes is still served on the old stack.
details: /sheets/visual/<int> -> view_visual_sheet renders sheets_visual.html + static/js/sheets-visual.js
/api/sheets/<id>/visualize saves node positions & zoom (sheets.py:1255-1260)
gdocs_sheet.html is the Drive-export rendering template

name: Legacy text add/edit/translate editor
summary: A jQuery-era page for adding a new text, editing a section or adding a translation, still served at /add, /edit and /translate.
details: Routes /add/new, /add/<ref>, /translate/<ref>, /edit/<ref>, /edit/<ref>/<languageFamilyName>/<version> -> reader/views.py edit_text; template edit_text.html + static/js/s1/editor.js (4338 lines).
Loads one section (TextRequestAdapter, padded section ref); mode add/edit/translate; edit_lang from direction of edited version; passes titles (autocomplete) and initJSON;
page title 'Add a New Text' or '<Mode> <ref>'.
SECURITY: edit_text is decorated only @ensure_csrf_cookie @sanitize_get_params, NOT staff-gated (login-only effectively); edit_text_info is staff-gated.
s1/editor.js areas: text load/buildView, commentary sidebar, 'about' panel history, add-source flow (handleSaveSource, validateSource), verse selection, new text/translation workflow (padEditorText,
makeCompareText, validateText), text reviews (jquery.raty stars), lock/unlock text and delete-version buttons (/api/locktext/...), /api/locks/* checks.
Header says it is legacy reader.js code now used only by Editor, 'ought to be rewritten entirely'.
jQuery plugins: keyboard, scrollTo, history, easing, caret, textchange, autosize, tag-it, raty, tooltipster. Loads templates/js/headers.js (868 lines).
s1/util.js (2823 lines, sjs.* helpers: loginPrompt, loadTOC, SchemaNode for Index editing, tagit, wrapRefLinks) also used by edit_text_info.html, sheets_visual.html, sheets.html.

name: Legacy Edit Text Info (Index editor) page
summary: Staff add or edit a text's Index record (titles, categories, schema, authors, dates) in a legacy template page.
details: Routes /add/textinfo/<new_title> and edit info -> edit_text_info (staff); template edit_text_info.html (895 lines) + util.js SchemaNode UI.
Non-staff see 'Permission Denied: The Text Info ... is locked'. Existing title redirects add->edit. Passes indexJSON, text_exists, new, toc.
Saves POST /api/v2/raw/index/<title>. Fields: titles, categories, schema tree, TOC zoom, authors, dates, collective title.

name: Terms editor (JSON editor)
summary: Staff add or edit a Term (name and titles) with a JSON-schema form.
details: /edit/terms/<term>, /add/terms/<term> -> terms_editor; empty URL shows instructions page; template edit_term.html + jsonEditor.js bundle.
jsonEditor.js (108 lines) window.SefariaJsonEditor(schemaName, initData, container) via react-jsonschema-form; only schema is 'terms' (name, titles[{text,lang en/he,primary}], scheme; x-ordering).
Submit $.post('/api/<schema>/<name>[?update=1]',{json}) -> /api/terms/<name>; delete DELETE /api/terms/<name> with confirm then redirect '/'.

name: Text version diff/compare tool (/compare)
summary: A public page compares two versions of a text segment by segment with inline diffs, and lets users click a change to apply it to the text.
details: Route ^compare/?((?P<comp_ref>[^/]+)/)?((?P<lang>en|he)/)?((?P<v1>[^/]+)/)?(?P<v2>[^/]+)?$ -> views.py:2191-2217 compare (NOT staff-gated);
template compare.html + bundle diffPage.js (diff_page.jsx 719 lines; React 15, jQuery 2.2, jQuery UI from cdnjs).
DataForm: ref input, language select (he/en only, TODO to generalize), two Version selects from Sefaria.getVersions(ref), 'Load Diff'. DiffTable of DiffRow;
each fetches segment text for both versions via Sefaria.text(segRef,{enVersion/heVersion, wrapLinks:0}).
DiffCell uses diff-match-patch; DiffStore strips HTML tags and maps positions; ValidateDiff only allows changes not touching tags.
Clicking an inserted/deleted fragment opens a dialog applying the change via Sefaria.postSegment(segRef, vtitle, lang, text) i.e. WRITES text (server auth applies).
'Load Next Chapter' via Sefaria.getRef(...).next; filter checkboxes (י ו " : ' ( ) ) toggle 'filtered' class on ins/del spans; book-level ref expands to first section with refArray;
props {secRef,v1,v2,lang,refArray}.
SECURITY: public page whose Apply action writes text; relies entirely on server-side auth of postSegment.

name: Link Explorer (/explore)
summary: An interactive D3 chart shows how two categories of texts (e.g. Tanakh and Talmud) link to each other, down to individual segments.
details: Routes ^explore(-(?P<topCat>[\w-]+)-and-(?P<bottomCat>[\w-]+))?(/book1)?(/book2)?(/lang)?/?$ -> reader/views.py:5102-5200 explore. Default Tanakh x Bavli.
Nav in explore.html: Tanakh & Talmud, Talmud & Mishneh Torah, Talmud & Shulchan Arukh, Mishneh Torah & Shulchan Arukh, Tanakh & Midrash Rabbah, Tanakh & Mishneh Torah, Tanakh & Shulchan Arukh.
Commented-out list adds Tanakh-Zohar, Mishnah-Tosefta.
Category config (views.py:5121-5190)
for Tanakh, Torah, Bavli, Yerushalmi, Mishnah, Tosefta, MidrashRabbah, MishnehTorah, ShulchanArukh, Zohar with shapeParam, linkCountParam, flags talmudAddressed, colorByBook, labelBySection.
explore.js (1177 lines, D3 v3 category10): two rows of books with width proportional to text length (/api/shape/<cat>), curved links weighted by GET /api/counts/links/<cat1>/<cat2>;
click a book to focus (axis + brush range); segment links GET /api/links/bare/<book>/<cat>; tooltips; toggle colour scheme; EN/HE labels.
pushState URL /explore-X-and-Y/<book1>/<book2>, Sefaria.track.exploreBook analytics; alert for unsupported browsers (ol.reversed).
Shared helper sefaria-d3/sefaria-d3.js (164 lines; SD3 textScale, _jaggedArrayScale, _textDomain for Talmud/integer address types) imported by explore.js and timeline.js.

name: Timeline visualization (staff, /visualize/timeline)
summary: An experimental staff-only chart places a passage's linked texts on a timeline of past, future and contemporaneous works.
details: Route visualize/timeline -> reader/views.py:5203 visualize_timeline @staff_member_required; template timeline.html + bundle timeline.js (597 lines, D3 v5).
?ref= (default 'Shabbat 32a:4'); partitions links into past/future/concurrent by index compDate - errorMargin (Sefaria.getIndexDetails, Sefaria.getLinks); time-scaled graph + passage text box;
pushState history.

name: Library sunburst and TOC visualizations
summary: Public pages visualize library word counts by category and a visual table of contents.
details: /visualize/library[/<lang>][/<cats>] -> visualize_library (:2694), visual_library.html, data GET /api/texts/version-status/tree/<lang>; lang regex [enh]*.
/visualize/toc -> visualize_toc (:2702), visual_toc.html.

name: Torah and Talmud data visualizations
summary: A set of static D3 pages show Torah by parasha, Rashi-to-verse chords, Talmudic relationships, Sefer HaChinukh mitzvot and commentator vocabulary.
details: /visualize/parasha-colors (visual_parasha_colors.html; static/files/torah_quant_by_parasha.csv and torah_quant_by_chapter.csv).
/visualize/links-through-rashi (visualize_links_through_rashi.html; static/files/torah_rashi_torah.json or tanach_rashi_tanach.json).
BUG: links-through-rashi: level = request.GET.get('level', 1) is a string when given, so only the default hits the Torah file.
/visualize/talmudic-relationships (static/files/talmudic_relationships_data.json, student-teacher). /visualize/sefer-hachinukh-mitzvot (static/files/mitzvot.csv; lets user upload CSV; parallel sets).
/visualize/unique-words-by-commentator (commentators_torah_unique_words.csv, first 60k words).
/visualizations gallery static page links community visualization projects (inv_08).

name: Gardens (visual garden pages)
summary: Curated 'gardens' of stops with time, place, author and tag are shown as maps and charts, including auto-built gardens from a sheet tag or search query.
details: garden/<key> custom_visual_garden_page loads Garden sefaria.custom.<key> (404 if missing); garden/sheets/<tag> auto-creates Garden sheets.tagged.<tag>;
garden/search/<q> auto-creates from search via import_search; vgarden/custom/<key> alias.
visual_garden.html (712 lines): map via GeoJSON places, crossfilter/dc.js charts (static/js/lib/dc.js). garden.html list view exists but garden_page helper is not routed.
Views reader/views.py:5313-5385.

name: Legacy Django-rendered sheet page (embed)
summary: The old jQuery sheet viewer still renders sheets for embed mode, with print option, collection header, likes and assignments.
details: /sheets/<id>?embed=1 (or editorMode) -> sourcesheets/views.py:169-228 view_sheet; templates/sheets.html (1514 lines) + static/js/sheets.js (3896 lines) + sheets.css, sheets-print.css.
Without embed falls to React reader (catchall).
Counts a view; builds option classes language/layout/langLayout/numbered/boxed/public; can_edit/can_add, collections, likes, assignments/'assigner' flows; video help iframe for new sheet;
Created/Views metadata; Hebrew/English options; Print option (id=print, printFooter sheets.html:924).
Canonical URL strips ?embed=1.

name: Visual (freeform) sheet view
summary: A legacy canvas view lets users position and zoom sheet sources freely and save the layout.
details: /sheets/visual/<id> -> sourcesheets/views.py:231-270 view_visual_sheet; sheets_visual.html + sheets-visual.js (308 lines, jQuery, jquery-ui + touch-punch).
Zoom via CSS scale (zoomScale); draggable/resizable sources; saves POST /api/sheets/<id>/visualize with visualNodes (JSON) and zoom -> add_visual_data; 'Back to Sheet' link to voices host;

name: Server-side rendering pipeline
summary: Pages are rendered on a Node server for fast first paint and SEO, then hydrated in the browser.
details: render_template merges base_props + view props + remoteConfig (CLIENT_REMOTE_CONFIG_JSON) -> propsJSON; if view props present, POSTs to Node NODE_HOST/ReaderApp/todo and injects HTML;
otherwise renderStatic=True (header only, client-rendered).
Node down/timeout -> elements/loading.html placeholder (logo per module/lang) unless FAIL_IF_NODE_SSR_UNAVAILABLE.
node/server.js loads shared data (toc, topic_toc, terms, books, virtualBooks) from Redis, refreshing when Django's last_cached is newer;
Sefaria.setup(data, props, resetCache=true), unpackDataFromProps, renderToString(ReaderApp).
templates/base.html: #s2 holds SSR HTML; static pages use #staticContentWrapper/#content and #s2.headerOnly; DJANGO_VARS = {props, inReaderApp:!renderStatic}; STRAPI_INSTANCE.

OWNER DECISION 2026-10-06: the client replaces node/server.js in the node pods. Requests reach it FIRST (nginx `location /` → node); it renders reader/library pages reading the API through Varnish (http://varnish-<env>-<rev>:8040 with the public Host), and passes Django's pages, every write and its own 404s to Varnish (src/start.ts, src/server/pass-through.ts; header x-served-by: django). Django's own SSR is switched off in that mode (USE_NODE = False): Django pages render client-side only until moved. BUILT on Sefaria-Project branch reader-next (helm values nodejs.mode reader|legacy; build/node/Dockerfile builds reader-next/). Verified locally: rendered nginx config passes nginx -t; nginx → client → stand-in Varnish routes reader pages, Django pages, /api and the 404 correctly, and falls back to Django when the client is down. docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

name: Who is signed in, at first paint (rebuild)
summary: The new client learns who is signed in from Django's session cookie while rendering on the server, so the header is right from the first frame.
details: Viewer query (src/features/auth/viewer.ts): on the server, only when the request carries a sessionid cookie, the cookie is forwarded to /_allauth/browser/v1/auth/session and /api/user_stats/<id>?quick=1 (through Varnish, which passes them); the answer is dehydrated into the page. In the browser the same endpoints are asked same-origin after 5 minutes. Sign-in and sign-out are full page loads.
Replaces the old DJANGO_VARS _uid / full_name / profile_pic_url / slug. /api/profile could not be used (see API-012).
